༄༅/ /ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa sbyong rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ca

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI082_ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i don 'grel khog phub/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa sbyong rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ de wā ti de wa bha ga wan ta thā ga ta ar+han+da samyak+sam̐ bud+dha te dzo rā dza ya bai ro tsa na bud+dha dh+wa dza ye a nu sā ri ni mā ma pra ṇa ma mi/ bod skad du/ lha yi lha bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzi brjid kyi rgyal po rnam par snang mdzad sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyi rjes su 'brang ba bdag phyag bgyi'o/ /ji snyed pa yi chos kun ji lta'i dbyings nyid du/ /ye shes spyan gyis rig nas thugs rjes 'gro ba la/ /lam mchog rnam par snang ba'i 'od mdzad 'khor lo'i mgon/ /rje btsun bla ma mus pa chen pos bdag la srungs/ /dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud rgyal che/ /sngon tshe 'phags pa'i yul du rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /kun dga' snying po la sogs yo ga la/ /mkhas pa'i skyes chen rnams la dad pas 'dud/ /phyi rabs gangs ri'i khrod 'dir dam pa'i chos/ /bsgyur mdzad lo chen rin chen bzang po dang / /khyad par rdo rje 'chang dbang mi yi zol/ /sa skya'i bla chen zhabs zung spyi bos mchod/ /de sras bsod nams ye shes rtser son dang / /khyad par yo ga bstan pa'i srol chen po/ /gsal mdzad dpal ldan sa skya'i rje btsun zhes/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin de bsngags par 'os/ /gzhan yang 'jam mgon sa skya paṇa chen zhabs/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa dngos brgyud slob mar bcas/ /khyad par kun dga'i 'dren mdzad bzang po dang / /dkon mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyag gi gnas/ /rje btsun mchog gi gsung la gzhan dag gi /log par rtog pa lung rig gis bsal nas/ /rnam dag bstan pa rgyas bshad go ram rje/ /bsod nams seng ger bsam bzhin dad pa 'phel/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i chos srid dpal 'byor rnams/

/dus ngan mtshan gyi lhag mar nye ba'i tshe/ /bstan pa'i me ro gso mdzad sprul pa'i sku/ /bka' drin mnyam med sngags 'chang chos rjer dad/ /de sras grub pa'i sa brnyes dbang po'i zhabs/ /'gro mgon chos rje slar byon grags pa'i mtshan/ /gzhan yang spyan snga chos kyi spyan ldan dang / /mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen par gus btud nas/ /dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud rgyal gyi/ /don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa'i gtam/ /sbyong rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed 'di/ /bstan dang 'gro la phan phyir 'dir spel lo/ /de la 'dir ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa sbyong rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di 'chad pa la/ bshad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba dang / bshad pa dngos gnyis las/ dang po la gang bshad par bya ba'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dam pa'i chos ngos bzung ba/ de 'dzam bu'i gling du dus ci tsam nas byung ba/ de la rgya bod dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos ji ltar tsam byung ba/ dgongs 'grel de dag gi nang nas yo ga stod lugs kyi rjes su 'brang nas rang lugs bzhag pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gdul bya rnams kyi blo'i rim pa dang 'tshams par phyi mtshan nyid kyi theg pa dang / nang gsang sngags kyi theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bskor ba yin te/ mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i rgyal po las/ rgyu la mos pa rgyu chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ong dus na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ltar gnyis kyi nang nas 'dir phyi ma yin la/ de la yang rgya bod paṇa grub rnams kyis rgyud sde so so'i rjes su 'brang nas rgyud sde gnyis dang / gsum dang / bzhi dang / lnga dang / drug tu bzhed pa la sogs du ma yod kyang /

rgyud sde bzhir nges pa yin te/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de ltag la/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang na bla med rnal 'byor rgyud du bsdus nas/ bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum du yang nges pa yin te/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rjes sngags don rnam gzigs las/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya dbye bas/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de yang bya rgyud la bdag nyid lhar mi bskyed cing / dka' thub gtsang sbra dang bcas te mdun du bris sku'i lugs ma gang rung lhar bskyed pa dang / yang na spyan 'dren pa tsam byed kyi/ ye shes pa dgug gzhug mi byed par lha rje dpon lta bu las dngos grub len pa yin te/ sdom gsum rab dbye las/ 'on kyang bya ba'i rgyud du ni/ /bris sku lha ru bsgoms nas kyang / /de la dngos grub len pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ston pa'i gzhung yang dkyil 'khor cho ga gtso bor ston pa gsang ba spyi rgyud/ lha'i sgrub thabs gtso bor ston pa legs grub kyi rgyud/ phyag rgya gtso bor ston pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i rgyud/ mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor gtso bor ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma'i rgyud sde bya ba'i spyi'i rgyud sde bya ba spyi'i rgyud chen bzhi dang / bya ba so so'i rgyud rnams yin no/ /spyod rgyud la bdag mdun gnyis ka lhar bskyed kyang de la ye shes pa dgug gzhug mi byed pa grogs po phan tshun phan 'dogs pa'i tshul gyis dngos grub len pa yin te/ sdom gsum las/ spyod pa'i rgyud du bris sku dang / /rang nyid gnyis ka lhar bskyed nas/ /grogs po lta bus dngos grub len/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ston pa'i gzhung yang /

rnam snang mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud dang / phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud lta bu yin no/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la rang nyid lhar bskyed/ de la ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs te dgug gzhug byas/ ji srid phyag rgya ma bkrol gyi bar du ye shes pa bzhugs shing / phyag rgya bkrol nas ye shes pa gshegs/ rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' chig rkyang du gnas par bshad pas/ lha rje dpon lta bus dngos grub len pa yin te/ sdom pa gsum las/ rnal 'byor rgyud du phyi rol la/ /dmigs pa'i rkyen tsam byas nas kyang / /rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa' la/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs te/ /ji tsam phyag rgya ma bkrol ba/ /de yi bar du sangs rgyas bzhugs/ /phyag rgya bkrol nas sangs rgyas gshegs/ /de nas rang nyid tha mal 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ tha mal 'gyur zhes pa yang / ye shes pa gshegs nas dam tshig pa chig rkyang du gnas pa la bya'o/ /de ston pa'i gzhung yang / rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa/ bshad rgyud la dum bu dang po'i bshad rgyud rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gtso bor ston pa thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud/ dum bu gnyis pa'i bshad rgyud 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rtogs pa chen po'am/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi rtogs pa gnyis ni so so'i bshad rgyud yin la/ thun mong gi bshad rgyud ni rdo rje rtse mo'am/ badz+ra shrī kha ra'i rgyud dang / rgya cher rol pa/ zhes mtshan gyi rnam grangs gsum dang ldan pa de yin no/ /cha mthun gyi rgyud ni dpal mchog dang po pa dang / dpal mchog sher phyin gyi skor lta bu yin la/ 'di gnyis la sher dum dang sngags dum yang zer/ gzhan yang ngan song sbyong rgyud/ rnam snang sgyu dra/ rab gnas mdor bsdus/ rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud/ gsang ba nor bu'i rgyud/ gsang ba rgyan gyi bkod pa'i rgyud rnams kyang cha mthun gyi rgyud yin no/

/gtsug dgu'i rgyud ces grags pa ni bu ston rin po ches bka' ma yin par bzhed cing / de nyid don la yang gnas te/ 'di'i mjug gi tshigs bcad du/ kun snying dang 'jigs med sbas pa'i man ngag la brten nas brtsams zhes 'byung ba'i phyir/ des na rgya 'grel tshad ldan zhig yin par nges kyang / 'di yis mdzad kyi gsal kha mi snang la/ bu ston rin po ches 'di la brten nas gtsug dgu'i cho ga yang mdzad do/ /bla med la bdag nyid lhar bskyed/ de la ye shes kyi 'khor lo spyan drangs nas dgug gzhug byas te/ dus nam yang dam ye 'bral ba med par 'dod pa yin te/ sdom gsum las/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud du ni/ /dag pa gsum gyi rang bzhin bshad/ /'di yi lung rigs man ngag rnams/ /bla ma'i zhal las legs par bris/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de ston pa'i rgyud kyang kyai rdo rje dang gsang ba 'dus pa dang 'khor lo sdom pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i rgyud rnams yin no/ /'o na ngan song sbyong rgyud 'di rgyud sde bzhi po gang du gtogs pa yin zhe na/ snga rabs pa kha cig 'dir bdag bskyed dngos su bshad cing / bris sku lhar bskyed nas bsnyen pa dang dngos grub len par bshad pa'i phyir bya ba'i rgyud yin zhes pa mi 'thad de/ 'dir bdag bskyed dngos su bshad pa'i phyir te/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas/ /thams cad zos te kun byas kyang / /'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na/ /snying rjer ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa dang / kun rig gi skabs nas/ bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang kha cig spyod rgyud yin te/ sdom gsum rab dbyer/ spyod pa'i rgyud du rigs lnga yis/ /don 'grub na yang tha snyad med/ /sku mdog phyag rgya rnam dag kyang / /rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin der ma gsungs/ /zhes pa'i rang mchan las/ ngan song sbyong rgyud 'di nyid rnal 'byor rgyud nas bshad pa'i rigs lnga'i don tshang yang /

mi bskyod pa dang / rnam snang la sogs pa'i ming gi tha snyad ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / rnal 'byor rgyud nas bshad pa'i kha dog dang mi mthun par lho phyogs kyi lha sngon po dang nub phyogs kyi lha ser po bshad pa'i phyir/ phyag rgya yang mi mthun par nub phyogs su chos 'chad sogs bshad pa'i phyir zhes dang / sdom gsum rab dbyer/ 'di ni gnyis ka'i rgyud yin pas/ /res 'ga' gtsang sbrar spyod mod kyi/ /phal cher ci dgar spyod par gsungs/ /zhes pa'i rang mchan las/ spyod rgyud kyi mtshan gzhir ngan song sbyong rgyud bzung ba'i phyir dang / rgyud 'di'i dbu zhabs gang du yang dam tshig pa la ye shes pa 'jug par ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / bdag bskyed kyi skabs su/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /sems kyis bsgom par byas nas su/ /zhes dam tshig pa bshad kyang ye shes pa gzhug pa ma bshad/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs su/ gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyis bskor/ /mang po rnams ni spyan drangs te/ /zhes ye shes pa spyan 'dren par bshad kyang dam tshig pa ma bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes zer ro/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ sdom gsum rang mchan du grags pa'i mchan rgyas pa 'di ni sa paṇa rang gi ma yin te/ go shāka sogs 'grel byed kyi mkhas pa chen po dag gi yig char zur tsam yang mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'di ni gnyis ka'i rgyud yin pas/ /zhes pa'i don ni spyod rgyud 'di phyi lus ngag gi bya ba dang / nang ting nge 'dzin gnyis ka cha mnyam du spyod pa'i rgyud yin zhes pa'i don yin gyi/ sbyong rgyud spyod rgyud yin par bstan pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa gzhug pa ma bshad ces pa yang mi 'thad de/ rgyud 'dir/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho thugs rje'i bdag /tshur gshegs zhes ni brjod nas kyang / /gsang ba'i bcing bas bcings bar bya/ /zhes de yod par bya ba'i phyir/ des na rang lugs ni 'di nyid rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yin te/

'khrul pa'i dri ma zad pa rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po go bo rab 'byams pa rnams kyis 'di rnal 'byor rgyud du bshad pa'i phyir dang / 'dir dbang la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang dang / rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis su phye bas kyang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yin par grub ste/ rgyud sde 'og ma gnyis la de gnyis so sor phye ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas slob dpon pad+ma lcags kyus/ rtsa rgyud shin tu zab cing rtogs dka' don/ /bshad dang cha mthun rgyud kyis rnam phye ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gsum yod pa las sbyong rgyud 'di cha mthun gyi rgyud yin no/ /gnyis pa 'dzam bu'i gling du dus ji tsam nas byung ba ni/ grong khyer pa ti kirti ru ston pa mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad nas byung ba yin te/ dpal sdom pa 'byung ba'i rgyud phyi ma las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /lha gnas gsum du grags pa ste/ /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams na/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri bo la/ /thugs rjes mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rjes gnang bar byed/ /ces sogs gsungs pa'i phyir/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba dag gzhung 'di nub phyogs u rgyan gyi yul rgyal po in+d+ra bhu ti la bstan nas gsang sngags dar ba'i shes byed du 'dren pa ni/ tshig tsam la yang ma brtags par zad de/ 'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams na/ /zhes pas nub phyogs u rgyan yin pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dzam gling shar lho'i grong khyer pa ti kirtir rgyal po rab gsal zla ba la phyag na rdo rjes dngos su dbang bskur nas rtsa rgyud de nyid 'dus pa lha gnas gsum du grags pa dang / sngar bshad pa bzhin gyi bshad rgyud cha mthun gyi rgyud rnams gsungs pa yin no/

/de nyid 'dus pa la lha gnas gsum pa zhes 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ston pa sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun pa'i tshe 'og min du rtsa ba'i rgyud de nyid bsdus pa dum bu dang po gsungs/ de nas sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams la rgyud phyi ma rnams gsungs/ de nas lcang lo can du rgyud nye bar bsdus pa gsungs pas de skad ces brjod do/ /'o na cha mthun gyi rgyud kyi nang tshan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud 'di ston pa gang gis gsungs pa yin zhe na/ de yang snga rabs pa rnams kyi gsung bgros las/ rgyud chung 'di la brtag pa gnyis/ /brtag pa gnyis la ston pa gsum/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sbyong rgyud 'di la gzhung tshad sh+lau ka stong dang / bam po gsum yod cing / brtags pa gong 'og gnyis yod la/ ston pa ni kha cig kun gzigs kyis gsungs pa yin zer ba mi 'thad de/ shākya'i gtso bos bka' stsal pa/ /zhes sogs dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na rgyud 'di la 'chad byed kyi ston pa gsum yod de/ brtag pa dang po 'phags yul du shākya'i rigs su skye ba bzhes pa'i sprul sku shākya thub pas gsungs/ brtag pa phyi ma la sngar dkyil 'khor bcu gcig yod pa'i dang po bcu phyag na rdo rje zhi ba sngar ston pa'i 'khor na yod pa de 'chad byed du ston pas byin gyis brlabs nas gsungs/ phyi ma bcu gcig pa rnams gdul bya ma rungs pa rnams 'dul ba'i don du sngar gyi phyag na rdo rje zhi ba de nyid khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal du bsgyur te gsungs pas na ston pa de gsum yang ngo bo gcig ldog pa tha dad pa yin no/ /gang du gsungs pa'i gnas ni/ grong khyer blta na sdug gi phyogs bzhi na skyed mos tshal yod pa'i byang phyogs dga' ba'i tshal du gsungs so/ /dus ni lha nor bu dri ma med pa sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas shi 'phos te mnar med du skyes nas mi'i zhag bdun lon pa de'i tshe gsungs/

dgos pa ci'i phyir du gsungs na/ sngon byung nor bu dri ma med pa rgyal po lus med bde bar gyur pa'i tshe/ pha ma bsad pa sogs kyi las byas pa'i rnam smin gyis skye ba phyi mar mnar med du skyes pa de sdug bsngal las drang ba'i phyir du gsungs shing / rjes 'jug 'dzam bu gling pa gdul bya'i gtso bor gyur pas ma 'ongs pa'i sems can thams cad kyi ngan song rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rgyun gcod pa'i phyir du gsungs shing / dgos pa de ldan gyi rgyud kyi bzhugs tshul ni/ brtag pa dang po rtsa rgyud dang / phyi ma bshad rgyud kyi tshul kyi bzhugs pa'am/ yang na brtag pa dang po rtsa rgyud dang / brtag pa phyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang po bcu'i gzhung rnams rgyud phyi ma dang / me ltar 'bar ba man chad rgyud phyi ma'i yang phyi ma'i tshul du bzhugs so/ /'o na rgyud 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo ji ltar ston pa yin snyam na/ de la yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso bor gyur pa drug de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jig rten pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor drug ro bsreg pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa gcig las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bzhi ste bcu bdun po de dang de'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa bstan cing / gzhan yang sdig pa sbyong ba'i sgo bdun nam dgu ni/ dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba dang / dbang bskur te mchod rten dbus su bzhag steྎ dbang bskur te dri'i gtsang khang duྎ bzlas pa byas teྎ phyir bzlog gi sgo nasྎ sbyin sreg gi sgo nasྎ ro sreg gi sgo nasྎ mchod rten byas teྎ rten med pa la sdig pa sbyang ba'i tshul dang / rang don dang gzhan don gnyis las/ gzhan don la yang tshe dang ldan pa'i don bya ba dang / tshe 'das rjes su bzung ba'i tshul gnyis/ dngos grub kyi ye shes la bslab pa dang / phyag rgya'i ye shes la bslab pa gnyis so/ /shugs las bstan pa dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis la dbye na/

bdag bskyed ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang / ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis bstan pa yin te/ brtag pa dang por/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs gyur pa/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang / /de ni dkyil 'khor dang por brjod/ /ces dang / dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsam nas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir 'dis bdag bskyed bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor bstan la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ ras la bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa bris la zhes sogs dang / brtag pa phyi mar/ sku gzugs kyi cho ga yang 'dir de bzhin du byas te cung zad du na bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzugs su bri'o/ /yang na sku gzugs ni dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bris la me tog la sogs pas mchod/ de'i spyan sngar 'bum tsam zhig sngar bsnyen pa byas nas las thams cad bya'o/ /zhes dang / tshe dpag med nas/ gtso bo ri mo'am lugs ma dang / /rdo rje can dang lhan cig bzhag /ces bris sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi tshul bri bar bshad do/ /des na rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ bdag bskyed ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis te sum cu so drug las bzhi'i sbyin sreg dang / ro bsreg pa'i thabs dang bzhi bcu zhe gcig yod do/ /de ltar gsungs pa'i dgos pa ni/ thugs chos nyid las ma g.yos pa'i rtags su dkyil 'khor bstan la/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i rtags su sbyin sreg bstan no/ /de yang bden pa gnyis dang mi 'gal ba'i ched du dkyil 'khor la yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis gsungs/ dngos por mngon par zhen pa bzlog pa dang / thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa mtshon pa'i ched du ro sreg gi sbyin sreg dang / 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sbyin sreg gnyis gsungs la/

de dag gi go rim yang thugs chos nyid las ma g.yos kyang rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems su 'dus pa'i rtags su rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems su 'dus kyang thugs rjes ngan song gi rgyu 'bras gzhom pa'i phyir/ shākya thub pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de ltar rgyu 'bras tsam yang glo bur gyi rkyen gyis 'chi bas de bzlog pa'i phyir du phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi 'chi yang sngon gyi las kyis 'chi bas de bzlog pa'i ched du tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor gsungs/ 'chi bdag bcom yang 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas don mdzad dgos pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ 'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang ma rung pa 'dul dgos pas me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ ma rung ba btul yang dngos por lta ba sun phyung dgos pas ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de sun phyung yang thugs rjes chos nyid las ma g.yos pa'i rtags su zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gsungs/ /de ltar ma g.yos kyang 'gro ba'i don mdzad dgos pas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gsungs/ de ltar don mdzad kyang 'gro ba dbang du bsdu dgos pas dbang gi sbyin sreg gsungs/ dbang du bsdus kyang ma rungs par mngon spyod kyi las dgos pas drag po'i sbyin sreg gsungs/ 'jig rten pa'i gnod pa rnams zhi zhing 'jig rten gyi phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub pa'i phyir du 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gsung la/ de dag gi cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa ni rgyud kyi brjod bya mdor bsdus pa'o/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud de la/ rgya bod du dgongs 'brel gyi bstan bcos ji tsam byung ba la/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang / gangs ri'i khrod 'dir ji ltar byung ba'i tshul dang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yo ga la mkhas pa'i mi gsum gyi nang tshan tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ko sa la'i rgyan/

don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa'i rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying pos mdzad pa'i 'grel pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa byung ba yin no/ /gnyis pa ni sbyong rgyud 'di chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku ring la dbas mañdzu shrī la sogs pa sad mi mi bdun gyis bsgyur cing / mnga' bdag khri ral can gyi sku ring la lo tsā ba rma ban rin chen mchog gis skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab cing slar yang 'gyur mdzad/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā kirti dang zhi ba snying po gnyis dbus su byon nas kun rig gi dbang dang cho ga tsam bshad nas dar bar mdzad kyang / rgyal po glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs nas brgyud pa chad pas gang gi srol yin shes par mi snang ngo / /bstan pa phyi dar la srol chen po gsum byung ba las/ dang po ni/ lo chen rin chen bzang pos paṇ+ḍi ta sangs rgyas zhi ba la 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang / 'phags lugs dang / yo ga de nyid 'dus la sogs pa gsan zhing paṇ+ḍi ta de'i dbang bka' sogs phyag len kun snying gi 'grel pa'i steng nas mdzad kyang / bshad pa rnams ko sa la'i rgyan gyi steng nas mdzad pas phyag len dang bshad pa yang mi mthun zhing spros pa che/ de dus lo chen yang sku na gzhon pas spros pa la dgyes shing / pu hrang lo chung gre ba bde ba dang dus mnga' ris stod du bon po rnams kyis dbyangs sogs kyi spros pa cher byas pas 'jig rten pa thams cad mos par yod pas de rnams 'dul ba'i phyir du rdo rje dbyings kyi snying ka'i bdag 'jug la/ dbang rdzas dngos su len pa dang / dbyangs kyi rigs mi 'dra ba du ma dang / rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa la tshigs bcad dang / lhug pa dang / sngags gsum gsum gyi byed pa dang / kun rig la yang rdor dbyings kyi rgyas bkab nas spros pa mang po mdzad do/ /de dus kyi slob ma pu hrang lo chung nyang stod kyi lcags zhar dang /

rkyang po chos blo/ bo dong gi spang ka 'dar chung gi pha gzhon nu rgya mtsho/ rin spungs kyi nyā stod me 'bar/ g.yag sde ba gnyan ston tshul 'bar sogs kyis sa cha smad du dar bar mdzad cing / de nas brgyud de rma ban chos 'bar/ rong pa chos mgon sogs dang / bu lugs kyi bar gyi srol rnams byung ba yin no/ /de rnams lo chen gyi sku tshe'i stod kyi bshad srol yin yang sa cha smad du dar bas yo ga smad lugs zhes grags pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad la kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta dharmā pā la bod du byon pa la yo ga'i chos skor rnams zhus shing bshad pa mdzad pa'i slob ma brang steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ gur shing la brtson 'grus rgyan mtshan sogs kyis zhus nas sa cha stod du dar bar byas/ de nas mal lo tsā ba/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras rnams la brgyud pa ni lo chen gyi sku tshe'i smad la byung ba'i bshad srol yin kyang sa cha stod du dar bas na yo ga stod lugs zhes grags pa yin no/ /gsum pa ni dharmā pā la'i slob ma jo bo rje bod du byon pa'i tshe gu mi bsgom chen gyis kun rig sogs zhus/ de la skyi nor dzñā na shrīs zhus/ de la gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ de la snur nyi ma 'od zer gyis zhus/ de la sa skya pas zhus pa'i srol rnams ni yo ga stod lugs kyi khongs su bsdu dgos pa yin no/ /rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras ni yo ga stod lugs la phyag len gtso bor mdzad kyang lugs gnyis ka'i bka' babs pa yin te/ yo ga stod lugs ni dang por phyag na rdo rjes rgyal po rab gsal zla ba la gnang / des sras sgra gcan 'dzin/ de nas rim pa bzhin/ ye shes rdo rje/ dzñā na sid+dhi/ grub chen kun snying / pradzñā wa li ta/ pradzñā bo dhi mu tig ka ko sha dharmā pā la/ jo bo/ rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa/ mal lo/ gnam kha'u pa/ des bla ma sa skya pa chen po la gdams pa yin zhing /

smad lugs ni lo chen yan gong dang 'dra la/ de nas pu hrang lo chung / dbus pa dge ser/ gnam kha'u pa/ des bla ma sa skya pa chen po la gdams pa yin no/ /de ltar smad du byung ba'i rgyud pa'i bka' babs du ma mnga' ba'i rje btsun sa skya pa chen po de nyid nas da lta'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad pa'i sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi rgyud pa ni/ bcom ldan shākya thub pa/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor bskyangs/ kun dga' snying po/ shes rab bskyangs/ zhi ba snying po/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrīr+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ chor bsgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ ti shrī kun dga' blo gros/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen nam mkha' dbang phyug rje btsun chos dbang phyug khyab bdag rnam snang chen po'i ngo bo 'khor lo'i mgon po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ des bdag sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la dgyes bzhin du gnang ba lags/ yang rje bla ma mus pa chen po de nyid kyi drung du/ sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis kyi dbang rnams kyang legs par thob pa'i rgyud pa ni/ sangs rgyas/ phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal po rab gsal ba/ bram ze dzi na mi tra/ swa ti pha la/ sgra gcan 'dzin/ pra dzñā wa li ta/ ye shes rdo rje/ pra hi ta/ slob dpon kun dga' snying po/

rab 'byor bskyangs/ kha che dharmā pha la/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ gnyal pa nyi she snur nyi ma 'od zer/ gshin rdo rje seng ge rgya gsar pa/ 'bro dzi ti pa/ snye mdo ba bsod nams dpal/ gnyal pa chos grags/ bya rin chen 'od/ bla chen sangs rgyas sras/ bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul rgyal pa/ bla ma dpal ldan pa/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ kha char ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen dkon mchog rin chen/ spyan snga rin po che dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ rje btsun 'khor lo'i mgon po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ des bdag sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung ngo / /yang kho bos 'dren pa bka' drin can de nyid kyi drung du/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud chen po rin chen mchog gi 'gyur/ sa bcad/ mchan bu/ spyi don rnams rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅges mdzad pa'i ṭīk+ka dang bcas pa'i steng nas bshad bka' lung dang bcas pa thob pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rje sa skya pa chen po yan gong du bshad pa'i kun rig sa lugs kyi dbang dang 'dra ba las de nas/ gnyan ston dbang rgyal/ rje btsun chen po/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang ston chos rje/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhas pa'i dbang po ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ spyan snga rin po che dkon mchog rgyal mtsho/ rje btsun mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ des bdag sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams la thugs spro ba mchog dang ldan bzhin du rgyud kyi dbu zhabs kun la gsung bshad mtha' dag zhib cing mtha' chod par stsal pa lags so/

/yang brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po yan gong dang 'dra ba las de nas/ kha char ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ byang chub sems dpa' blo gros rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ mkhan chen nam mkha' dbang phyug rje chos dbang phyug 'khor lo'i mgon po mus chen bud+dha'i mtshan can/ de'i drung du sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bdag gis don gnyer gyi blo mi dman tsam gyi ngang nas thob pa lags/ de ltar gong du bshad pa'i yo ga stod lugs smad lugs de gnyis kyi nang nas yo ga stod lugs nyid lugs srol la khyad par du 'phags pa yin no/ /yo ga stod lugs ni bshad pa dang phyag len gnyis ka grub chen kun snying gi 'grel pa'i steng nas de'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin mdzad pa'i phyir grub chen kun snying ni rgyal bas dngos su lung bstan cing chos nyid don dam pa'i bden pa mngon du rtogs pas bka'i dgongs pa rang dbang du 'grel nus pa'i phyir te/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge ā ming bdag nyid che/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gces 'dzin byed/ /blo ldan yon tan kun gyis bkur/ /zhes pa dang / grub thob brgyad cu'i bstod pa las/ sgrol ma dkar mo'i byin gyis brlabs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la 'grel bshad mdzad/ /kun dga' snying po zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / kun mkhyen gyi sdom gsum kha skong las/ ku ku ri pa kun snying sogs/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin pa la/ /'khrul pa med par sangs rgyas gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang na dha na shi la'i slob ma g.yag sde ze dmar bas/ bi bha ta tsaṇ+ḍa la zhus pa dang / mal lo tsā bas bal po de wan+t+ra la zhus pa'i kun rig gi dbang du cho ga tsam byung yang / lugs gnyis po gang gi nang du yang mi 'du bar mngon no/ /'o na bod 'dir sbyong rgyud las 'phros pa'i yig cha ji tsam yod ce na/

gzi brjid bshad pa zhes bya ba sngon gyi chos grwa nyams pa'i dus kyi btags chos kyi 'grel pa sus byas cha med pa zhig dang / mdzes pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba khyin lo tsā ba/ dge tshul khyung grags zhes bya bas kun snying la kha 'phangs pa zhig dang / de nyid snang ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'bring 'tshams pa'i sprag li chung bas byas pa kun snying la kha 'phangs pa zhig dang / zangs dkar lo tsā bas mdzad pa'i 'bru 'bum nam mkha' dri med ces bya ba dang bzhi ni ma dag pa yin la/ gzhan rong zom chos bzang gis mdzad par khas blangs pa'i 'grel pa zhig dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba bod du gangs blta ba la byon pa'i tshe bod kyi slob ma rnams kyis zhus nas rgyud la mchan btab pa phyis dkyus su shor ba 'bru 'grel rgan po zhes pa gnyis ni bod kyis byas pa yin yang dpe rnyed na bshad pa la shin tu phan zhes bla ma dag gsung ngo / /rma rin chen mchog gis mdzad pa'i dris lan rgol ba mig tshar zhes pa zhig kyang yod la/ yang go rim lo tsā bas sbyong rgyud kyi khog phub chen mo'am/ 'dod 'jo'i ba zhes bya ba'i stong thun mdzad/ de la brten nas rje btsun chen pos rgyud 'chad thabs kyi man ngag spyi chings/ rgyud kyi sa bcad/ rgyud kyi mchan/ lag tu blangs pa'i rim pa gzhan phan 'od zer/ gzhan phan nyer mkho rnams mdzad cing / de'i rjes su rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos lag tu blang ba'i rim pa gzhan phan mtha' yas zhes bya ba ras bris la brten pa'i lugs dang / rdul tshon la brten pa'i gsal byed gzhan phan nyer mkho zhes bya ba nyung zhig dang kun rig dang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub thabs sgrib pa rnam sel lam/ bsnyen pa rgyas pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa mdzad/ de'i rjes su kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i dbang po go bo rab 'byams pas sbyong rgyud kyi brtag pa dang po'i ṭīk+ka gzhan phan kun khyab/ bo dong pa'i rtsod lan gzhan phan gnod 'joms rnams mdzad do/

/bzhi pa dgongs 'grel de dag gi nang nas yo ga stod lugs kyi rjes su 'brangs nas rang lugs bzhag pa la/ rgyud 'chad pa'i tshul dang / sgrub thabs 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la dus kyi 'khor lo lta bu rgyud 'grel pas 'chad pa'i tshul dang / gsang 'dus pa'i rgyud sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dpon slob gnyis kyi gzhung phran la brten nas 'chad pa lta bu rgyud gzhung phran la brten nas 'chad pa lta bu rgyud gzhung phran gyis 'chad pa'i tshul dang / rgyud kyis rgyud 'chad pa'i tshul dang gsum yod pa las/ 'dir ni rgyud kyis rgyud 'chad pa yin te/ gong du bshad pa'i yig cha de rnams yod na bshad pa la phan mod/ 'on kyang bla ma'i man ngag yod na rgyud 'di'i gong 'og 'khrugs sdebs pa'i dkyil chog tshad ldan re thon nus pa'i phyir/ des sngar bshad pa ltar sbyong rgyud 'dir 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug dang / 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug ste bcu gnyis gtso bor ston pa yin pa las/ de gnyis kyi khyad par la/ ngor lugs pa kha cig dbang bskur ba'i tshe 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gi gtso 'khor kun la dbang len/ 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gi gtso bo kho na las len gyi/ 'khor rnams las rjes gnang tsam ma gtogs dbang len pa med pa dang / me tog dor ba'i tshe gtso bo kho na la me tog dor cing / 'khor la 'dor ba ma yin te/ 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gi 'khor rnams 'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin pa'i phyir te/ rang rang gi srog snying phul nas dkyil 'khor la bkod pa yin pa'i phyir dang / 'jig rten pa zhes pa'i ming don las shes nus pa'i phyir zhes zer te/ kun mkhyen gyi sdom gsum kha skong las/ kha cig ngan song sbyong rgyud las/ /gsungs pa'i gtso bo phyag rdor la/ /rgyal chen bzhi sogs kyis bskor ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor drug gi 'khor gyi lha/

/'jig rten rang rgyud pa zhes smra/ /sgrub byed dris tshe dam bca' 'god/ /la la bla ma gsungs zhes zer/ /srog snying phul nas dkyil 'khor la/ /bkod pa'i phyir dang 'jig rten pa/ /zhes pa'i ming dang ldan phyir dang / /rgyud gsungs 'khor gyi tshangs pa sogs/ /yin pa'i phyir zhes 'god par byed/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ de dgag pa la/ lung gis dgag pa dang / khas blang 'gal bas dgag pa dang / dngos stobs kyi rigs pas dgag pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gi 'khor rnams 'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin pa rgyud dang 'gal te/ rgyud las sems can rnams la phan byed pa/ /drang srong skal ba chen po pa/ /zhes de rnams kyis sems can la chos kyis phan pa sna tshogs mdzad par der bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis las/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /zhes sogs dang yang 'gal te/ gzhung des rgyud sde de dang dang de'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i rnam 'phrul yin par bshad pa gang zhig 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gi 'khor rnams 'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gi 'khor las dbang mi len pa yang rgyud dang 'gal te/ rgyud las/ gza' brgyad sngags kyis btab pa yi/ /las bzhir 'jug par byas nas ni/ /las bzhir me tog dor byas te/ /zhes rgyal chen bzhi la me tog 'dor bar bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gi 'khor rnams 'jig rten rang rgyud pa ma yin te/ rje btsun chen po'i gzhan phan 'od zer dang / rje rdo rje 'chang gi bsnyen rgyas las/ 'jig rten pa'i 'khor thams cad gtso bo phyag rdor gyi thugs khar bskyed nas 'byin par bshad pas phyag rdor gyi rnam 'phrul du grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / sangs rgyas kyi thugs kar bskyed pa'i 'byung po yod par thal ba sogs mtha' yas so/

/gzhan yang kun rig gi 'khor yug gi 'jig rten rang rgyud pa yin par thal ba dang / khyams kyi nyan rang rang rgyud pa yin par thal/ sngar gyi dam bca' de 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis su slob ma dbang bskur byed pa'i tshe me tog 'dor ba'i dus su gtso bo nas bzung ste me ri'i bar rten dang brten par bcas pas thams cad gtso bo nyid kyi rnam 'phrul yin pas gang la phog kyang khyad par med do/ /'on kyang tshe snga ma las bsags pa'i lha zhig la 'bab par shog cig snyam du mos la me tog dor cig ces pa'ang rang tshig dngos shugs 'gal ba yin par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ mchod pa byed pa'i tshe sgeg sogs brgyad kyis dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad la mchod pa byed par bshad pa mi 'thad par 'gyur te/ 'jig rten las 'das pas 'jig rten pa la mchod pa byed pa bzhad gad kyi gnas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang de ltar smra ba khyod la sngags kyi sdom pa lta zhog skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa tsam yang med par 'gyur te/ 'dir skyabs 'gro'i tshe gtso 'khor thams cad skyabs yul du byas nas skyabs 'gro byed dgos pa gang zhig 'jig rten pa'i lha la skyabs 'gro byas na skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa 'chor ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang ye shes pa dgug gzhug gi tshe sangs rgyas byang sems rnams 'jig rten rang rgyud pa'i lha la bstim par khas blang dgos par 'gyur ro/ /gnod byed rgyas par ni kha skong las shes par bya'o/ /des na rang lugs ni/ de gnyis kyi khyad par gtso 'khor thams cad dus gcig la spyan drangs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa dang / thog mar gtso bo spyan drangs nas de nas 'khor spyi 'dren pa 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor yin te/ 'das pa'i skabs su/ gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyis bskor/ /mang po rnams ni spyan drangs te/ /zhes gsungs shing / 'jig rten pa'i skabs su/ bcom ldan 'das ni spyan drangs nas/

/de nas rgyal po spyan 'dren no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor la yang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor drug la sgo khyud sgo legs rta babs sogs yod la/ 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug po gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa yin kyang sgo khyud sogs med de/ gzhan phan spyi chings las klu chen brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor la ni sgo khyud dang bral bas/ zhes pa dang / rdo rje snying po rgyan gyi rgyud las/ de bzhin sgo bzhir bris nas ni/ /sgo khyud la sogs rnam par spangs/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ de gnyis kyi khyad par zhib par ni gzhan phan spyi chings las shes par bya'o/ /'o na rgyud 'di'i dbu zhabs 'khrugs sdebs pa'i dkyil chog tshad ldan ji ltar thon zhe na/ kun rig lta bu la mtshon la sha chang sgog gsum la sogs pa'i kha zas ngan pa thams cad spangs/ zas dkar gsum dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro ba'i lus kyi spyod lam dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor khang par 'jug tshul ni/ rgyud 'di'i kun rig gi skabs nas/ de nas khrus la sogs pa byas la/ zhes dang / rdo rje 'dzin ma'i zhugs nas ni/ /me tog thogs te sgo phyogs 'dug /dri dang 'phreng mchog 'phreng ba can/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ skyabs 'gro ni shāka thub kyi skabs nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs dag la/ /thos nas kyang ni skyabs su song / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgrib med chos/ /rgyal pos thos nas dga' bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems/ /bla ma dam pa rnams mi spang / /zhes pas bstan/ sems bskyed ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs nas/ stong pa mtshan ma med pa'i sems/ /zhes dang / kun rig gi skabs nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /bla na med pa rtogs gyur pa/ /zhes pas bstan/ srung 'khor bsgom pa la/ dang por phyag na rdo rje bskyed pa ni/ me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs nas/

de nas bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje rang gi sku/ /zhes pas bstan/ de 'jig rten gsum rgyal du bsgyur ba ni/ bor te rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bzhugs te/ /zhes pa dang / kun rig gi skabs nas/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag bsrung la sogs byas nas kyang / /zhes pas bstan/ khro bo de'i cha lugs ni/ me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs nas/ ma rungs snying khar mnan nas sdig byed cing / /zhal ni shin tu 'jigs 'jigs lta/ /phyag ni brgya phrag du mar ldan/ /sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan pa/ /stag lpags kyis ni smad g.yogs bgos/ /rgyu ma thogs shing dbu mtha' yas/ /mgo thod shas gang phyag na thogs/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de'i sngags ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i khro bo rdo rje me nyi ma zhes bya ba'i snying po nyid kyi thugs kha nas phyung ngo / /oṃ badz+ra satwa kro dha zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de dag ni rgyud kyi dngos bstan gyi srung 'khor bsdus pa yin la/ rgyas par byed na dang por rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom/ de nas lag pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ gtsug dgu las bstan pa yin zhing / srung 'khor rgyas pa ni bla ma rnams kyis rdo rje 'byung ba nas gsungs pa 'dir kha bskangs pa rgyas pa'i lugs yin no/ /de rgyu gzugs can gyi sbyor ba ni 'khor los bsgyur ba'i skabs nas/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi byin gyis brlabs par bsams te/ hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang a zhes bya ba'i zla ba'i de gnyis byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo gnyis ka la a la sogs pa'i yi ge bcu drug gis kun tu bkang zhing 'phro bar bya ste/ mthe bong gnyis la oṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ gung mo gnyis la tram̐ zhes bya ba bsam/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūm̐ zhes bya ba bsam/ srin lag gnyis la hri zhes bya ba bsam/ mthe chung gnyis la a zhes bya ba bsam/ de ltar yi ge rnams bsam par byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yin par mos pa bskyed de/

chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres pa dang / bdag dang yang dag rjes su mthun par byas te/ lag pa gnyis pad+mo lta bur sbyar bar byas nas/ zhes sogs kyis bstan/ 'bras bu lhar bskyed pa tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ rang lhar ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ de nyid las/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med pa/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni phyag rdor gyi skabs nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas so zhes pa dang / kun rig gi skabs nas/ tshangs pa chen po pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs te/ zhes pa nas/ yid bde bar so sor thob par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ sngags dngos ni/ de nyid las/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti/ zhes sogs kyis bstan/ mchod bstod ni/ de nyid las/ de nas tshangs dang brgya byin lhas/ /rin chen gdugs la sogs mchog gi /mchod pa sna tshogs byas nas kyang / /phyag na rdo rje dgyes can la/ /dga' ba'i bsam pas bstod byed pa/ /sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de nas bum bzlas bya ba ni/ kun rig gi skabs nas/ snga ma bzhin du bum pa la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad ni bzla bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ mdun bskyed la sa chog ni/ de nyid las/ gtsug lag khang dang skyed mos tshal/ /mchod rten lha khang kun dga' sogs/ /ji bzhin pa yi cho ga yi/ /gnas ni byin gyis brlab par brtsams/ /zhes pas bstan/ lha sta gon ni ma byas kyang chog ste/ gzhung na med pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i tshul ni/ de nyid las/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas der ni/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /gru bzhi pa la sgom bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /them skas bzhi yi 'phreng ba can/ /seṅge ban glang rnams kyis brgyan/ /dar dang lda ldi do shal 'phreng / /dril bu dang ni rnga yab brgyan/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang /

/rgya gram pa yi phyag rgyas brgyan/ /srad bu brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ /phyi yi sgo khyud rnams kyis brgyan/ /sgo yi cha ni bgos pa la/ /sgo dang sgo khyud gsum char bya/ /rdo rje srad bus thig gdab po/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor thig btab pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo 'dra ba la/ /lte bar bcas shing rtsibs bcu drug /rim pa gsum dang ldan pa la/ /rtsibs ni nyid 'gyur nyid du bya/ /dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni/ /dung dang kun da zla 'dra ma/ /zhal bzhi pa la rdo rje yi/ /seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa dang / /ting 'dzin phyag rgyar ldan pa dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan par bri/ /de yi spyan sngar ngan song kun/ /sbyong ba'i rgyal po bri bya ste/ /phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin du bsgom/ /zla ba rgyas dang ba mo'i mdog /rgyan rnams kun gyis legs brjod la/ /rgyal mchog skyes bu gang ba bris/ /rgyab tu shākya ri dbang po/ /gtso bo thub pa bri bar bya/ /g.yon dang g.yas kyi phyogs char ni/ /rgyal mchog rin chen me tog gnyis/ /lo tsā na dang mā ma ki /de bzhin dkar mo sgrol ma rnams/ /rang gi rigs kyis mtshan pa bzhi/ /grwa yi phyogs ni kun tu bri/ /rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad du/ /rdo rje sems sogs sems dpa' mchog /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams/ /go rim bzhin du bri bar bya/ /mkhas pas la s+ya la sogs pa/ /mchod pa grwa yi phyogs su bri/ /sgo yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /sgo ba bzhi po bri bar bya/ /rta babs mtshams ni thams cad du/ /byams pa la sogs bri bar bya/ /nyan thos rgyal ba thams cad dang / /de bzhin rang rgyal gtso bo rnams/ /khro bo bsngags pa pho nya sogs/ /bri bya yang na ming yang rung / /phyi yi dkyil 'khor phyi rol tu/ /gling bzhi po ni bri bar bya/ /'dzam bu'i gling du tshangs pa dang / /byang phyogs su ni dbang phyug che/ /shar dang nub pa'i gling du ni/ /brgya byin gtogs 'dod thams cad kyang /

/'khor dang bcas pa bri bar bya/ /gzhan dag kyang ni de bzhin te/ /lha min dri bza' nam mkha' dang / /gnod sbyin srin po lto 'phye che/ /'byung po yi dwags 'dre rnams dang / /klu dang grul bum ri rnams dang / /rgyal po bzhi rnams bri bar bya/ /gza' dang skar ma rgyu skar dang / /khro bo ma rung 'tshe ba dang / /bgegs ni byi na ya ka rnams/ /sems can kun la phan byed pa'i/ /drang srong skal ba chen po rnams/ /phra men ma dang bud med bri/ /'byung ba chen po'i lha chen po/ /khyim dang ri la gnas pa dang / /shing dang kun dga' nags la sogs/ /dur khrod grong khyer gnas pa rnams/ /zhes pas phyi ma gzhal yas khang dang / nang lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can bri ba'i tshul bstan/ bsdus pa phyag mtshan dang sa bon gyi sgo nas bri ba'i tshul ni/ ming dang brda yi yang na ni/ /thig le rnams kyang bri bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ de ltar dkyil 'khor bris zin nas/ rgyan bkram pa ni/ de nas mkhas pas dkyil 'khor la/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan lhab lhub dang / /gdugs dang rnga ma lda ldi dang / /'phan dang sna tshogs na bzas mchod/ /gser las byas pa'i bya rnams ni/ /brgyad dam bcu drug dag kyang rung / /dbang bskur rin chen chus gang ba'i/ /bum pa lnga ni bzhag par bya/ /mar me gtor ma bum pa dang / /mdzes pa'i bshos rnams bzhag bya ste/ /bza' ba btung ba sbyar legs dang / /bca' ba sna tshogs bzhag par bya/ /gnod sbyin srin po'i kha zas su/ /gtor ma rnams pa sna tshogs bzhag /'byung po che dang lha dang klu/ /mi dang mi min de bzhin te/ /me tog dri rnams sna tshogs dang / /'o ma mar dang ka rar bcas/ /rnam rgyal bum pa dri yi chus/ /rab tu bkang ba bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas rgyan dang mchod gtor gshom pa'i tshul bstan/ mdun bskyed ni/ gtso bor rgyal ba sras dang bskor/ /mang po rnams ni spyan drangs te/ /phyag rgya sngags dang bdag ldan zhing / /lcags kyu la sogs rnal 'byor gyis/

/dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥthugs rje'i bdag /tshur gshegs zhes ni brjod nas kyang / /gsang ba'i bcings bas bcings nas ni/ /mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ de nas mtshan ma skyes na ni/ /thog mtha' med pa mngon sum mthong / /zhes pas phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas 'debs pa bstan/ ar+gham̐ mchog rtag gsang la sogs pa yi/ /dbyangs snyan pa yi bstod dang lha rdzas kyis/ /mchog gi dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces pas mchod bstod gnyis bstan/ 'og gi phyogs na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag /ces pas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma dang / de nas 'byung po kun la gtor ma byin/ /zhes pas 'byung po'i gtor ma dang / sems can bkres shing skom la btung ba dang / /zhes pas sil gtor gnyis/ gong gi gnod sbyin srin po'i kha zas su/ /gtor ma rnams pa sna tshogs bzhag /ces mar drangs nas bgegs gtor bstan pa yin no/ /de nas bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni/ de nas sngags pas bla med byang chub kyi/ /gnas su slob ma yongs su 'dzin par bya/ /'gro la phan phyir myur du byang chub par/ /de dag byang chub sems mchog bskyed du bzhugs/ /de rnams byin rlabs byang chub smon lam gdab/ /zab cing rgya che ba yi chos bsgrags la/ /bsrung ba byas nas brtul zhugs sdom pa sbyin/ /rang gi kha nas sngags bzlas 'jug par bya/ /dar la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yogs nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma dpal gyi lag gnyis bya/ /me tog rin chen sogs pas de brgyan la/ /yon gyi lag pa bkang ste bzhugs par bya/ /zhes pa nas/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis slob ma sta gon dang 'jug pa'i chos rnams bstan/ mos pa brtan dang ldan par dam bcas nas/ /sarba bid kyis ji bzhin dbang bskur te/ /bum pa la sogs ji snyed mang thogs pa'i/ /bcu po rnams kyi dbang bcu ci dgar bskur/ /de nas lag tu dril dang rdo rje byin/

/'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun thogs la/ /mi yi dbang phyug 'khor lo thob pa dang / /sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /sngags grub phyir ni mos pa'i slob ma la/ /sngags pas bka' ni rab tu bsgo bar bya/ /zhes pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba/ 'jug mtha' rten sbyin pa/ bka' bsgo ba rnams bstan pa yin no/ /de nas slob mas yon 'bul ba ni/ des kyang mos pas spyi bos phyag byas te/ /ci ste nor yod bla ma 'bul bar bya/ /nor dang gter dang 'bru dang dbyig dang gser/ /bzhon dang khyim bdag bu pho bu mo rnams/ /skyes pa dang ni bud med yang na ni/ /grong dang grong khyer de lta ci bzhed rnams/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su dad pa yi/ /yon gyi mchog nyid 'bul ba nyid du bya/ /myur du 'grub phyir mos pa'i bla ma/ /mdor na rang gi lus kyang 'bul ba nyid du bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ brtan byed kyi bzlas pa ni/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas skyil krung gis 'dug la zhes sogs kyis bstan/ bdag mdun tha mi dad bsgrub pa ni/ de nyid las rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ badz+ra dha ra zhes sogs kyis bstan/ mjug gi cho ga ni/ de yi lus la dbang bskur zhing / /mnyam par bzhag pas bsrung nas ni/ /mjug tu mngon par mchod nas kyang / /lha rnams gshegs su gsol ba shis/ /zhes pas bstan/ ras bris la brten pa'i lugs ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang / lha'i 'jig rten pa rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir sgrub pa'i cho ga 'di gsungs so/ /ras la bcom ldan thams cad rigs pa de bzhin du bris la/ g.yas phyogs su de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ g.yon phyogs su shākya thub pa/ zhes sogs kyis bstan pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sgrub thabs 'chad pa'i tshul la/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa gnyis las/ dang po dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bsnyen pa dang /

dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsnyen pa gnyis/ gnyis pa la/ rdul tshon la brten pa'i lugs dang / ras bris la brten pa'i lugs gnyis te/ de dag gi rnam gzhag rgyas par sngar kho bos logs su bshad zin pas shes par 'dod na de dag tu blta bar bya'o/ /de yan gyis bshad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa bshad pa dngos la/ 'dir skabs su babs pa rgyud 'chad pa'i tshul cung zad rgyas par bshad pa la/ mtshan don gyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ gzhung don gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ byas shes drin gzo bskyed pa'i phyir 'gyur byang smos pa dang gsum las/ dang po la gnyis/ dang po mtshan bsgyur ba ni/ rgya gar skad du/ sarba durga ti ni/ bod skad du/ ngan song thams cad/ pa ri sho dha na ni/ yongs su sbyong ba/ te dzo ra dza ya ni gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ ta thā ga tā ya ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ a ra ha te ni dgra bcom pa/ saṃ myaka saṃ bud+dha ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ nā ma ni zhes bya ba/ kal pa ni brtag pa'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan bshad pa ni rje btsun gyi chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid ji lta ba bzhin du chud cing gzhan la ston nus pas byang sems dang / sbyin pa dang / shes rab dang / brtson 'grus bzhi ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /des spyir 'dod khams kyi lha/ bye brag tu sum cu rtsa sum gyi lha rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal mthong / bslab pa'i gzhi bzung / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / phyir mi ldog pas na rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ngo / /mdzod spu'i 'od zer gyis ngan song thams cad zil gyis gnon pas na gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ brtag pa ni cho ga zhib mo'am zhes bzhed do/ /'bru 'grel las ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes te chos kyi sku'o/ /dgra bcom pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/

yang dag par rdzogs pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes te de gnyis ni longs sku/ sangs rgyas ni bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes te sprul sku'o/ /sku gsum po de'i 'phrin las ni/ rgyu ngan pa las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'bras bu khams gsum du song bas na ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'o/ /ji ltar na rgyu ting nge 'dzin gyis las nyon dang / 'bras bu 'od zer gyis sdug bsngal sbyangs pas na gzi brjid do/ /rgyal po dang brtag pa ni sngar dang 'dra bar gsungs so/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa ni lo tsā bas bkod pa'i mchod brjod do/ /des na mtshan don gyi 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i brjod bya mtha' dag bsdus pas na dbang po rnon pos mtshan don la brten nas kyang brjod bya mdor bsdus te rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ gleng gzhi dang / gleng slong dang / rgyud kyi gzhung dngos dang / rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /dang po gleng gzhi la don drug ste/ chos dang / bsdu pa po dang / dus dang / ston pa dang / gnas dang / 'khor dang ston pa'i che bas bzhugs pa'o/ /dang po chos ni/ 'di skad ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa bsdu pa po ni/ bdag gis thos pa'i zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dus ni/ dus gcig na zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ston pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa gnas ni/ lha'i mchog spyir bsam gtan gyi bde ba dang mi ldan pas/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha bye brag tu sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyis tā tha'i zhal mthong / bslab pa'i gzhi bzung / dri dar na ma la skyabs su song phyir rigs pas na/ thams cad kyi rtsub 'gyur la sogs pa'i/ dga' ba'i tshal yid khyad par du byas pa lta na sdug pa sum cu rtsa gsum/ du 'ongs pas na/ nor bu dang / rnam pa/ gser rnams kyi bsod nams las grub pa/ yang na sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rgyan du snang ba/

gyi shing yal ga dang lcug mar bcas/ pa dang / shing drung pa gcig tu gnas pa/ gel pa dang / sman dang / me tog 'di rnams kyi dbyibs dang kha dog la sogs pa mi mthong bar bshad kyang mi mthong na bshad mi dgos so/ rgya dpe la me tog zhes pa'i sgra med de/ rgyal po bka' bcad la 'di dag gi dod med pas me tog ces pa'i sgra med na mi go bas chug cig ces 'byung ste med kyang btub/ ka ma la dang / me tog at+pa la dang / me tog kar ṇi ka dang / me tog 'dab ku li dang / me tog ti la ka dang / me tog a sho ka dang / me tog man dha ra ba dang / me tog man dha ra ba chen po la sogs pa sna tshogs pa rgyan gyi khyad par/ dang / dpag bsam gzhan yang rgyan gyi khyad par/ gyi shing drung du phyin na rang gi gzugs brnyan 'byung ba/ rnams kyis mdzes par byas shing / gzhal yas khang gi rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dkon brtsegs nas bkod pa lta bu/ bya rnam pa sna tshogs dam pa'i chos kyi skad 'byin pa/ rdza rnga dang / cang te'u dang / ker cha lang / ko 'khar rnga/ dang / gling bu dang / rnga bo che dra ba can/ la sogs pa'i sgra grag pa brgya byin dang rtsa sum gtso bo pa'i 'dod khams kyi/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha dang / lha'i bu mo sna tshogs rnam par rtse ba/ mdzes par byas pa'i don/ rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzhugs pas/ kyi brten pas rten/ byin gyis brlabs pa gnas brtag bzhugs te/ zhes pas bstan/ drug pa gnas dang 'khor dang ston pa'i che bas bzhugs pa la gnyis/ 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /dang po 'jig rten ni/ 'khor bstan/ brgya byin dang 'dul ba dang nyan pa gnyis ka'i 'khor yin pas dus thams cad du ston pa'i drung na bzhugs pas nye ba'i 'khor yin pas sngon la smos so/ /tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha dang /

lha'i khongs su 'du ba'i/ rig rten mi lus la bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin pa yin la/ rang lha gang yin pa'i rten la bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin gyis thob pa ni 'das pa'i sngags te sngags kyi nus pas tha mal gyi lus las lha'i lus su gyur te sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro nus tshe bskal pa nas bskal par thub 'jig rten pa'i longs spyod phyir thams cad zer la longs spyod nus pa'o/ /de la rigs sngags 'chang grub pa zhes gdugs dkar nas bshad/ 'dzin nye ba'i don gyi/ dang / lha'i bu mo 'khor bye ba nyis brgya nas bgrangs pa'i/ phrag khrig brgya grangs kyi gnas gzhan brgyad pa/ stong phrag du ma dang / gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po dang / srin po lang ka mgrin bcu dang / lha ma yin thags bzang ris dang / dri za zur phud lnga pa dang / mi'am ci ste se gang na/ mi'am ci'am ljon par rta mgo lto phye chen ri rab kyi khog na gnas pa'i sa bdag phag po sbrul mgo bdun pa dang klu dga' bo la sogs pa'i 'khor du ma 'di rnams sngon la 'ong ba nye ba'i 'khor yin pas so/ /dang / zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa 'jig rten las 'das pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bye ba shes rab snying rje'i bdag nyid khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad la 'di lta ste/ byang chub par dgongs shing sems dpa' sems dpa' thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas zad pa mi skye bar shes rab dang snying rje'i bdag nyid gsum/ chen po spro ba chen pos sems can gyi don la blo gros tshad med pa dang / blo gros mi g.yo ba ri bo la sogs pa dang / blo gros yangs pa dang / kun tu blo gros dang / blo gros mtha' yas dang / blo gros ka ma la dang / blo gros chen po dang / blo gros lha rdzas dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po blo gros shes rab chen po'i sgo nas/

sna tshogs la sogs pa 'dul ba'i 'khor min/ nyan pa'i 'khor yin pas res yod/ res med pas nye ba'i 'khor min pas phyis smos pa'o/ /phyir de rnams de nyid 'dus pa'i phyag na rdo rje sogs sbyar nas de dang de yin zer te de min no/ /'di bshad pa'i ming gi mi phan yin bya ba med/ mi ldog sa brgyad pa'i sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes thob pa sa dang po'i byang sems sngar thob pa'i byin rlabs kyi phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i dge 'dun so so skye bo yin/ mthar grangs brjod kyis mi lang pa'am yang na de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan/ thug pa med pa rnams kyis ston pa shākya thub pa/ bsti stang du byed/ bsnyen bkur/ bla mar byed/ ston pa shākya thub pa/ mchod par byed cing brjod la rab tu spel te/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan/ 'khor mang po'i dbus na/ tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa bh+ram̐ na grol zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa gleng slong ba la gnyis/ ston pas bslangs pa dang / 'khor gyis bslangs ba'o/ /dang po ston pas bslangs pa la drug ste/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs pa/ thabs 'od zer gyi spro bsdu/ 'bras bu ngan song las grol bar bstan pa/ mchod pa sngon du song bas ched du brjod pa/ brgya byin la sogs pas ngo mtshar ba bstan pa'o/ /dang po rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa ni/ tshangs tshad med bzhi ldan/ pa dag pa'i don/ chen po shes rab mtshon cha chos dbyings rtogs pa'i/ pad+ma'i gdan 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos mtshon la shākya thub pa bzhugs te/ ngan bud+dha'i ye shes gdan du snang bas so/ /song gi rgyud rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i sdug bsngal dang 'brel ba'i shes pa'i brang chags thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs te zer/

nas smin mtshams kyi 'od zer spro ba dang bsdu bas rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i ngan song sngon dngos su ma 'ong pas nyams su len na yang dkyil 'khor gang bsgom gyi gtso bo'i ting nge 'dzin 'di la 'jug dgos so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa thabs 'od zer gyi spro bsdu ni/ ngan song gsum gyi rgyud las rnam par grol ba thar pa zhes bya ba/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ming / byang chub sems dpa' shes rab chen po'i sgo nas sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin zhes ming btags nas bstan pa/ 'od stong gsum du/ 'phro ba dang / slar gnas su/ sdud pa mang po'i 'phreng ba bar ma chad pa nyid shākya thub kyi dpral ba'i gnas mdzod spu nas phyung nas/ des 'od zer stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'od zer gyi yul 'di dag thams cad kun tu snang bar byas so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa 'bras bu ngan song las grol bar bstan pa ni/ ma lus pa/ kun tu snang ba byas pas sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems 'od kyi byed las kyi nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las sdug bsngal ba'i mtshams sbyor rnam par grol te/ lus dang sems kyi zad med kyi/ bde ba so sor thob nas/ ston pa'i bzhugs gnas byang nges/ dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu snang bar byas te/ zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa mchod pa sngon du song bas ched du brjod pa ni/ 'od zer 'phros pa'i byin rlabs kyis brgya byin la sogs pa'i lo ka ba dang sngar nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol ba'i sems can thams cad kyis me tog la sogs/ mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs kyi mngon par mchod de/ gus pas/ lan brgya phrag stong du mar bskor ba byas/ mgo bos lan brgya phrag stong du mar gus pa'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das shāka thub kyi spyan sngar mdun gyi phyogs de nyid la bya ba bsam pa rdzogs pa dang nyon mongs pa'i dri ma med pas/

nor bu dri ma med pa'i steng du 'khod de/ 'di skad chos mthun pa'i gnas la yang ming de ru btags/ bsdu pa po'i mtshams sbyor/ ces gsol to/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas ngo mtshar chos sku rtogs pa mthar thug de la brten nas sa bcu rtogs pa/ e sangs rgyas/ /e ma ho sangs rgyas mdzad pa sems can gyi don/ legs/ /gang ga dan tshigs phyir legs na ngan song bdag rgyu 'bras kyis bsdus pa/ cag sngar gyi smin mtshams kyi 'od zer gyis sbyangs/ pas legs/ byang chub nyan pa'i skal ba can dang snod rung bar byas pa'o/ /spyod pa nyid la bzhag bkod zer/ /ces pas bstan/ lnga pa brgya byin la sogs pas ngo mtshar bstan pa ni/ de nas lha sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i/ rnams bdag por gyur rgyal por gyur/ kyi dbang po mchod sbyin brgya lhag gcig mig brgya dang ldan pas na brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la lan brgya phrag stong du mar bskor ba byas te/ phyag 'tshal nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes bos nas/ don gang gi slad du/ sangs rgyas thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyi 'od zer kun tu snang bas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po 'di na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi ngan song gi rgyud las rnam par bkrol zhing / rnam par bkrol ba'i shes rab chen po'i stobs kyis skal ldan du byed pa lam la bzhag pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar che'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar che lags so/ /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa bcom ldan 'das kyi ngo mi mtshar bstan pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po zhes bos nas 'di ngo mtshar mi che'o/ /lha'i dbang po ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ni ngo mtshar mi che ba'i rgyu mtshan ste/ sangs rgyas ci'i phyir mi che bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dag cing gtsang bar byed pas na 'phags pa'i ye shes rgyud la bskyed par byed pas na tshad med pa'i bsod nams rgyu dus su drug pa pha rol tu phyin pa/

kyi tshogs yang dag par bsags pa lam dus su sems can gyi don la 'o/ /lha'i dbang po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni tshad med pa'i yon tan dpes nye dgos 'dod 'byung bas na/ bar mtshon pa/ rin po che'i 'byung gnas su 'bras bu'i dus su phan 'dogs par byed pas gyur pa'o/ /lha'i dbang po yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni/ rgyu dus su/ tshad med pa'i thabs shes rab chen po'i sgo nas/ sna tshogs spyod pa'i dus su 'bras bu la/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'o/ /lha'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni shes rab tshad med pa bsags pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das lam dus su sems can gyi don la pha rol tu phyin pa drug gam bcu bzhi rnams kyi spyod pa ni tshad med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi/ 'bras bu'i dus su/ 'dul ba'i skye bo tshad med pa rnams snod skal ldan du gyur par mdzad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni so so skye bo dang dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa dang nyan rang dang sa la gnas pa'i byang sems rnams dang / mi mnyam pa dang / dus gsum gyi ta thā thams cad dang chos dbyings shes pa mnyam pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni/ thabs gang gi sngar bzhin/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i sngar ltar/ rdzu 'phrul lus kyi mthu dang ldan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sngar bzhin/ mi mnyam pa dang sngar mnyam pa'i ra smon lam sbyin pa la sogs pa'i shugs gyi stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /lha'i dbang po gong gi don dgu pa'o/ /de bas na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyu'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa/ snod rgyu yod na/ ji lta ba bzhin du/ sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa dang / thabs gang gi sgo nas ji ltar gsung gi sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa 'dul ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyi don mdzad pa dang /

thugs kyi sgo nas/ mos pa gang dang gang 'dod pa de ru/ ji lta ba bzhin du sems can rnams kyi sngon smon lam gyi stobs kyi don mdzad pa yin par shes par bya'o/ /'di la the tshom dang som nyi dang yid gnyis ma byed cig gang de bzhin gshegs kyis 'dul bar mi 'gyur ba'i gnas ma yin no/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa 'khor gyis gleng bslangs ba la brgyad de/ brgya byin gyis ston pa la spobs pa la skyed cig par gsol ba btab pa dang / nor bu dri ma med pa gang du skye lung bstan du gsol/ zhes zhus pas bcom ldan gyis dus la babs nas nyon cig par gdams pas brgya byin gyis dus la babs par khas blangs pa/ dri ma med pa'i skye brgyud bstan pa/ brgya byin la sogs pa skyo ba skyes te 'gyel ba/ bcom ldan 'das la nor bu dri ma med pa sdug bsngal las thar pa'i thabs zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon cig par bstan pa/ zhus pa dngos so/ /dang po brgya byin gyis ston pa la spobs pa skyed cig par gsol ba btab pa ni/ de nas ston pas gleng bslangs pa'i rjes de la/ sum bcu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin rang gi bsod nams grub pa'i stan las langs nas/ yang bcom ldan 'das la lha rdzas me tog la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin sna tshogs pas mchod pa rgya che zhing che bar byas te/ phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom brgya byin gyis ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sems can spyir rigs drug gi rgyu 'bras gnyis/ thams cad la lus dang sems kyi bde ba'i rgyu dang 'phrad par 'dod pa'i/ phan pa nyid du bgyid pa dang / sems can sna tshogs dud par 'gro bas des 'bras bu bsdus pas dud 'gro duḥkha rgyu dang bcas pa dang bral bar 'dod pa dang / thams cad la snying brtse ba nyid du bgyid pa dang / yi dwags la snying rje can du nyid yod dgos la bgyid pa dang /

dmyal ba/ snying brtse ba chen po nyid du bgyid pa dang / bsam pa lo ka dang lo ka las 'das pa'i dngos grub bde ba dang yid bde ba/ thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das bdag blo chen po dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs shig pa'i don spobs pa bskyed par gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa bdag spobs pa bskyed par gsol/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa nor bu dri ma med pa gang du skyes lung bstan du gsol zhes zhus pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das sum cu ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi steng na phyogs bzhir grong khyer brgyad brgyad gnas pas so gnyis dbus na lha'i dbang po'i khang bzang yod pa dang gsum mo/ /rtsa gsum pa'i rigs te 'khor 'di nyid nas/ lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od 'di la kha cig na re brgya byin gyi bu yin zer te de min lha thams cad dang yid mthun par blon po'i gzugs dang ldan pa zhes 'og nas zer/ bshes gnyen gyi stobs kyis sgrib pa dag pas de skad ces bya/ ces bgyi ba zhig shi 'phos te dus las 'das te/ dgung bdun la la lha'i/ la la dmyal ba'i zer te/ mi'i yin par tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas shes/ dmyal ba dang lha'i zhag tu byas na sangs rgyas dgung lo brgyad cu las mi bzhugs pas de gong du mya ngan las 'das pas mi 'thad mi la bya lon lags na/ bcom ldan 'das de bstan du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pa lung bstan du gsol/ zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa bcom ldan 'das kyis dus la bab na nyon cig par gdams pas brgya byin gyis dus la babs par khas blangs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po ci ste/ dus la babs par shes na nyon cig lha'i dbang pos gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'di ni brgya byin phan sems skyes pa'i skyo ba skyes pa bde ba'i dregs pa bzhi ba yi gsum dgos pa las 'dir tshangs pa'i dus la babs lags so/

/bde bar gshegs pa 'di mchod dang dus la babs lags so/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa dri ma med pa'i skye rgyud bstan pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po lha'i bu nor bu dri med pa'i 'od ces bya ba de/ 'di nas shi 'phos nas sdug bsngal na bar mtshams med sems can zer pa'i skyabs med pa dang smad pas na/ dmyal ba chen por skyes te/ des der gnas der/ lo stong mi'i phan par kun la shes par bya/ phrag bcu gnyis kyi bar du sdug bsngal ma rungs shing mi zad pa myong nas/ sems can dmyal ba chung ngu rnams su yang lo brgya phrag brgyar sdug bsngal myong ngo / / khri phrag gcig zer/ byol song dang zas skom yid la btags pa'i don gyi na tshim pa med pas na/ yi dwags kyi skye gnas su yang brgya phrag brgyar sdug bsngal myong nas/ /de nas mi khom pa'i gnas brgyad kyi ya gcig mtha' 'khob kyi mir skyes nas kyang / 'on pa dang / dig pa dang / lkugs pa'i rang bzhin can dang / smra ba mi gsal ba lo drug khri bzhi stong / stong phrag drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bar du myong nas/ lo brgyad khri bzhi stong / stong phrag brgya bcu rtsa bzhi'i bar du nad khrag 'dzag pa dang / mdze dang / phol mig rnams kyis gzir ba/ skye bo mang pos smad pa yongs kyis spangs pa/ rigs dman pa'i rigs can rjes su myong zhing sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal brgyud pa dang / gzhan dag la gnod la ma nad med/ par byed pa dang / las mtshams med lnga nye ba lnga la kun tu bshad/ kyi sgrib bar chad med pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / gzhan yang sdug bsngal gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa myong zhing myong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa brgya byin la sogs pa skyo ba skyes te 'gyel ba ni/ de nas brgya byin la sogs pa lha'i bu thams cad kyis thos nas/ lus shin tu dngangs shing sems skrag ste/

lha'i 'dod yon la skyo nas kha sbub tu 'gyel bar gyur to/ /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa bcom ldan 'das la nor bu dri ma med sdug bsngal las thar ba'i thabs zhus pa ni/ de nas yang langs nas/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /sdug bsngal chen po brgyud pa 'di las/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar thar bar 'gyur/ bde bar gshegs pa ji ltar thar bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ci nas kyang / sdug bsngal gyi phung po 'di las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ba 'di skyabs su gsol/ sdug bsngal las/ bde bar gshegs pa 'di sdug bsngal bas skyabs su gsol/ par zer/ zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon cig par bstan pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po sngar gyi sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis kyang bshad pa 'di ngas kyang bshad kyi nyon cig ces pas bstan/ brgyad pa zhus pa dngos la gnyis/ brgya byin gyis zhus pa dang tshangs pa la sogs pas zhus pa'o/ /dang po brgya byin gyis zhus pa ni/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis yang bcom ldan 'das la me tog man dha ra ba/ me tog man+dha ra ba chen po dang / me tog rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang / phyag gdub dang / dpung rgyan dang / snyan cha dang / do shal dang / se mo do rkang gdub dang mgul/ la sogs pa brgyan gyis khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs kyis mngon par mchod de/ lan brgya phrag stong du mar bskor ba byas shing / phyag 'tshal te zer nas/ legs so/ /bcom ldan 'das lha rnams kyi don du legs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa mi rnams kyi don du legs so/ /zhes bya bas mnyes par byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten klu la sogs pa'i 'jig rten pa/ la phan pa dang / bde bar bgyi ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams ngan song gi rgyud gsum las rnam par thar pa bgyi ba'i ces zer slad du/

legs par bshad du gsol/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa tshangs pa la sogs pas zhus pa ni/ de nas yang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /legs so bcom ldan 'das legs so/ /bde bar gshegs pa legs so/ /ci nas kyang ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyis rgyud 'di'i mtshan tsam thos pas kyang ngan song gsum gyi lam las rnam par grol te bde 'gro lha'i 'jig rten nas mi'i 'jig rten du skyes nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par bgyi ba'i slad du bshad du gsol/ ces pas bstan/ gsum pa rgyud kyi gzhung dngos la gnyis te/ ston pas 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa dang / rgyud dngos so/ /dang po ston pas 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ de nas gsol ba btab pa'i rjes la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gleng gzhi bstan la brgya byin bsdu pa po dga' ba'i tshal du ston pa dang brgya byin la sogs pa mthong ba dang / tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i bu de dag mngon sum du mdzad pa de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes lnga ldan/ thams cad kyis thugs bskul ba'i don gyi bcud dwangs mar gyur pa'i don gyi na snying po 'dis ye shes lnga ldan byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir/ gdon don yod zer/ mi za ba'i 'bras bu dang bcas pa rdo rje'i stong nyid/ skal ldan du byin gyis brlabs pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig pa la mi dmigs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i shugs kyis snyoms par bzhugs so/ /de nas yang thugs ka nas sngags 'di phyung nas/ lha de dag dam tshig can du byin gyis brlabs so/ /oṃ bkra shis/ badz+ra a dhi byin rlabs/ tiṣ+ṭha brtan par byed pa/ dzñā na ye shes/ dam tshig las mi 'da' ba sa ma ye hūm̐/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas kyang thogs pa med par gdon mi za bar mi tshom pa'i yang na bar chad byed pa'i don/

rdo rje'i byin gyis rlabs kyi sngags 'di'i nus pas bdud la sogs pa'i stobs chen po'i nus pa 'joms pa/ byin gyi brlabs nas/ mi dmigs pa'i thugs rjes snod ldan du/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyud dngos la gnyis/ shākya thub pas gsungs pa/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag na rdo rje'i zhal nas gsungs pa brtag pa phyi ma'o/ /dang po shākya thub pas gsungs pa kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la drug ste/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa/ nang gi dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro bas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba/ ras bris la brten pa'i dngos grub/ tshe 'das kyi sdig pa sbyang ba'i thabs kyi bye brag bstan pa/ nor bu dri ma med pa ngan song 'thon pa phan yon dang bcas pa bstan pa/ rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa la gnyis/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba dngos dang / phan yon no/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba dngos ni/ ngan song sdig pa thams cad yongs su sbyong ba la mnga' brnyes pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po thugs bskul ba/ 'di shāka thub rang gi snying kha thugs la gnas pa zhal nas phyung ngo / /oṃ ro'am rang gi lus la byin gyis brlabs pa'i dus su dpral ba mdzod spu des 'dre'o/ /sho dha ne sho dha ne/ sarba pā paṃ sdig pa thams cad/ kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi zlos sngags/ bi sho dha ni/ rnam par sbyangs/ shud dhe dag pa/ bi shud+dhe rnam par dag pa dag pa/ sarba thams cad/ karma las/ a wa ra ṇa sgrib pa/ bi shud+dhe swāhā/ rig pa chen po 'di bshad ma thag tu/ sbyong rgyu yod pa'i/ sems can thams cad kyi ngan song gi rgyud kyi 'ching ba thams cad rnam par chad do/

/ngan song 'gro zer/ thams cad sbyangs so/ /sdug bsngal rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'o/ /mi zad pa rnams rab tu zhi ste/ skye bo mang po rnams lus sems kyi bde ba dang ldan par gyur to/ /de nas gzhan yang gsang ba'i snying po 'di zhal nas gsungs so/ /oṃ rin chen me tog sho dha ni sho dhi ni/ rna ba g.yas pa/ sarba a pa ya/ sarba a pa ya/ sarba satwa bh+ya hūm̐/ lha'i dbang po gzhan yang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ shāka thub/ sarba a pa sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ rna ba g.yon pa/ lha'i dbang po gzhan yang 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snying po dang nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ tra tha me tog cher rgyas/ mgo bo'i gtsug phud/ lha'i dbang po gzhan yang 'di ni ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i snying po'o/ /hūm̐ sbyong ba'i rgyal po dpung pa g.yas/ lnga po de bsnyen pa'i dus su bzlos pa'i sngags/ lha'i dbang po gzhan yang 'jig rten 'di rnams grangs/ mdor na dran pa sngags tsam gyis kyang / dag cing gtsang bar byed pa dang 'phags lam rgyud la skye bar byed pas na bsod nams chung ba'i sems can rnams ngan song gi rgyud thams cad las/ bde blag tu dka' thub la sogs pa med par/ rnam par grol bar gyur pa ni 'di yin no/ /na mo phyag dpung pa g.yon/ bha ga wa te bcom ldan 'das/ sarba thams cad/ durga ti ngan song / pa ri sho dha ni yongs su sbyong ba/ rā dzā ya/ rgyal po/ ta thā ga ta ya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i/ ar ha te/ dgra bcom pa/ samyaka sam̐ bud+dhā ya/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ tad+ya tha/ 'di lta ste/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni/ 'di man sngags/ sarba pa pam̐ bhi sho dha ni/ 'di bsnyen pa sogs kun la dgos/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi shud+dhe swāhā/

rtsa ba'i 'jig rten pa dang 'das pa gnyis ka'i dus su lha cig lam du byed pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi tshogs tsakra gnyis ka la dgos/ rig pa'o/ /oṃ snang gong / sarba bid sku mdog sarba lha bskyed pa dang dkyil 'khor 'god pa'i sngags/ ā wa ra na/ bi sho dha ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ bid hūm̐/ sked pa/ oṃ sarba bid pus mo g.yas/ phaṭ rin chen/ oṃ shāka thub/ sarba bid a pus mo g.yon/ oṃ bol g.yas/ sarba bid me tog cher rgyas/ tra thā/ lnga po 'di sked pa dang 'god pa'o/ /oṃ tsakras mtshan pa bum pa sarba bid oṃ kun rig bol g.yon/ oṃ shāka thub/ sarba bid swo/ pad+mas mtshan pa'i bum pa long bu g.yas/ oṃ sarba bid rin chen me tog a dad nas/ oṃ sna rtse/ sarba bid sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ hūm̐ rdo rje/ oṃ ral gri sarba bid tra tha/ mig g.yas/ me tog cher rgyas/ oṃ mig g.yon/ shaḥ stong par bsgom/ oṃ gsang gnas/ bha 'byung ba rim brtsegs bsgom pa'i sngags zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa phan yon la gnyis/ sngags thos pa la sogs pa'i phan yon dang / sngags dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po sngags thos pa la sogs pa'i phan yon ni/ lha'i dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid mdzod sku'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng bas 'phro ba dang bsdud pa'i 'phreng bas rnam pa can/ kyi rgyal po'i mnga' 'byor mdzes shing 'bar ba gsang ba'i snying po 'di gong gi bco brgyad po ni rigs kyi bu'am sems bskyed byas pa'i rigs kyi bu mo gang yang rung bas ming tsam mnyan tam/ bcangs sam/ bklags sam/ bris nas kyang / mgo bo'am/ gtsug phud dam/ dpung pa'am/

mgul du btags te bcangs nas/ tshe 'di nyid la dus ma yin par 'chi ba me chu dag la sogs pa brgyad dang 'brel ba'i rmi lam na bltas pa na gyi rnam pa'am/ ngan song dang 'brel ba'i mtshan ma de dag thams cad rmi lam du yang mi 'byung na/ dkyil 'khor du kun rig sogs bcu gnyis su/ ji lta ba bzhin du bzhugs la dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis por zhugs nas kyang dbang bskur nas snying po yang bzlas brjod byed cing / sngags kyi don yang bsgom pa gang yin pa lta smos kyang ci dgos te/ de dag la ni sdig pa gang yang nye bar mi 'gyur na/ ngan song du yang nye bar 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa sngags dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa'i phan yon ni/ skyes pa'am/ bud med dam/ rang shi ba/ lha ru skyes pa'am/ klu'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ srin po'am/ byol song ngam/ yi dwags sam/ sems can dmyal ba ra skyes pa la sogs pa shi ba te/ gang rung ba shi ba'i lus med cing / dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis gang rung / por/ du bcug ste dbang bskur na/ de sems can dmyal bar skyes na yang de ma thag tu rnam par thar nas lha'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der skyes nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos nyid mngon du byed sa dang po yan chad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la lus kyis/ bsnyen bkur la sogs mchod pa yang byed/ phyir ngan song gsum khams gsum 'khor ba/ theg pa dman par mi ldog par 'gyur rgyud theg pa chen po'i rgyud nges pa can du yang 'gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su yang nges par snod du rung bar skye/ nyon mongs pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa rnams rab tu spangs nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs sam lha'i rigs sam/ gzhan gang yang rung bar lus kyi bde ba myong bar 'gyur ro/

/lha'i dbang po mdor na/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phan pa dang / bde ba thams cad myong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa nang gi dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro ba'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la gsum/ brgya byin gyis bshad par gsol ba btab pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa'i don du ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa/ bshad pa dngos so/ /dang po brgya byin gyis bshad par gsol ba btab pa ni/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la lus ngag la thogs pa med pa yin pas/ bskor ba lan brgya phrag stong du mar tshegs med par byas te/ phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ngan song thams cad kyi dbang du gyur pa rnams la thugs rje chen pos ngan song la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal las sgrol bas/ phan pa dang / lus sems bde bar bgyid pa dang / ci nas kyang sems can de dag ngan song thams cad la rgyab kyis phyogs par bgyi ba dang / bla na ma mchis pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i dka' thub dang dka' spyad la mi ltos par byang chub bde blag tu rtogs par dgos pa khyad par can bgyi ba'i slad du bshad du gsol/ rje cig bshad du gsol zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa'i don du ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa ni/ de nas sngar gling bzhi pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i ston pa bcom ldan shākya thub yin par 'dis shes pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byed pa po ngo bo nyid yin pas bya ba'i chos sems can thams cad ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i chos dbyings shes pa/ ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byed pa po ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di gsungs so/

/zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa bshad pa dngos la gnyis/ nang gi dkyil 'khor dang / phyi'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dang po nang gi dkyil 'khor ni/ sangs rgyas bsgom pa'i nang gi dkyil 'khor bri ba phyi'i dkyil 'khor min te bri ba ngos gsal bar bshad/ kun gyi byang chub sems/ / don dam byang chub sems ni chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba dmigs pa med pa yin te/ dbu ma las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub pa/ /bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi /stong pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs shing / /rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed/ /ces so/ /kun rdzob la gnyis/ smon pa dang 'jug pa'o/ /dang po ni sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni lam la 'jug pa ste/ bsnyen pa nas brtsams te rgyud 'di nas 'byung ba'i rang don dang gzhan don la 'jug pa'o/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor snying po'o zhes bya'o/ /bla na med pa dmigs pa'i thugs rje chen po sgrib pa med pa'i ye shes de nyid gong na med pa phul du byung ba'o/ /rtogs 'gyur bsgom pa shugs la bstan/ ba'i/ / thugs su chud pa'i/ rgyal ba shākya thub pa 'das pas/ gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stong pa nyid kyi/ ye shes gang / /de dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po byang chub kyi sems de nyid kyi bcud dam dwangs mar gyur pa dang ces par 'gyur ba'i don gyis so/ /ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs/ 'dir bsnyen pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor la sogs pa mngon rtogs kyi tho sgrig ste bshad/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa phyi'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis/ bsdu pa po'i mtshams sbyar dang / gzhung ngo / /dang po bsdu pa po'i mtshams sbyar ni/ de nas bsdu pa po'i mtshams sbyor/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyi sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba'i slad du phyi'i dkyil 'khor 'di la ltos nas nang gi dkyil 'khor gong gi yin par gsal/
