gsungs so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa gzhung la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po slob dpon gyi las la drug dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gnas/ sa'i cho ga thig btab ste bri ba/ lha dgod pa/ mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa/ zhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gnas ni/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la bzhugs pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i gnas gtsug lag khang dang skyed mos tshal/ dbus na yang shing yod pa mtha' ma na shing gis bskor ba/ /mchod rten lha khang kun dga' sogs/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa sa'i cho ga ni/ gsang ba spyi rgyud nas bshad pa'i ji bzhin pa yi cho ga gzhan las gsungs pa 'dir cho ga'i tho sgrig yis/ /gnas 'di la brten pa sa chog ni byin gyis rlabs pa tsam/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa thig btab ste bri ba la gnyis/ mdor dang / rgyas pa'o/ /dang po mdo ni/ byin gyis rlabs kha'u pa ston gzhung na med kyang shugs 'byung mdzad/ gnyal pa gzhung bzhin ston med pa byed/ pa'i gnas der ni/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas pa ni/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs bzhi dang yang dag ldan/ /them khyams kyi stegs la skas bzhi yi 'phreng ba can/ /seng ge sgo 'grul du/ ba glang chen g.yon rnams kyis brgyan/ /dar dang dra ba dang dra phyed lda ldi do shal 'phreng / /dril bu dang ni rnga yab brgyan/ /shar rdo rje sgo steng du 'bri gsungs te steng gi pad+ma la/ lho rin chen nub pad+ma dang / byang /rgya gram yang sgo bzhi la mtshan ma bstan pa yi phyag rgyas brgyan/ /srad bu 'og tu sbyar brgyad dang yang dag ldan/ /phyi yi sgo khyud rnams kyis brgyan/ /dgu yi gnyal pa tshang gis ngos re la gcod byed dgu dgu ste/ char kha'u pa spyir cha chen bcu drug spyi dang 'dra ba las nang thig bzhi btab pa ling tshe dgu ni bgos pa la/

/ cha chen/ sgo dang sgo khyud kha'u pa'i bzhin gsum char dgu char bya zer gnyal pa/ bya/ /rdo rje srad bus thig gdab bo/ /dbus kyi dkyil 'khor thig zlum po gdab pa/ /chos kyi 'khor lo zlum po 'dra ba la/ /lte ba tsakrar bcas shing rtsibs phyogs bzhir bzhi bzhi bcu drug /rim pa gtso bo rigs bzhi yum bzhi skal bzang gsum byang sems kun rig sbyong ba'i dang ldan pa la/ /rtsibs ni gnyis 'gyur rgyal po sems dpa' bcu drug lha rnams byed na dbus kyi rim pa gnyis sdom tsam gcig rtsibs la yod pa nyis 'gyur nyid du bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa lha dgod pa ni/ dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni/ /dung dang kun+da zla 'dra la/ /zhal bzhi pa la rdo rje yis/ /seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa dang / /ting 'dzin phyag rgya mnyam bzhag ldan pa dang / /rgyan dbu rgyan sogs rnams kun gyis brgyan par bri/ /de yi spyin sngar ngan song shar kun/ /sbyong ba'i rgyal po gdan dang gzhal ma gtogs kun rig 'dra bri bar bya/ /phyag gnyis ting 'dzin tshul du bsnol/ /zla ba dkar rgyas dang ba mo'i mdog /rgyan rnams kun gyis legs rdzogs la/ /rgyal mchog sbyong ba'i rgyal po ming gnyis pa skyes bu gang ba bri/ /nub rgyab tu shākya ri dbang ser po chos 'chad kyis bzhugs pa po/ /gtso bo thub pa bri bar bya/ /kun rig g.yon byang dang lho g.yas kyi phyogs char ni/ /lho/ rgyal mchog sku mdog sngon po g.yas mchog sbyin rin chen byang me tog cher rgyas/ ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin g.yon mnyam bzhag dkar mo 'khor lo 'dzin pa lte ba la mig 'bras gnyis/ /me mtshams nas lo tsā na dang ma ma ki sngon mo/ /de bzhin dmar mo/ dkar ljang khu/ mo pad+ma 'dzin pa/

sgrol ma ut+pal rnams/ / de rnams shar lho nas g.yas skor du dgod/ rang gi rigs kyi spyan rdo rje pad+ma ut+pal/ mtshan ma bzhin/ de dag gi sngags mu dra bzhon nas ston/ /grwa yi tsakra nang gi me mtshams nas brtsams te/ phyogs snur pa sgo sbrag tu 'od zer mi gsal/ kha'u pa sgo rkyang du 'dod pas de la lag len byed/ ni kun tu bri/ /rtsibs kyi nang du thams cad du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' sngags dang phyag rgya 'og nas ston/ mchog /rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams/ /go rim bcu drug bri bar bya sems dpa' bcu drug phyi nang gi lha mo brgyad sgo ba dang ni de nyid 'dus pa bzhin du dgod par bya'o/ /bzhin du bri bar bya/ /mkhas pas la s+ya la sogs pa/ /mchod pa grwa yi phyogs su bri/ /sgo lho phyogs su 'chi bdag nag po ma he la bzhon pa dbyug pa thogs gzhan na med pa yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /sgo ba kro dha bzhi po bri bar bya/ / sngags dang mu dra shāka thub kyi skabs nas ston te/ rta babs khyams ni thams cad du/ lha rnams/ /byams pa la sems dpa' bcu drug rdo rje 'byung ba ltar dgod par bya'o/ /sogs bri bar bya/ /nyan thos bcu drug rgyal ba thams cad dang / /de bzhin 'di dag gi ming phyag mtshan gzhan na bris yod/ rang rgyal gtso bo bcu gnyis yin la bcu drug tu 'dod pa'ang yod/ rnams/ /dbus/ khro bo lo ka gsum snang sogs brgyad/ ma ḍa g.yas/ pho nya sogs/ g.yon bran bzhin rgyab tu bri/ /bri bya sngags dang mu dra dkyil 'khor tha ma nas ston pas der blta'o/ /yang na ming yang rung / /phyi yi dkyil 'khor phyi rol tu/ zlum por bskor ba la/ /gling bzhi po ni bri bar bya/ /'dzam bu'i gling du chung ma tshang ma dang dbyangs can gnyis 'khor tshangs pa brgyad/

tshangs pa dang / /byang phyogs su ni dbang phyug mdung rtse thogs pa 'khor chung ma brgyad/ dbang phyug che/ / u ma sngo/ gha gha dkar/ ya ma na ljang / dpal mo gser/ 'jigs byed ma dkar/ rdzong gi lha mo dmar/ stobs bzang ma dkar/ ku ma ri dmar skya/ ci bde ba'i lag cha 'dzin pa'o/ /shar dang nub kyi gling du ni/ /brgya byin rtogs 'dod ser po rdo rje 'dzin sha rtsi dang / thig le mchog gnyis dkar/ thams cad kyang / khyab 'jug sngo/ btsun mo nor rgyun dang dbyangs can gnyis dkar ser/ /'khor dang bcas pa bri bar bya/ /gzhan dag gong gi tshangs pa la sogs 'khor dang bcas pa kyang ni de bzhin te/ /lha min thag bzang ris sngon mo 'khor dang bcas pa nub phyogs su/ dri za shar phyogs su ljang khu ste/ zur phud lnga pa chung ma gnyis pho nya gnyis dang bzhi/ nam mkha' lding / / byang stod du gser mig chung ma dang bcas pa phyag bzhi g.yas na gan+ḍe dang bgrang 'phreng g.yon pad+ma mchog sbyin/ gnod sbyin nub tu klu rgyal po sbrul mgo bdun pa dang mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can/ srin po lto phye che/ /'byung po byang shar du dbang phyug dkar po glang la zhon pa yi dwags 'dre rnams dang / / de nyid kyi gtso bo re ma ti bris/ klu dang nub phyogs su klu chen po brgyad bri phyag mtshan 'og tu shes/ grul bum rlig po che pho mo dang bcas pa nag po/ ri yi lha rnams ser/ rnams dang / /rgyal po bzhi rnams phyogs bzhir 'og nas/ bri rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs bzhin bya zhing / /gza' brgyad dang skar ma rgyu skar nyer brgyad phyogs rer bdun bdun de dag gi sku mdog la sogs pa 'og gi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs su ston/ dang / shar du gnod sbyin gyi bdag po sngo skya/ khro bo ma rung 'tshe ba dang /

/bgegs ni nub tu sprin gyi sgrol ma dmar po de bzhin rdo rje rtse gsum sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o byi na ya ka rnams/ /sems can kun la phan byed pa'i/ /drang srong rgyas pa dang gar ldan gyi bu la sogs pa ci rigs par bya ste sku mdog dang lag cha nges pa med/ skal po chen po rnams/ /phra men ma dang gau ri dang tsau ri ma taṃ gi la sogs la khog lag cha nges pa med pas brgyad la sogs pa ci rigs pa bri/ bud med tsa mun ḍi dang ri'u ma ti la sogs pa gzhung tha dad nas 'byung ba bzhin bri bar bya/ bri/ /de bzhin phag mo dkar/ sring mo nag mo/ gnod pa thogs pa/ thod pa 'dzin pa/ be con mtshan mo/ nag mo gzhag ma/ dgra satwa gnod sbyin nag mo che ba'o/ /'dod pa nag mo phag mo dkar mo/ sring mo de dag gi rtsar ming po gnyis yang bri ste rgyal bar byed pa ljang khu/ dril bu 'dzin pa/ sbrang rtsir byed pa dkar po/ lcags kyu 'dzin/ don kun 'grub pa dkar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma/ /'byung ba chen po'i lha chen po/ sa'i lha mo ser mo bum pa 'dzin/ chu lha dkar po zhags pa 'dzin/ me lha dmar po ra la bzhon/ rlung lha ljang khu sha ba la bzhon/ /khyim khyim gyi lha yin no zhes bsdus pa'o/ /rgyas par byed na phyugs lha glang zhon dkar lam gyi ba lha rta bzhon khri thogs sngo khyim la brten dmar skya gzugs bri des 'gre dang ri la gnas pa dang / /shing sib la/ shing dang kun dga' shing sib na dmar/ nags tshal sib na ljang la sogs/ /dur khrod ljongs kyi lha chen po la brten pa 'dre nag po/ grong khyer gnas pa grong khyer la brten pa/ rnams/ /ming de rnams kyi dang brda ste tshal bu 'am bri ba'o/ /yang na ni/ /thig le mdzub bu'i rjes lta bu rnams kyang bri bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa ni/

de nas mkhas pas dkyil 'khor la/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan lhab lhub dang / /gdugs dang rnga ma lda ldi dang / /'phan dang sna tshogs na bzas mchod/ /gser las byas pa'i bya ma bum ste gzugs byas pa'i bum pa/ bya rnams ni/ /mchod bum la rtsa rig bzla/ brgyad dam bcu drug lhag mchod bum 'di dag la bum pa med na kham phor sogs kyis btub/ kyang rung / /dbang bskur rin chen chus gang ba'i/ /bum pa lnga ni bzhag gong gi sngags lnga bzlas pa'i/ par bya/ /mar me gtor ma brgyad dam bcu drug bum pa dang / /mdzes pa'i bshos rnams bzhag bya 'gre ste/ /bza' ba btung ba sbyar rtsa rig sngon du 'gro ba'i lha thams cad kyi sngags 'gre legs dang / /bca' ba bza' ba zer/ sna tshogs bzhag par bya/ /gnod sbyin srin po'i kha zas su/ /gtor ma rnams pa sna tshogs bzhag 'gre /'byung po che 'byung po thams cad dang lha dang klu zer/ dang lha dang klu/ /mi min mi min de bzhin te/ /me tog dri rnams sna tshogs dang / /'o ma mar dang ka rar bcas/ /bgegs thams cad la rgyal bas na/ rnam rgyal dri yi chus/ /rab tu bkang ba bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa bzhugs te bsgrub pa bzhi/ slob dpon bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi sgo drung du 'dug pa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te bsgrub pa mchod cing bstod pa/ gtor ma btang ba'o/ /dang po slob dpon bdag nyid kyi sgo drung du 'dug pa ni/ de nas khrus rtsa rig sngon du song ba'i lha thams cad sngags bzlas pas bdag bsrungs nas dbang bskur ba kun rig gi lha'i rnal 'byor can nyid bzhugs zer bas so/ /gtso bo la 'khor los bsgyur ba byed/ dkyil 'khor dpal mchog bzhin te/ mchog 'di'i ston pa yin pas na shāka thub kyi byed pa lugs gcig go /rang 'dod min no/ /la sogs byas la/ dri dang me tog 'phreng ba dang /

/dri zhim kha bkang mchog mdzes pas/ /bde bar 'dug pa nyid la zhugs bdag bskyed bdag bsrung nas dbang bskur lha'i rnal 'byor can nyid zhugs zer/ rdo rje 'dzin ma 'dir kha 'ub pa 'og gi shāka thub kyi skabs nas bshad pa dang bstun nas sgrub mchod byas pa dang 'jug 'o na 'dir bsgrub pa'i gong du rdo rje 'dzin las zhugs zhes pa dang mi 'gal lam zhe na/ da ni dkyil 'khor gyi sgo drung du phyag rgya bcas te 'dug pa tsam la dgongs so/ /des 'gal ba med snur pas bris pa'i rjes de nyid la sgrub pa byas par 'jug zer te/ de la don med pa dang 'og shāka thub kyi skabs nas bshad pa dang 'gal bas mi 'thad/ kha cig na med/ bzhugs nas kyang / /me tog thogs te sgo phyogs 'dug /gnyis pa ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te bsgrub pa ni/ kun rig gtso bo yang na ta thā bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor du gtso bo'i thugs las bskyed pa'i sras nyan thos sku sprul pa rang rgyal/ gsung gi byams/ skal bzang thugs kyi sprul pa yin pas sras kyi khongs su bsdu'o/ /de ltar gtso bo kun rig gi 'khor lo khro bo mngag pa la sogs pa dang lo ka lhag ma thams cad sras sogs phyag rgyas sngon du song bas phyag rgya rnams bstan/ rgyal ba sras de pa bzhi skal bzang nyan rang khro bo mngag pa sogs/ /re re zhing dpag tu med pa kyi 'khor/ /mang po skal bzang nyan rang lo ka rnams ni spyan drangs te/ /rdo rje bsdu ba'i/ phyag rgya sngags dang bdag ldan sgrub pa po ldan zhing / /lcags kyu la sogs rnal 'byor gyis/ / nga rgyal dang ldan pas byed/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥthugs rje'i bdag /tshur gshegs zhes ni brjod nas kyang / /gsang ba rdo rje bsdams pa'i bcing bas bcings nas ni/ /mdzub gnyis lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ /zhags pa bzhin du sbyar nas kyang /

/de nyid lcags sgrog tshul du bya/ /mtheb gnyis nang du bkug nas kyang / /bskyod par gyur na dbang du gyur/ de pa bzhi skal bzang nyan rang khro bo mngag pa sogs/ de nas mtshan ma 'og ras bris kyi skabs nas bstan pa/ skyes nas ye shes pa spyan drangs te bskul ba/ ni/ /thog chos dbyings shes pa'i ye shes pa'i thug mtha' med par mngon sum bsgrub pa po rang gi rgyud la mthong / /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa ni/ ar+gham̐ mchod yon gtso bo'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa de dbul/ mchog sgeg mo la sogs pa brgyad kyi mchod yon sngon 'gro gsum la me tog la sogs pa lnga/ brtag gsang la phyag rgya rnams sngon du song bas phyag rgya rnams bstan/ sogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i/ dbyangs snyan pa yi bstod dang lha rdzas kyi/ / rin chen sna bdun/ mchog gi yang bdag gi dngos po stong par byin gyis brlabs/ dam pa rnams kyis legs par mchod/ /ces pas bstan/ bzhi pa gtor ma btang ba ni/ de nas dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul bum sogs kyis/ 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma bya/ /sems can bkres shing skom kha 'bar las de nas lag pa byin gyis brlabs nas rigs gsum spyi'i sngags/ la btung ba dang / /phyogs legs grub ma'am rig pa mchog las bshad/ kha cig na med/ na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag / dpung bzang las bshad pa shar phyogs rdo rje can sogs/ phyogs skyong gtor ma ste de ltar bzhi/ de yi gtor ma gsum po/ ji ltar 'dir gtor ma gtong thabs ma gsungs pas mdo sde'am rgyud sde gang nas/ mthun par gzhan la bshad pa ltar bya'o/ /bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba la gnyis/

mdo dang / rgyas pa'o/ /dang po mdo ni/ de nas sngags pas slob dpon gyi las rdzogs pa'i rjes la bla med byang chub kyi/ /gnas su slob ma'i mtshan nyid 'og 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor nas bstan pa bzhin no/ /slob ma yongs su smin par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas pa la gnyis/ 'jug pa dang / dbang ngo / /dang po 'jug pa la gsum/ slob ma lhag mar gnas pas sems bskyed pa/ slob ma 'jug pa/ dam tshig bsgrags pa sngon du 'gro bas sdom pa 'bogs pa'o/ /dang po slob ma lhag par gnas pa sems bskyed pa ni/ 'gro la rdo rje 'byung ba sogs dbang gi tshigs bcad brjod/ kha cig na med/ phan phyir myur du byang chub par/ /de dag byang chub sems theg pa spyi dang mthun pa gang gis kyang 'gal ba med gsungs so/ / phyag bzhes shig yod/ mchog bskyed du gzhug /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug pa ni/ de nas byin brlabs rdo rje khu tshur gnyis oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa sogs kyi gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su byin gyis brlab pa/ yang na rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgyas yang na gnas gsum du yang na slob dpon rang rang gi lha'i sngags dang mu dra rnam pa bzhi yang gnas bzhir/ rdo rje 'byung ba nas bshad pa'i bdag gis 'di skad ces brjod pa'i dge ba'am rtsa ba 'dis zhes sogs kha cig na med/ byang chub smon lam gdab/ /rnam snang mngon byang nas 'byung ba'i u dum wa ra'i me tog sogs zab cing rgya che'i chos bsgrags la/ /bsrung ba byas na brtul zhugs sdom pa byin/ /rang gi kha sngar sems bskyed pa slob ma'i rgyud dag pa/ nas sngags bzlas zhugs ku sha sbyin pa des bsrung skud la mdud pa gsum ldan dmar po mngon byang bzhin yang na 'di rang gi me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i sngags 'og nas 'byung / par bya/

/dar la sogs pas mig gnyis g.yogs nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin ma 'di nas mar gyi 'phreng gnyis tsam po 'di slob dpon bdag 'jug tu yang 'di ka bzhed/ dpal gyi lag gnyis bya/ / 'og shāka thub nas ston/ me tog rin chen dkyil 'khor gyi lha la 'thor ba'i/ sogs pas slob ma'i lus de brgyan la/ /bla ma la dbul ba'i yon gyi lag pa bkang ste bzhugs par bya/ /sngags ni 'di rnams yin no/ /mu dra 'ching sngags oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug sngags/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ ye shes dbab sngags/ oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hūm̐ gi rnam pa/ hūm̐/ a sa me tri sa me skye ba med pa'i dam tshig sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐/ dam tshig chen po/ de nas sngags 'og gi 'dis me tog la sogs pa dor bar bya'o/ /sangs rgyas ngag tu yang brjod dngos grub thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag la thugs brtses dgongs nas ni/ /'gro ba yongs la phan phyir dkyil 'khor gyi gtso chen kun rig gyi/ /dman par thugs rje'i sgo nas/ dgongs te bzhes su gsol/ /me tog dor sngags/ oṃ badz+ra pra ti gṛ ha na hūm̐/ mgo la 'ching ba'i sngags/ oṃ pra ti ts+tsha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ me tog rin chen la sogs pa/ /gang la babs pa rigs kyi lha/ /gtso bos rigs kun rig rtsa lha so bdun kun rig las skyes pas de bsgrubs nas ni/ /dngos grub 'gyur te the tshom med/ de nas gdong g.yogs dkrol/ dkyil 'khor bstan pa phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nas bstan pa de yan chad slob dpon bdag 'jug shes par bya/ /ces pas bstan/ gsum pa dam tshig bsgrags pa sngon du 'gro bas sdom pa 'bogs pa ni/ de nas sngags la mkhas pa yi/ /sngags 'di dam tshig slob ma la sbyin par bya/ /slob ma'i rgyud la dam tshig bskyed pa oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/

de nas rigs kyi phyag rgya snying kar bcings te/ dam tshig gi lha snying la gnas par bya ba'i sngags/ slob ma'i snying dam tshig gnas shing brtan pa/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hri da ya me/ pra be sha hri da tiṣ+ṭhi hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas 'dis dam tshig bsgrags par 'og tshigs bcad/ bya'o/ /rnam rgyal bum pa nas chu blug cing 'di brjod/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /gnyis su med pa'i khyor chu byin gyis brlabs pa na/ rdo rje bdud rtsis chu 'dis 'grub/ /slob ma khyod kyis/ ci ste dam tshig 'das na ni/ /de nyams ma thag tu snying bkas nas sngar ye shes dbab pa de gshegs/ /gzhan yang rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas kyang / /kha'u pa mar mar gyi bdun brgyud bu tsha'u la sogs pa byed de 'thad/ bdun brgyud rigs ni snur pa sgrub pa po'i ma gtogs pa mar gyi bdun brgyud de pha mes po yang mes po yang mes dgu mes/ rlag par byed/ /de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis/ /rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig bka' nas brgyud pa'i dam tshig dang / /sdom pa dang ni spang bya spong ba'i gnyen po bla ma'i bka'/ /shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya/ /khyod kyis srog chags gsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /rdzun dang 'dod log la spyod pa rnams/ /dngos grub 'dod pas byas nas dngos grub mi 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas/ bya ba min/ de rnams byas na dngos grub mi 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur/ chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing / /sha tsong la sogs pa ku bag can gyi la sogs pa bza' mi bya/ /sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni/ /nam yang bya ba ma yin te/ /dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spang / /dus kun tu ni byang chub smon 'jug sems/ /snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang /

/rang gi lha dang bla ma de bzhin no/ /sdig la sogs pa gang yin dang / /bla ma'i gong gi srog chags gsad mi bya'o/ /bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /me tog sogs lha la phul ba'i snying ma dang / /de yi grib ma 'gom mi bya/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor du byin brlabs byas nas bkod pa'i gri gug sogs/ gzugs la de bzhin no/ /sngags dang lo ka dang 'das pa'i lha la smad mi bya/ /gdon gyi las rang gi dngos grub la bar chad mi byed na gzhan gyi 'dre rgod gzir ba dang phur bus gdab pa/ sogs bya ba min/ /mu stegs can la dngos grub ring ba'i rgyu smad mi bya/ /mdor na yid gnyis som nyi lha dang sngags dang bsgrub pa gsum la/ mi bya ste/ bdag gi de nyid lha'i rnal 'byor dang ni sngags lha'i de bzhin no/ / yid gnyis sogs mi bya'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ dbang bskur ba dang / rje bla ma mchod pa phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa'o/ /dang po dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma/ mos pa rten dang ldan par sdom pa'i/ dam bcas nas/ /sarba thams cad/ bid rigs pa/ kyi ji bzhin dbang bskur te/ /bum pa bum pa zer cho ga phyag na rdo rje'i skabs nas 'byung ba bzhin myur ba'i don/ la sogs ji snyed mang thogs pas/ /bcu po rnams kyi dbang bcu 'og nas 'byung ba'i cod pan dang gsang ba yan chad ci dgar bskur/ /de nas lag tu dril dang rdo rje sbyin/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang / /'khor lo la sogs rin chen sna bdun thogs la/ /mi dbang bskur ba'i 'bras bu/ dbang phyug 'khor lo thob pa mthong ba'i chos 'di nyid la dang / /sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya zer/ bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rje bla ma la mchod pa phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa ni/ sngags grub phyir na mos pas slob ma la/

/slob dpon/ sngags pas bka' ni bla ma mchod cig par rab tu bsgo bar bya/ /slob ma/ des kyang mos pas spyi bla ma la bos phyag 'tshal te/ /ci ste nor yod bla mar dbul bar bya/ /nor dang gter dang 'bru dang dbyig dang gser/ /bzhon dang khyim bdag bu pho bu mo dang / /skyes pa dang ni bud med yang na ni/ /grong dang grong khyer de ltar ci bzhed rnams/ /rang gi sems can yongs su dad pa yi/ /yon gyi mchog nyid dbul ba nyid du bya/ /dngos grub/ myur du grub phyir mos pas bla ma la/ /mdor na rang gi lus kyang dbul ba nyid du bya/ /tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / /'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang / /sangs rgyas nyid kyang thob 'gyur na/ /lha yi bde ba smos ci dgos/ /slob mas mchod pa'i rten du/ sangs rgyas de tsam phan yon che bar ci ste shes na kun dang bla mar mnyam/ /rdo rje slob dpon brnyas na ni/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob 'gyur bas/ /slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya/ /rdo rje spun dkyil 'khor zhugs dang sring mo dang / /rdo rje ma rnams bla ma'i btsun mo nyid la ni/ /rnal 'byor can gyis brnyas mi bya/ /rtag tu 'khon dang gcugs mi bya/ /dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la/ /bzod pa bsgom par mi bya ste/ /bla ma smon brtson ma rungs dang / /dam tshig 'das pa de bzhin te/ /de sogs chos mi ldan dang sdig spyod dang / /rtag tu sems can gnod sogs la/ /dam tshig ldan rnams snying brtse bas/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni sngags kyis bsad/ byed pa tshar bcad nas/ /'grub 'gyur zhes ni kun rig gsungs/ /sems can kun la snying brtse chags/ /bsgrub na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ ras bris la brten pa'i dngos grub la gnyis/ bsdu pa po'i mtshams sbyor dang / gzhung dngos so/ /dang po bsdu pa po'i mtshams sbyor ni/

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang lha dang bcas pa rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang bde ba bsgrub pa'i cho ga 'di gsungs so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa gzhung dngos la gsum/ rten ras bris bri ba/ rten rdzogs pa la rab tu gnas pa bya ba/ rten bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po rten ras bris bri ba ni/ ras la gtsang ma thag pa la nyes sngags chus sam spos chus bkrus/ ras 'dus par byas pas/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa de bzhin bris la/ kun rig dung dang zla 'dra la/ /zhal bzhi pa la seng ge'i sogs/ /g.yas phyogs su de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ g.yon phyogs su shākya thub pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ g.yon phyogs su shākya thub pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i 'og tu ni/ kun tu spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mdog zla ba lta bu phyag na pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ shākya thub pa'i 'og tu ni byang sems lag pa rdo rje de gnyis kyi bar du kun rig gi 'og tu sman gyi lha mdog sngon po phyag gcig na 'bras bu a ru ra/ phyag gcig ni mchog sbyin du bya/ rta mgrin dmar dang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba sngo nag ma rungs pa 'joms pa la brtson pa gnyis ni rang spyan ras gzigs kyi 'og tu rta mgrin/ gi lha la phyag rdor gyi 'og 'jig rten gsum rgyal/ rten pa bri/ de gnyis kyi dbus su lo tsa na dang 'di bzhin gzhan las chung ba bya/ mā ma ki dang dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa na bza' dkar mo dang sgrol ma ljang rnams rang gi mtshan ma lag tu thogs par bri/ lha bcu gnyis la sman lha ma gtogs thams cad dkar por bya ba lugs gcig go /de dag gi 'og tu bkra shis pa yin pas pad+ma'i rdzing bu las pad+ma skyes pa'i steng du bri chu srin dang /

nya dang / rus sbal dang / sbal pa dkar po dang / nya dkar po la sogs par bcas pa dang / chu las skyes pa'i me tog rnam pa du mas yongs su gang ba bri/ bdug pa de rnams kyi char dang / mar me dang / dri dang / 'phreng ba dang / bshos dang / me tog dang / 'bras bu rnams pa sna tshogs rnams bri/ de'i 'og tu sgrub pa po bdag nyid thal mo sbyar zhing / phyag 'tshal te 'dug par bri/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rten rdzogs pa la rab tu gnas pa bya ba ni/ de nas ri mo'i ye shes pa med pas lnga dang brgyad dang bstod pas/ sku gzugs de mngon par bris pa'i rjes la bdag bsrung nas dbang bskur bar du lha'i rnal 'byor dang mchod pa bsang zhing byin gyis rlabs pa sngon du song nas de rgyam tsar/ mchod de/ bdag nyid spyan pra ti dang rab gnas dbye ba bya zhing / bden pa'i mchod pa dang gtor ma/ bstod pa rdzogs par byas la byin gyis brlab pa bris pa'i lha rnams spyan drangs dgug gzhug byas/ lag pa byin gyis rlabs/ rigs gsum mu dra sngon du song bas mu dra yod pa rnams bstan med pa rigs gsum gyi btub de bya/ dmigs sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang bcas pa sogs brjod pa sogs sngon du song nas bdag la dngos grub stsol cig ras bris 'di la byin gyis rlobs shig par bya'o/ /de nas ci ste mtshan ma zhig mthong na ni myur du dngos grub thob par 'gyur la/ 'on te mtshan ma mthong na ni/ ring mo zhig nas dngos grub tu 'gyur te/ bzhad pa ni dngos grub kyi mtshan ma rab/ rnga sgra 'bring / dang / /dril bu'i sgra dang 'brug tha ma/ de bzhin/ /dge slong 'bring gi rab/ bram ze 'bring gi 'bring / bu mo 'bring gi tha ma/ dang / /'bras bu mthar thug gi phung po mthong na myur du ni/ /mchog sid+dhi'i rtags dang sbyar/ dang bar dang tha ma 'grub/

/de nas ras bris sogs/ gzugs de byin brlabs te/ /sngags dang ji ltar brlab na sgrub po rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas de'i mu dra ras bris la brten pas rang gi lha'i sngags ci nus gcig bzlas/ phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas/ /ci des spyan dbyes 'gyur/ bdog pas ni mchod par ar+gham̐ la sogs pas/ bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa rten bsgrub pa la bzhi/ bsnyen pa/ nye bsnyen/ bsgrub pa/ bsgrub pa chen po'o/ /dang po bsnyen pa ni/ rtag tu mngon sum 'dug nas kyang / /'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag bsrung gnas la sogs byas nas kyang / /bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing / / lha'i rnal 'byor rdzogs par byas thugs kar zla dkyil la rang gi snying po dbus tha mar rtsa rig bkod nas ras bris dmigs yul du bzhag nas mu dra ston cing rtsa sngags sngon du song ba'i rang snying / /rtsa rig 'bum phrag gsum mam yang na drug /dngos grub mtshan ma byung bar du/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa nye bsnyen ni/ des na sngar bas dben pa'i gnas gcig nas yang lus ngag dben par bya/ dben pa'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa/ gnas su ni/ /brgyad brgya brgya rtsa brgyad zer/ nyid du sngar bzlas pa'i sngags dang / tshang bar bya/ /dngos grub ma byung bar du ni/ /sngags ni phra la 'khrul med par ma nor bar/ bzlas/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa bsgrub pa ni/ de nas bsnyen pa rdzogs pa bzlas pa'i mjug tu ni/ /ras bris dkyil 'khor/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin du ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ bsam ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa 'di yin la/ /mchod pa rgya chen byas nas ar+gham̐ mchog rtags sogs kyang / /mtshan gcig thog thag las sbyor lta bu gsungs/ bzla bar bya/ /ci ste gtso bo'i kun rig de yi sras/ sbyong ba'i rgyal po/

/ gtso bo tsakra la ras bris la bris pa/ /yang na lha rnams bstan ma sogs pa'i brgya byin la sogs pa/ mthong gyur na/ /bsod nams snod sgrub pa po las ci dga' bar/ /dngos grub mchog ni stsol bar byed/ /lha yi dngos grub 'bras bu ni/ /de la rtag tu dgyes nas gsol/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni/ sgrub pa chen po la/ phyag 'tshal dngos grub la mchod bstod byas te/ sogs blangs/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum bdag la/ /nor gyi yin pa'i phyir de'i/ skal ba re re phul nas ni/ /de la nas rtag tu ldan la bdag spyod cig /bla ma dkon mchog med na mkhas pa bdag nyid kyis/ slob ma/ /blangs nas yongs su spyad par bya/ /sems can kun la phan brtson pas/ /skal pa du mar gnas par 'gyur/ /ci ste dngos grub ma gyur na/ /las rnams sgrub pa pos phan gdags pa dang tshar bcad pa'o/ /thams cad nus par yang slob ma dbang bskur la sdig pa sbyang ba rnams/ 'gyur/ /gnod sbyin lha rnams kyi gtso bo skar ma'i gdong la dri ma med pa'i gzugs ltar sogs/ lha'i dbang po sde brgyad/ /chad pas bcad cing bka' tsam gyis/ /zhi ba la sa gsum sogs las bzhi kun dang ni/ /bran bzhin las kun byed par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa tshe 'das kyi phyir ngan song gi sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs kyi bye brag bstan pa la bzhi/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' gnang ba/ ngan song gi sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs bshad pa'i gzhung dngos/ de'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la zhus pa ni/ de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sdig pa mi dge ba bgyis pas bgyis pas/

sems can 'bras bu dmyal ba la sogs dbang du 'gyur ba rnams ji ltar na sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i sdug bsngal spangs pa'i slad du bsgrub par bgyi/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bcom ldan 'das kyi bkas gnang ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po nyon dbang bskur phyir bzlog gnyis char byed na phyag len la dang po phyir ldog de nas dbang bskur byed/ spyir sngon la gang byed kyang 'dra ba las sngon ma gtso bas skabs 'dir phyir bzlog gi ngag 'don cung zad sbyar/ kha cig na med/ cig sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems can sdig pa byed pa/ sdig pa chen po byed pa de dag ci nas kyang sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las thabs sla bas grol bar 'gyur ba nyon cig ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ngan song gi sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs bshad pa'i gzhung dngos la dgu ste/ kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba/ dbang bskur te mchod rten dbus su bzhag te sdig pa sbyang ba/ dbang bskur te dri'i gtsang du bzhag pas sdig pa sbyang ba/ bzlas pa bya bas sbyang ba ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba/ rten med pa la sdig pa sbyang ba/ phyir bzlog gis sdig pa sbyang ba'o/ /dang po kun rig gi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba la gnyis/ rten ro yod pa la sbyang ba dang / rten med par gzugs brnyan la dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba'o/ /dang po rten ro yod pa la sbyang ba ni/ de bzhin phan yon 'di 'og ma kun nas shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon gyi las thams cad tshe dang ldan dang tshe 'das 'dra/ bsngo ba man chad tshe ldan la byed pa bzhin tshe 'das kyi rten gnyen 'dun 'dzin du bcug la ngag tu brjod dgos pa rnams kyang gnyen 'dun 'dzin du bcug la ngag tu brjod dgos pa rnams kyang gnyen 'dun gyi brjod cing dngos su rten la bya/

dkyil 'khor bris pa'am ras bris kyi drung du/ nas bsnyen pa mchog thig sngon du song nas lha dang mchod rdzas bkod lha'i rnal 'byor byas nas/ snga ma bzhin du dmigs pa tshe 'das la dmigs te dper na mngon spyod kyi las dngos su/ liṅga dmigs la bsgrub bya la/ la byed pa bzhin/ bum pa la/ mchod bstod dbang bskur ba byas nas brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /dbang bskur bar ni bdag 'jug dang ye shes pa spyan drangs te bsgrub mu dra bstan/ mchod bstod gtor ma sems skyong zer/ bcu dam tshig bsgrag sdom pa dbog bar ni rab tu brtag /de nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te/ /dmyal ba la sogs sdug bsngal las/ /de ni myur du rnam par thar/ /rten de sdig las rnam grol de nyid de/ /dga' ldan sogs bar gyur pa'i lha rnams kyi/ /rigs su skye bar gyur nas kyang / /chos 'gro bar ni thob par 'gyur/ /ngan song gsum du phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas/ /rim gyis byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rten med par gzugs brnyan la dbang bskur te sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ de yi shi ba'i ro med na gzugs brnyan bri ba'am/ /gur gum gyi ni shi ba'i ming byang ming yang bri/ /ngan song gsum gyi 'jig rten las/ /sems can rnams ni grol ba'i phyir/ /brgya byin lta bu/ sngags mkhan gzhan la phan brtson nor bu dri med pa/ zhing / /snying rje can gyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa dbang bskur te mchod rten dbus su bzhag te sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ de nas rnal 'byor can gyis dbang bskur te mchod rten du bcug nas sbyangs/ kha cig na med/ ni/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas de dbang ro la sogs pa'i rten gang yod pa la bskur sngar dang 'dra/ /lha yi gzugs su shi ba de'i ro la sogs dkyil 'khor du bcug brtags nas sngar gyi las khyad can/

kyang / /mchod de nas rten dbus su gzhag par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dbang bskur te gtsang khang du bzhag pas sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ rang dbang bskur nas yi dam lha/ gi lha'am rgyud 'di gson po'am yang na shi ba'i rten dkyil 'khor du bzhag tsa na me tog phog pa'i lha gzhan slob dpon rang dad pa'i lhar bskyed/ gyi/ /snying po snying kar bris nas gzugs brnyan gyis/ kyang / /lha 'dra bar ni sems bskyed de/ /khyim gyi nang du gzhag par sngar las khyad par ro la byed pa dang gzugs brnyan ni ming la byed pa las med do/ /bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa mchod rten bya bas sbyang ba ni/ de yi dbang bskur te mchod rten du bcug nas sbyangs/ ming nas mchod rten btab pas sdig pa sbyangs/ smos nas su/ 'di la kha cig par med/ /gur gum bzang pos sngags bris rtsa rig gam yang na me tog phog pa'i lha de'i rtsa rig sogs gang rung bri/ la/ /rim gyis 'bum ni tshang tsam du/ /mchod rten las ni rab tu bya/ /sdig can sdig ni zad bya'i phyir/ /bye ba 'di mdo tsam smos pa ste rgyas par 'og tu ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba'i skabs nas thal ba dang rus pa'i zhes bya ba nas 'bum phrag gnyis kyi bar du bkod pa ltar nyams su blangs/ 'dir khyad par sngags bris nas 'jug dus med do/ /snyed ni tshang bar bya/ /de ni nges par dmyal gnas na/ /'di byas pas ni grol bar 'gyur/ /yi dwags byol song sdug bsngal las/ /grol nas lha yi gnas su skye/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa bzlas pa bya bas sbyang ba ni/ de yi ming nas brjod nas ni/ /ji ltar rang lha'i rnal 'byor byas la snying kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rtsa rig mtha' bskor du rang gi lha'i sngags dang zhal gsum du skye ba zad par byed pa sngags bkod la de las 'od zer 'phros nas sems can gyi don bya lugs 'og phyag na rdo rje'i skabs bzhin no/

gsungs pa'i rtsa rig gi sbyong ba'i rgyal po'am yang na cho ga mkhan gyi rang lha'i snying po sngags bzlas shing / /'bum phrag stong ngam yang na ni/ /brgya phrag stong du tshang ba dang / /bye ba snyed du rab bzlas na/ /lha yi gnas su bzla bsgom kho na las dbang sogs mi dgos nges par skye/ /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa sbyin sreg bya bas sbyang ba ni/ de yi shes rab ming nas brjod nas sbyin sreg gis sdig pa sbyangs/ kyang / /mkhas pas 'bum phrag brgya'am bye ba'o/ /ni/ /yang na brgya phrag stong snyed du/ grangs sngags la 'dzin/ /sbyin sreg thab rdzas lha sngags 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin/ byas par gyur na ni/ /dmyal ba chen por gyur pa yi/ /sdig pa de las thar bar 'gyur/ /ji srid mtshan mdor bstan rgyas par 'og nas ston/ mar shin tu ni/ /'bar ba'i gnas su skyes gyur pa/ /til dang yungs dkar 'bras rnams dang / /ra yi 'o mar ldan pa dang / /dri yis bskus pa'i yam shing gis/ /cho ga bzhin 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin/ du sbyin sreg bya/ /de nas 'di ni nges par yang / /lha yi gnas su skyes gyur nas/ /de yi mtshan ma ston par byed/ /yang na lha phyir mi ldog pa'i chos dang ldan pa ta thā zhal mthong ba'i bslab pa gzhi bzung ba'i/ mchog tu 'gyur/ /yang na hoṃ khung nang du ni/ / sngon gyi mtshan ma'i nir ti me yi lhas ni ston byed cing / /lha yi gnas su skyes pa dang / /sdig pa bcom pa'i mtshan mar ni/ /dkar po nyid dang g.yas su 'bar/ /gyen du 'bar zhing dri ma med/ /zlum zhing rnam par mi 'phro la/ /brtan la rlung gis me bskyod pa la glog bzhin dri ma med/ /yang na me lha nyid kyi ni/ /bdag nyid me lha de bzhin sngar gyi me lha ston par byed/ /zla ba dri med dkar 'dra la/ /bzhin bzang zer mdog dkar phyag mtshan gzhan dang 'dra

zhing lham mer 'bar/ /de ni me dag gi ni/ dmyal ba la sogs rnams grol zhing / /sdig pa bcom nas bde 'gror ni/ /skye ba yin par shes par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyang ba la brgyad/ thab khung gi dkyil 'khor bri ba/ mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te mchod pa/ rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bsreg rdzas byin gyis brlab pa/ ro byin gyis brlabs te chas su bzhugs pa/ sbyin sreg bya ba'i rim pa dngos/ mchod rten gdab pa/ rtags dang phan yon 'byung bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po thabs khung gi dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ rang rang gi khru bzhi pa yi 'di ras kyi dbang du byas pa'am yang rgya gar na ro nar mor bsreg pa'i lugs yin gyi 'dir khru gang pa nyid do/ /tshad du ni/ /cho ga sa chog sogs bzhin du khung brkos la/ /kha khyer la/ rdo rje tha ma bskor ba yi/ /'khor los rgyas par tshe dpag med kyi zhi ba'i thab khung du blta/ dbus su rdo rje shar du tsakra lhor rat+na nub tu pad+ma byang du rgya gram/ yang na 'khor yug tu tsakra shar gyi dbus su bri/ gzhan bzhi po yang shar du bri/ de bzhin du lnga char tshang bar bri'o/ /dbus su bri bar bya/ /rigs lnga yi ni phyag rgya rnams/ /ji bzhin pa yi phyogs su bri/ /de bzhin lha rnam pa bcu drug sems dpa' rnams 'dir lha rnam gnyis las med/ sgo dang rta babs kyang med pas nyams su len tsa na tshe dpag med dang 'khor los bsgyur ba dang me ltar 'bar ba dang 'di rang dang bzhi sdebs pa la bya'o/ /dang ni/ /'jig rten lo ka ba gtso la sogs pa bri thams cad chu tshon gyis/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa ni/ byang dang bum pa gang ba dang / /gtor mas snod rnams gang ba dag /brgyad snyed tsam du bzhag bya 'am/ /yang na bcu drug snyed du bzhag /bza' ba dang ni bca' ba'i bshos/

/me tog brgyad dam bcu drug 'phreng sogs de bzhin te/ /bla bre rgyal mtshan dar la sogs/ /gdugs mchog rnams kyis legs par brgyan/ /sbyin sreg dkyil 'khor dam par ni/ /sbyin sreg rab tu bya ba sbyin/ /cho ga shes pas bris nas kyang / /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs te mchod pa ni/ lha rnams mang po spyan drangs la/ /sngags shes pas rtsa rig gi sbyong ba'i rgyal po rang gi lha'i gsur rtsa rig po rgyud 'di'i lha gang rung gi sems dpa' sogs kun 'gre ni sngags phyag rgyas/ /ar+gham̐ dbul bar shes nas kyang / /mdor na mchod pa byas nas ni/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas bsreg rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ lha kun gtso bo gang yin pa'i me tog gang phog de sbyin sreg gi dkyil 'khor gyi tsakra ma byed pa'am yang na rang lhan cig tu byed pa'i dbye ba'ang shes par bya'o/ /yi sbyor ba rab rdzogs byas la/ rab gnas la/ / sbyin sreg gi ga pur gur gum tsan+dan a ka ru dang du ru ka la sogs pas/ /mar dang 'o ma til bsgos la/ /til dang yung dkar 'bras rnams dang / /dri yi chus ni legs bkang ste/ /'bras can yos dang sbrang ka ra bu ram bzhi bsres la/ la du ba/ /sbrang rtsi sha ka rar ldan pa/ /brgya phrag du mar yongs bzlas rang lha'i rtsa rig sogs rgyud 'di'i lha gang rung gi sems rtsa rig sbyong ba'i rgyal po/ kha cig na med la/ /yam shing la yang sngar gyi de bzhin te/ /rang gi 'gre sngags kyis btab pa'i shing / /khung bu'i nang du bzhag par bya/ /ces pas bstan/ lnga pa ro byin gyis brlabs te chas su zhugs pa ni/ ro la lo ka gsum rgyal lam bdud rtsi 'khyil la sogs pa'i khro bo'i/ sngags kyis btab nas kyang / /chu rtsa rig bzlas pa'i mchog gis ni bkrus nas ni/

/sngags bzla pa'i dri yis dbyug par bya/ /ro la/ gos dang rgyan gyis ras kyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dbu rgyan sogs/ bklubs nas kyang / /sngags kyis btab pa'i bdug pas bdug /ro la/ me tog 'phreng la sogs pas mchod/ /gtsug phud dpung par de bzhin du/ /sngags oṃ badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dzñā na sa ma ye hūm̐/ bris pas ni gdags pa bya/ snying kha lkog ma kha phyogs su/ /sarba bid kyi rdo rje khu tshur gnyis gtugs la/ byin gyis brlabs/ /dpral ba mdzod spu rna ba gnyis/ te gsum/ /mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis/ / ste drug sna dang bdun/ sked pa brgyad/ pus mo bol/ gnyis te bcu/ /long bu gnyis te bcu bzhi/ sna yi rtse mo dang / /mig gnyis dang bcu bdun/ ni gsang ba'i gnas/ bco brgyad/ /dbang po rnams kyi gnas dang ni/ /de ltar gzhan gong du bstan pa'i bco brgyad po/ /du yi ge sngags/ / a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ mchog tu dge ba rnams bzhag dgas sam yang na bag chu sogs kyis sbyar go /de nas ngan song sbyong ba'i phyir/ /ras gtsang ma'i stan dang bcas te thabs dbus su/ /ro/ bzhag pa nyid du bya ba yin/ /de nas sngags 'chang sngags kyis ni/ /btab pa'i gos kyis stod g.yogs sogs g.yogs par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa sbyin sreg bya ba'i rim pa dngos ni/ de nas byin za dang ag ni me lha dang gsum don gcig dge ba rab sbra la/ me lce rgyud 'di'i dbu zhabs na me lha dam tshig pa bskyed pa med/ stong gis dkris shing 'bar ba'i lus/ /zla dkar kun+da'i zhi ba'i mdog bzhin la zhi ba'i lus/ / de gnyis la mchod pa dang sbyin sreg mtha' yas pa mang po/ yi gzugs kyi me bkug spyan drangs lugs rgyud gzhan nas bshad la/ /ar+ghaṃ me lha rang gi sngags kyis dbul bar brtags nas de bzhin du/

/bsgrub pa po/ blo mchog ldan pa'i mdun du yang na mchod rdzas rnams me lha bris pa'am brkos pa'i/ gzugs sogs bzhag /ji ltar gsungs shing me lha sbyin sreg rdzogs pa'i rjes la yon tan 'dod pa yi/ /de sbyin sreg gi yon tan 'og nas 'byung / bzhin gshegs rang gi lha'i dkyil 'khor sogs kyi tsakra sogs de ltar e ha hi sogs kyis spyan drangs la/ /ar+ghaṃ la sogs brtags nas de bzhin du kun rig gi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i skabs/ /bde gshegs gsungs pa'i mchod pa lnga brgyad bstod pa dbyangs pa'i bstod lha rdzas mchog gi dkyil 'khor la/ gang yin bya/ /de nas rang sngags kyi byin za la ni brtags bya ba/ /bsreg byas bkang ste sbar bar bya ba'i phyir/ /de nas bsreg byas bkang ste rim gyis ni/ /rgyal rang lha'am dkyil 'khor gcig la sogs pa brgya rtsa brgyad du rang sngags kyi brtag /de nas sbyong ba'i sngags rang sngags/ kyi rgyal po la sho dhani/ /bsreg par bya ba nyi shu rtsa gcig spyan drangs pa'i dkyil 'khor la rang lha'i/ brtag /de nas me lha'am rang lha'am dkyil 'khor gcig phyag na rdo rje/ spyan drangs yo byad lan spyir me lha bgrang brgya rtsa brgyad dang rang lha'am dkyil 'khor la gnyis gcig phyag rdor la brgya phrag stong bye ba ste lan grangs tshar gsum po de'i yo byad lan gsum la sbyar te grangs nges yin no/ /gsum de gnyis la mchod pa dang sbyin sreg dang / /ar+gham̐ pu tsa lnga la sogs pad+ma dkar zhal mchod/ /phyag na rdo rje pad+ma zhags pa bsnams/ /'jig rten gsum las zhal phyag mtha' yas pa rnam rgyal gzugs/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma sdig mnan hūm̐ mdzad kyis dbang phyug chen po dang u ma mnan pa bzhin ro mnan pa ni thugs rjes sdig pa mnan pa'i/ cing / /rgyan rnams kun ni rab rdzogs pa/

/rdzogs dbu rgyan gtso bo/ sangs rgyas ni dbu rgyan mtho/ /bsam sam phyag rdor la sbyin sreg byed tsa nas sngar thab na yod pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor gcig ni lha gshegs gsol mi byed de sngar gyi steng du bsnan nas spyan drangs so/ /de yi snying badz+ra satwa/ po de nas rang lha dkyil 'khor gcig rang sngags kyi de bzhin du/ /brgya phrag stong ngam yang na ni/ /bye ba'i tshad du sbyin sreg bya/ / de nas yang me la mjug gi cho ga bya/ ci ste mtshan ma sngar gyi sbyin sreg bye bas sbyang ba'i skabs/ la sogs byung / /de bzhin sdig can gyi rgyud dag par shes par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa mchod rten gdab pa ni/ de nas thar bar gyur pa dang / /rdo rje bsdu ba'i dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsngags kyi ni/ /cho ga bzhin du bsdu bar mu dra dang bcas pas bya/ /thal ba de dang rus pa'i rdul/ /sngags btab pa sngar mchod rten bya ba dang sdig pa sbyang ba'i skabs su'ang 'di bzhin bya/ yi dri chu dang / /ba skyes 'o ma la sogs lngas/ / badz+ra satwa la sogs pa/ /sbyong ba'i sngags kyis blo ldan gyis/ /'bum du bzlas pas rdzis nas ni/ /ga pur dri dang bsgos pa yis/ /'jim pa dang ni bsres nas kyang / /kun rig gi gtso bo dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i gzugs su bya 'am yang na ni/ /mchod rten gyi ni lhar byas la/ /gcig gam gnyis sam gsum mam lnga/ /yang na brgya rtsa brgyad gdab bar du/ /sngags dang 'gre/ lha'i sku phyag rgyas btab nas bsgom kyang / /'bum phrag gnyis kyi bar du sku gzugs sam mchod rten de byin gyis brlabs sngar gang btab pa'i sngags bzlas/ /zhes pas bstan/ brgyad pa rtags dang phan yon 'byung bar bstan pa la gsum/ rtags dngos/ rtags ma byung na/ bskyar ba'i cho ga bskyar chog byas pas rtags 'byung bar bstan pa'o/

/dang po rtags dngos ni/ de nas mchod rten 'bar gyur tam/ /yang na gzugs kyi zhal 'dzum mam/ /dri dang byug pa'i gos kyang rung / /snang ngam yang na ngad ldan nam/ /lha la sogs pa'i rnam pa ni/ /sna tshogs par ni snang 'gyur ram/ /rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa dang / /me tog la sogs lha la 'dor ba dang / /dung dang rnga la sogs pa'i sgra/ /gling bu pi wam̐ la sogs rnams/ /ci ste mtshan ma de dag ni/ /sdig can blos ni mi mthong na/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rtags ma byung na bskyar ba'i cho ga ni/ 'bum gyi phrag ni brgyad stong ngam/ /ji srid mtshan ma byung bar du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mchod nas ni/ /rang lha'i nga rgyal la/ mnyam par bzhag pas bzlas par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa bskyar chog byas pas 'grub par bstan pa ni/ de yi mthar ni mkhas pas kyang / /mtshan gcig thog thag mi nyal bzlas/ de nas de yi sdig pa yi/ /dag pa nyid du nges par mthong / /lha rten de yi lus ni gzugs gyur la/ /rang gi rgyud du ngo shes 'gyur/ /mtshan ma tshe 'das de sngar 'dir skye ba dang shi ba 'dir skye dran pa 'di dag shes nas ni/ /rnam par mi rtog sems kyis kyang / /byams dang snying rje ldan pa yis/ /las rnams thams cad byed par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ brgyad pa rten med pa la sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ de rnams ni ro yod pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ yang na med par gyur na yang / /sngags/ bzlos shing bsgom pa'i tshul gyis ni/ /shi ba'i/ ming tsam legs par bris nas kyang / /mchod rten 'phreng ba lugs gcig bya ba'am/ /yang na 'jim pa lha'i gzugs su bris kyang rung / /ming dang bsreg rdzas bsres la/ sbyin sreg mngon par ming sogs dbang bskur na/ /phan yon/ gdon mi za bar bde 'gror skye/ /zhes pas bstan/ dgu pa phyir bzlog gi sdig pa sbyang ba ni/

phyir ldog thal ba yungs dkar bye ma sogs/ /shi ba/ rang gi ming nas sngags btab nas/ /bzlas par byas te song nas kyang / 'od zer/ rten la brab pa'i rdzas dman pa de mthun de rnams la re re 'khor rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i klung du dor/ chu klung zer/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa de'i sdig pa sbyangs pa'i phan yon bstan pa la gnyis/ phan yon dngos dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa la sogs pa'i rten la thabs sngags dang phyag rgya med na mi 'byongs par bstan pa'o/ /dang po phan yon dngos ni/ sngon byung dri ma med pas sdig pa sbyangs thabs de rnams byas kyang brgya byin lus ngag la thogs pa med pas 'gal ba med gsungs so/ de ltar byas na sdig can yang / / sdig pa sbyangs thabs de rnams las gang rung gis/ ngan song las ni thar 'gyur na/ / shi ba de/ dge ba'i mchog ni bskyed pa dang / /byang chub kyi sems bskyed byas nas sa bon bskyed pa'i bdag /sangs rgyas shi ba de'i rgyud la 'bras bu gyur ldan par/ /shi ba'i rgyud la/ sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin par ldan/ /tshul khrims sdom pa rgyu dang rab ldan par/ /sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i/ bzod pa brtson 'grus mnyam bzhag bsam gtan dang / /shes rab thos rnams kyi 'bras bu shes rab rgyu bsgom pas/ / tshe 'das la de ltar byas nas/ 'jig rten bsod nams ldan ci smos/ /myur du de ni ngan song ni/ /sngar bstan pa'i rgyu de lta bu sngon du song nas/ bcom par 'gyur te the tshom med/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa la sogs pa'i rten la thabs sngags dang phyag rgya med na mi 'byongs par bstan pa ni/ shi ba'i rgyud la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed la/ /med par lta chad lta ba gang yin dang / /byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa/ lam las rnam log pa/

/bud+dha'i/ bstan pa sde snod gsum la zhe sdang gnod kyi bsam pas kun nas bslangs nas byed cing / /sdig pa'i rang bzhin las dge sdig mi shes pas ma mthong na/ /pha dang ma la snying ring zhing / /byang chub sems la smon 'jug gnyis kyi sems brten pa dang / /'dod chags bral ba dgra bcom pa/ bsad pa rnams/ ci ste lha sgrub pa po'i cho ga mkhan po rnams med gyur tam/ /sgrub pa po la/ sangs rgyas dge 'dun chos de bzhin/ /bsgrub pa la/ sngags dang phyag rgyas tshogs la sogs/ /shes rab thabs rnams med na ni/ /sdig can de dag rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa la med/ sgrub pa po yang gong ma rnams med na rang grol du/ mi thar zhes/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ngan song nas 'thon pa'i thabs phan yon dang bcas pa la bdun/ brgya byin la sogs pas cho ga ji lta ba bzhin byas pas dri ma med pa sdug bsngal las thar te dga' ldan gnas su skyes pa/ nor bu dri ma med pa la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te ngo mtshar ba bstan pa/ brgya byin la sogs pas ched du brjod pa bstan pa/ dga' ldan pas ngo mtshar te ched du brjod pa/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams kyis ya mtshan skyes te ched du brjod pa/ yang dga' ldan pas ngo mtshar skyes te mched du brjod pa/ nor bu dri ma med pa la sogs pas mchod pa byas te slar dong bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po brgya byin la sogs pas cho ga ji lta ba bzhin byas pas dri ma med pa sdug bsngal las thar te dga' ldan gnas su skyes pa ni/ de nas brgya byin la sogs/ rtsa gsum pa'i/ lhas pad+ma lta bu'i sems la rtog pa skyes pas lus kyi mig phye nas/ /legs so zhes bcom ldan 'das/ pas mnyes byas te/ /rab tu mgu bas mchod byas nas/ /brgya byin gzhan la phan brtson nor bu dri ma med pa byang sems/

pas/ /ta thās/ ji ltar gsol ba'i bka' bzhin du/ /shākya'i gtso bos bka' stsal pa/ /sngar bstan pa'i sdig pa sbyangs thabs/ bden pa nyid du byas gyur na/ /de nas de ni dmyal ba yi/ /sdug bsngal las nor bu dri ma med pa ni thar nas kyang / /dga' ldan gnas su sems can kun/ /phan phyir nor bu dri med pa/ bde gshegs 'dra bar skyes/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa nor bu dri ma med pa la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te ngo mtshar bstan pa ni/ de nas dga' ldan gyi lha rnams la dbang 'byor pa/ dbang por bcas pa yi/ / dga' ldan du skyes pa/ lung las dga' ldan pa/ drag chen lha rnams gar byed cing / /mchod pa rgya che pa'i sprin ni mtha' yas pas/ /de bzhin gshegs la mchod bya'i phyir/ /lha yi tshogs kyi mdun byas te/ /tshe 'di nyid la lus 'di nyid la byang chub tu sems bskyed na ni mchod bya'i phyir zer na legs gsungs mchod pa'i phyir/ /byang chub tu yang sems bskyed nas/ /lha rdzas rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /me tog bdug pa byug pa dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phan la sogs/ /rgyan la sogs pa rab mdzes dang / /na bza' rin chen char la sogs/ /dga' ba'i tshal ni gang bar byas/ /de nas rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams ya mtshan cher gyur te/ /lha rnams kyis kyang phyag 'tshal nas/ /dga' ba'i tshal ni yid 'ongs pa/ /kun nas dga' bar gyur pa yis/ /sna tshogs byung ba 'di ci lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /grogs po dag shes par gyis shig rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa 'di ni lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba de'i yin no/ / zhes gsungs so/ /lha rnams kyis gsol ba/ mtshams med pa'i 'bras bu'i du khaḥdabang du gyur pa rnams myong zhing / mthong ba'i chos 'di nyid la sngar gyi cho ga'i che ba bde 'gro lha'i dbang du gyur pa gang lags pa de ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar lags so/

/bde bar gshegs pa ngo mtshar lags so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa brgya byin la sogs pas ched du brjod pa bstan pa ni/ de nas brgya byin la sogs pa'i gleng bzhi bstan pa'i 'khor/ lha'i bu thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs kyi ston pa la ltos na 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /mu stegs kyi chos la ltos na/ chos dang 'dra ba'i dge ba med/ /byang chub sems dpa'i/ dge 'dun 'dra ba'i snod med do/ /sngags dang 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med/ /de na lha'i bu de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la sa bcad gtso bo'i dbang du byas nas 'di pas ched du brjod pas so/ /kha cig na med/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i/ /dga' ldan lha'i rigs su skyes pa'i lha'i bu ci 'dra zhig de'i rdzu 'phrul dang mthu ci 'dra zhig lags/ lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bgyi ba de bdag cag blta bar 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha rnams kyi snying la bskal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gyi 'phreng ba nyid kyi zhabs kyi mthe bong gnyis las lha'i bu ngan song las 'thon pa'i rtags byung ngo / /phyung nas kyang nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i lus thams cad snang bar byas nas snying khar nor bu dri ma med zhugs te bskul nas de nyid du mi snang bar gyur to/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa dga' ldan pas ngo mtshar te ched du brjod pa ni/ de nas lha'i bu nor bu dri med pa'i 'od de nyid rab tu sems can gyi don la/ dga' nas/ dri ma med pa'i/ lus kyi 'od zer gyis dpag tshad brgya stong tshun chad kyi nam mkha'i ngos thams cad gsal bar byas te/ lha'i bu stong phrag du ma'i 'khor gyis bskor cing mdun du byas nas/ lha'i rdzu 'phrul chen pos rang lus/

mi snang bas byas te/ dga' ba'i tshal thams cad 'od zer gyis gsal zhing snang bar byas te/ bcom ldan 'das dang brgya byin ma gtogs pa lha rnams kyi 'od zer zil gyis mnan to/ /de nas 'od zer snang bar byas pas dri ma med pa mi snang bar byas so/ /dga' ldan du skyes nas dga' ba'i tshul du 'ong ba'i lha'i bu des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas/ ched du brjod pa 'di ched du brjod do/ /kye ma shākya mgon po yis/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa ya mtshan che/ /gang phyir ngan song ltung ba yi/ /sems can glog bzhin myur du grol/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa sum cu rtsa gsum pa rnams ni ya mtshan skyes te ched du brjod pa ni/ de nas skad cig ma de nyid kyi tshe/ shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyi pad+mo thams cad rin po che las byas pa/ dpag tshad brgya phrag stong du dri'i ngad ldang ba/ lha klu snyan pa'i sgra grags pa/ ya mtshan du ma yang dag par ston pa/ lha'i klu dang / gar dang / brdung ba dang / gling bu dang / rnga dang / ker ko rnams kyi sgra snyan par 'byin pa zhig bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar phyung te/ de mthong nas shin tu ya mtshan skyes te/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos ni bsam mi khyab/ /sngags kyi yon tan sna tshogs bsam mi khyab/ /byang chub rten pa rnams kyang bsam mi khyab/ /tshangs spyod tshul khrims mi dge ba bcu spangs nas dge ba bcu dang du len pa'i/ dri med de mnyen po skyes mtha' yas/ /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa dga' ldan pas ngo mtshar te ched du brjod pa ni/ de nas rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i bu dri ma med pa dga' ldan du skyes pa de dag gis de blta bar 'dod nas/ yang bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha'i bu de dri med dga' ldan du skyes pa dang de'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor blta bar 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das blta bar 'tshal lo/

/bde bar gshegs pa blta bar 'tshal lo/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang zhabs kyi mthe bong gnyis nas 'od zer phyung ste/ 'od zer dri ma med pa des lha'i bu de dang / lha'i bu de dang de dag kun tu snang bar byas te bskul nas de nyid du 'od zer des bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs kyi mthe bong gnyis la slar thim ste mi snang bar byas te/ de nas nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba dang / de la sogs pa'i gnas gtsang ma'i dga' ldan du skyes pa rigs kyi lha'i bu rnams kyis dga' ldan gyi ston pa bcom ldan 'das dang cho ga byed pa'i bla ma brgya byin gnyis kyi gdan ma gtogs pa dga' ba'i tshal thams cad g.yos par byas te/ lan brgya stong du mar bskor ba byas shing / bskor ba byas nas kyang yang nas yang du 'di skad ces gsol to/ /kye ma sangs rgyas rnams kyi ni/ /sngags kyi byin rlabs ya mtshan che/ /gang phyir mtshams med ltung ba yis/ /sems can dri ma med lha gnas dga' ldan du/ myur du skyes/ /zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa nor bu dri ma med pa la sogs pas mchod pa byas te slar dong bar bstan pa ni/ de nas lha'i bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba dga' ldan du skyes pa/ la sogs pa lha'i bu de dag gis/ bcom ldan 'das la nor bu dang gser dang / dngul dang / gsum pas byas pa'i do shal dang / sor gdub/ se mo do dang / gdub bu dang / dpung rgyan dang / dpung rgyan rkang rgyan mgul rgyan/ snyan cha la sogs pa rgyan gyi khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs du ma dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / 'phan dang / lda ldi dang / rnga ma bla bre la sogs pa yo byad kyi khyad par rnam pa sna tshogs pa dang / seng ge'i gdan dang / gzim cha dang / pho brang dang / gzhal med khang dang / khang bu brtsegs pa la sogs pa gnas zla ba'i gdan kyi khyad par sna tshogs pa dang /

me tog la sgra dri ro reg bya sogs mchod pa'i khyad par sna tshogs pa dang / rang gi lus dang / ngag dang / sems rnams kyang phul te/ ba glang dang / rta dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / spre'u dang / sgo ba dang / thub re dang / ma he dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo dang / chu srin dang / phag dang / ra dang / glang dang / ba dang / 'dod pa'i bzhon la sogs pa 'dod pa'i khyad par du ma yang phul te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyang mngon par mchod/ lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin gyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams kyang mchod de/ legs so zhes bya bas gsol nas/ bcom ldan 'das dang / brgya byin gnyis la bla ma dang bsti stang du byed de/ phyag 'tshal nas de bzhin du dong ngo / /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa la bzhi ste/ brgya byin la sogs pas bshad par gsol ba gdab pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon cig par gdams pa bstan pa/ bshad pa dngos/ bha ga wan gyis brgya byin la yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i rgyud de 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams kyi don du bag yod par sgrubs shig par bkas gnang ba'o/ /dang po brgya byin la sogs pas bshad par gsol ba gdab pa ni/ de nas brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa/ lha rnams mchog tu sngar med don la ya mtshan du gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das la yang dang yang du legs so legs so/ /zhes bya bas bstod cing mchod de phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das gang gi slad du/ ma 'ongs pa'i byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams 'chang ba dang 'dis sngon cho ga yod par shes/ tshig dang don gyi sgo nas/ klog pa la spro bar bgyi ba'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod pa'i yon tan bshad du gsol/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon cig par bstan pa ni/ bka' stsal pa/ brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i bu dag ngas bshad kyis legs par nyon la yid la zungs shig

ces pas bstan/ gsum pa bshad pa dngos la lnga/ chos dang ldan pas thos par bstan pa/ lha rnams kyis snod ldan par khas blangs pa/ gzhan gyi don byas pa'i phan yon/ brgya byin la sogs pas bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa/ rgyud bcangs pa la sogs pa'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po chos dang ldan pas thos par bstan pa ni/ lha'i bu rnams dge ba bcu dang ldan pa'i sems can gyi rna lam du thos par 'gyur gyi/ sems can ma rab mi dge ba bcu dang ldan snod min pa rnams kyi ni ma yin no/ /pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la mos pa'i sems can rnams kyi rna lam du nye bar 'gro bar 'gyur gyi/ sems can dge sdig gang yang med pa phal pa ma rab zer/ rnams kyi ni ma yin no/ /sems can theg pa chen po'i rigs su bsam pa dengs pa rnams dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i yon tan mang po la mngon par 'dod pa'i sems can rnams kyi rna lam du grags par 'gyur te/ mdor na thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la brten pa'i sems can rnams kyi rna lam du 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ / grags zer/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa lha rnams kyis snod dang ldan par khas blangs pa ni/ de nas brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i bu de dag yang dag par skyes dga' ba nas/ 'di skad ces gsol te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni snod du gyur pa'o/ /bde bar gshegs pa bdag cag ni snod du gyur pa ste/ gang gi slad du bdag cag gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po mtshan brjod pa 'di/ bcom ldan pad+mo'i zhal nyid du thos pas/ bdag cag ni ngan song gis 'jigs par mi 'gyur/ dus ma lags pa'i 'chi bas 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'chi ba dang / lha'i gnas nas/ ltung ba dang / tshe 'di la gnas gcig pa'i phyi ma so sor skyes pa rnam par 'thor ba dang /

rnam par 'jigs pa la sogs pas 'jigs par mi 'gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni gdon mi 'tshal bar sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub pa'i snod du gyur pa lags so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa gzhan gyi don byas pa'i phan yon la gnyis/ dris pa dang lan no/ /dang po dris pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das brtag pa'i rgyal po 'dis nas bstan pa sdig pa sbyangs thabs kyis sems can gyi don bgyid pa gang lags pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag gi 'bras bu ni cir 'gyur/ rnam par smin pa ni cir 'gyur/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa lan ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po de dag ni skyes bu dam pa 'ba' zhig tu ma zad kyis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du la dor ba'i tshig blta bar bya'o/ /lha'i dbang po gang gi phyir 'jig rten pha rol tu song nas/ mtshams med pa la sogs pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen por skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi sdug bsngal sna tshogs rab tu spong bar byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i phyir mi ldog pa la rab tu 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /lha'i dbang po dper na khyod kyis lha'i nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba mtshams med pa'i sems can dmyal pa chen por skyes pa'i don byas pa bzhin no/ /lha'i dbang po de ltar gzhan yang ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams kyi don byed pa'i sems can so so skye bo yin snyam du sems sam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po de ltar sems can de dag ni/ skyes bu dam pa chen po gzhan la phan 'dogs pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang phyag bya ba/ phul du phyin pa'i tshig mchod pa yon tan gyi sgo nas brjod pa/ bsti stang du bya ba phrag la bskur bar bya ba lus kyis bsnyen bkur ba la sogs pa yin na/

lhar bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de yan chad bsgrub pa'i phan yon/ zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa brgya byin la sogs pas bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas pa ni/ de nas brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i bu rnams dang / rgyal po chen po bzhi dang / phyogs skyong bcu dang / 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad dang / gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad lnga brtsen dang / gnod sbyin chen po nor bu bzang po dang / nor bu bzang po chen po la sogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa la sems rab tu gnas pa dang / lus klu'i rgyal po dga' bo dang / nyer dga' bo gnyis dang / 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgyas bskor ba rnams dang / /gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po pan tsi ka dang / pan tsi ka chen po la sogs pa dang / gang gzhan dag kyang rgya che zhing rgya che ba'i lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / 'byung po dang / yi dwags dang / 'dre dang / rims dang / gdon dang / dug dang / skar ma la sogs pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'dus shing tshogs pa thams cad kyis skyes bu dam pa chen po de'i rkang pa gnyis mgo bos blang bar bgyi'o/ /mdor na rtag par rgyun du dus thams cad du bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gang du brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di rigs kyi bu mo dang bas 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ gzhan la rgya cher yang dag par 'chad par 'gyur ram/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas chos spyod bcu'i sgo nas/ mchod par 'gyur ram/ rgyal rigs sam/ bram ze'i rigs sam/ rje'u rigs sam/ dmangs rigs sam/ gzhan yang rgyal po'am/ rgyal po'i bu'am/ rgyal po'i bu mo'am/ rgyal po'i btsan mo'am/

rgyal po'i 'khor mo'am/ gang su yang rung bas 'chang zhing klog pa nas/ gzhan la rgya cher yang dag par 'chad pa'i bar du bgyi ba na/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'dus shing tshogs pa thams cad de'i bran du 'gyur ba lags so/ /rang gi skye bo pha las gyes pa dang / gnyen gyi skye bo ma las skyes pa dang / yongs kyi phal pa skye bo dang / grong bcu/ dang grong bzhi yan chad/ grong khyer nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / brgyad man chad/ grong brdal dang sum cu so bzhi/ ljongs drug cu rtsa bzhi dang / bzo sna bco brgyad yod pa de dag gnas pa'i yul spyi la bya/ rgyal po'i pho brang dang / 'khor rnams yongs su bskyang bar bgyi/ dus dus su char yang 'bab par bgyi 'bru la sogs pa bskyed par bgyi/ skye bo mang po la phan pa dang / bde ba'i slad du rjes su bsgrub par bgyi/ pha rol phru mang po gzhom par bgyi/ sems can ma rung pa rgyud 'chad pa la sogs pa mi mthun phyogs gnod cing 'tshe bas de la sgrub pa po mi phan pa'i sems bskyed pa gang yin pa dag brlag par bgyi ba'i slad du bsgrub par bgyi/ ma rung par bgyi'o/ /de la bdud kyi las kyang bgyi'o/ /gnod pa bgyid pa la yang nye bar gnas par bgyis te/ bcom ldan 'das mdor na ma 'ongs pa'i sems can rnams la brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa lta bur gnas pa lags pas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis bu bzhin du bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa rgyud bcang ba la sogs pa'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ lha'i dbang po khyod ji ltar smras pa de de bzhin du/ brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di ni de bzhin du blta bar bya'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa bha ga wan gyis brgya byin la phan yon de lta bu dang ldan pa'i rgyud 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams kyi don du bag yod par sgrub shig par bkas gnang ba ni/

lha'i dbang po la sogs kyi 'dzam bu'i gling na gnas pa'i sems can sdig pa'i chos la kun tu spyod pa/ sems can dmyal ba'i yul du gyur pa/ 'khor ba mi gtsang ba'i 'dam du bying ba'i sems can la phan pa dang bde ba bya ba'i phyir/ yun ring po nas bag yod par byos la sgrubs shig slob ma'i snod brtag la de nas bshad par bya'o/ /de yan chad la rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes 'dogs pa ni 'og nas phyi ma zhes bshad pas snga ma rtsa ba yin/ des shugs la shes so gsungs/ ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa phyag na rdo rje'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i brtag pa phyi ma la gnyis/ bsdus pa po'i mtshams sbyor sngon du song bas ston pa gdan las bzhengs te phyag byas nas ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs pa dang / rgyud kyi gzhung ngo / /dang po bsdus pa po'i mtshams sbyor sngon du song bas ston pa gdan las bzhengs te phyag byas nas ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa ni/ bam po gnyis pa/ de nas kun rig gi rjes byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thugs rgyud ye shes su snang ba'i phyag na rdo rjes/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis gsungs pa'i ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus brtag pa'i rgyal po sngar gyi rjes la gsungs pa ni de bzhin du kha skong ba zab pas dka' ba gcod pas bla ma'am mchog tu gyur pas brtag pa phyi ma 'di bshad do/ bde bar byas pa'i/ kha gcig na med/ phyir byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga zhi ba mo mtshan gyi skabs su bshad pa dang mthun/ /dga' bo gdan la rang gi ye shes gdan du snang ba las bzhengs nas ni/ /sems can don la/ dgyes shing rdo rje gsor nas ni/ /shākya'i rgyal po dgyes mdzad pa'i/ /thub pa'i gtso la phyag btsal nas/ /nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ming rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par rtse gcig tu zhugs mngon sum du mdzad pa nas/

zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyud kyi gzhung lnga/ shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor/ phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor/ tshe dpag tu med pa gsung gi dkyil 'khor/ 'khor los bsgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor/ me ltar 'bar ba 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor/ dang po shākya thub pa sku'i la lnga/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa/ phyag rgya'i ye shes/ dngos grub kyi ye shes/ nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi skye rgyud bstan pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba ni/ ngan song thams cad rnam par sbyong ba'i rang gi snying po 'di nyid kyi thugs kha nas ston pa ci lta ba ni/ byung ngo / / byin gyis rlabs pa'i don/ oṃ shāka thub skyed pa/ bzlas pa/ dkyil 'khor du bkod pa/ mu dra ston pa/ bum pa bzla ba/ thams cad kyi'am/ /phyag na rdo rje dgos pa'i skabs nas 'gre sarba pā pam̐ da ha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba a pa ya bi sho dha na badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba karma ā ba rgyal ba'i gtsug tor/ ra na ni bhasmin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bh+rum̐ bi na sha ya 'khor lo bsgyur ba ā ba ra na ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bh+rum̐ bhi sho dha ya dmyal ba'i las sha las byed/ a ba rnam par rgyal ba/ ra ṇa na ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ kha cig na med/ oṃ dz+wa la mtshams g.yon bskor min pas gzi brjid phung po/ dz+wa la/ dha ka dha ka ha na ha na/ ā ba ra na ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ srum̐ sa ra sa ra/ pra sa gdugs dkar po/ ra pra sa ra/ ā ba ra na ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ ha ra rnam par 'thor ba/ ha ra sarba ā ba ra na ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭ sarba ā ba ra ni bi s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sku/ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba 'di gsum bzlas na lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig pa sbyang ngo / ā ba ra na ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs so/

/ṭa tha ṭa tha sarba ā ba ra ṇi hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ yang 'og gi mu dra sbyar la lha'i rnal 'byor dang mu dra ston dgos te dkyil 'khor dgos so/ /tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba ā wa ra na ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bid tra bid tra sarba ā ra sngags rkang 'di med pa'i dpe mang ba 'dug pas brtag trad tra ni hūm̐/ oṃ dā ha dā ha sarba dmyal bar skye bar byed pa'i rgyud zad par byed/ 'di gsum bzlas pa'i dus su sngags phreng mjug tu btags la bzlas te dkyil 'khor thams cad dgos/ rang lha'i sgrub pa la yang shes par bya'o/ /na ra ga ga ti he tun hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ga ga te he tun hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma thā dud 'gro ma thā sarba tir+yag ga ti he tu hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas de dag gi yo byad bshad do/ /oṃ sarba a pa ya bhi sho dha ni dha ma dha ma gdug pa ma/ dhu pa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba durga ti pa ri sho dha ni puṣ+pam̐ bi lo ki ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba a pa ya ni bi ga ti dzñā na a lo ke ka ri ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba a pa ya ga ti gan+dha na sha ni gan+dha dkyil 'khor thams cad du dgos pa ti hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas sgo ba rnams kyi sngags la/ oṃ na ra ka gar+ya lcags kyu ya a kar+ṣa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba na ra ga zhags pa/ bud+dha ra ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ dkyil 'khor thams cad du dgos/ sarba a pa lcags sgrog ya bhan dha mo tsa ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ sarba a bha ya ga ti dril bu/ ga ha na bi na sha ni hūm̐ phaṭ sgo ba bzhi yod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du dgos/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma dbang bskur ba/ phan yon dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po slob dpon gyi las la gnyis/ bri zhing dgod pa dang / dkyil 'khor du bzhugs te bdag bskyed la mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'o/

/dang po bri zhing dgod pa ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gnas dang mchog kun rig bzhin/ 'khor lo zlum po 'dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ shin tu mdzes pa'i rtsibs brgyad can shes rab can/ /ting nge 'dzin/ lte bar bcas shing rtsibs rten ldan/ / mu 'khyud rdo rje'i ra ba bya gsungs/ nang gi rim pa bris nas ni/ /lte ba'i nang du rang gi sngags zlos shing / shākya yi/ /bdag po pad zla/ thub pa bri bar bya/ /lag na rdo rje stobs can phyogs kyi lha thams cad dkar/ ni/ /dpa' bo de yi sbyin sngar shākya thub/ bri/ /rgyab tu 'khor los bsgyur ba bri/ mnyam bzhag /g.yas phyogs rgyal ba'i gtsug tor la/ mchog sbyin/ /g.yon phyogs rnam par rgyal ba mi 'jigs bri/ /mtshams kyi lha g.yon bskor/ gzi brjid phung po me dkar dmar g.yas nyi ma g.yon bskur/ yi phyogs/ /dbang ldan phyogs su gdugs dkar dkar po/ /rnam par 'thor slob dpon g.yas ral gri g.yon po ti ba rlung gi phyogs/ /de rnams kyi sku mdog phyag mtshan rnam par kha cig na med/ 'joms pa rgyal mtshan no/ ni ri ti srin po'i phyogs/ /bris nas phyi rol bri bya ste/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ dang / /seng ge dang glang po ches rta babs brgyan par bya/ /dpa' bo khro bo yin pas/ lcags kyu zhags pa dang / /lcags sgrog dril bu snyan rnams bzhag /grwa yi phyogs ni thams cad du/ /bdug pa la sogs bri bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor du bzhugs te/ bdag bskyed la mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ de nas dri zhim la sogs pas/ mchod rdzas sogs dgod pa kun rig bzhin/ /rang gi lus ni a ci rgya/ bskus nas kyang /

/slob ma 'jug pa ltar/ rdo rje 'dzin pas bzhugs pa'i sngags mu dra 'ching ba kun rig ltar/ nas ni/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bha ga wan e h+ya hi mahā ka ru ṇi ka dri sh+ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod pas lha rnams spyan drangs/ nas dgug gzhug dang mu dra bstan/ de nas bde bar gshegs pa mos pa bskyed de mchod pa dang gtor ma bstod pa byas nas/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma dbang bskur ba phan yon dang bcas pa ni/ de bzhin du bcug ste dbang slob ma lha gzhan sogs kun rig bzhin bskur nas bla ma mchod pa kun rig ltar/ phan yon ni ngan song thams cad las rnam par grol te/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten dang / gong nas gong du sa rnams su yang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas su yang gdon mi za bar 'gyur ro/ /snga ma bzhin du las thams cad byed cing las thams cad thogs pa med par 'gyur ro/ /byab pa rma bya'i sgro rdo rjes byab la byas pas rims thams cad dang / gdon dang dug la sogs pa las thar bar 'gyur ro/ /phyag na rdo rje ye shes dbab dus su hūm̐ zhes kyi rnam par bzhugs zhes bya ba las thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /brtag pa kun rig dang tshe dpag med la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas bshad pa'i sdig pa sbyangs thabs/ gzhan gyi cho gas kyang thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po la sogs pa ngan song gi rgyud kyi dbang du gyur pa rnams kyi shi ba'i ro'i gzugs brnyan nam ming la sogs pa bris te/ bzlas pa dang / sbyin sreg dang / dbang rnams kyi snga ma bzhin du sdig sbyang kun rig nas bshad pa bzhin thams cad bya'o/ /bskur na ngan song thams cad las grol bar byed do/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa phyag rgya'i ye shes ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyag na rdo rjes 'khor gyi nang du mu dra 'di gsum lo ka pa la 'das pa gnyis ka'i thun mong ste dkyil 'khor thams cad dang gzhan gnyis ga la byin gyis rlabs dang mu dra ston pa'o/

/seng ge'i lta stangs kyis bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du bltas te/ phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan phyag rgya dam pa yi/ /mtshan nyid dam pa bshad par bgyi/ /thugs rjes bskul ba thugs mnga' ba'i/ /rgyal ba kun gyi byin gyis rlobs/ /mnyes pas bzhag pas de rnams mi thob pa thob par byed pa'i dus su dkyil 'khor gyi rtsar slob ste rjes gnang gi dbang bskur ro/ /dpral bar ni/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi thal mo sbyar/ /sangs rgyas bde gshegs skyes rnams kyi/ /phyag 'tshal ba yi phyag rgyar bshad/ /rnal 'byor rigs pas mgrin phyogs su/ /thal mo snyim par sbyar nas ni/ /rtag tu pad+ma'i rigs nyid kyi/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya yin par bshad/ /rdo rje thal mo sbyar nas kyang / /snying kar gung mo thal sbyar nas/ /rdo rje rigs kyi phyag rgya ni/ /dam tshig thams cad 'dzin byed pa'o/ /lag pa g.yon pa'i thal mo gan rkyal du pang khar bzhag la/ de'i steng du g.yas pa bzhag ste mthe bong gnyis kyi ngo sprad la/ zhi bas lta bas blta ba 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya ste/ dam tshig yin par bshad do/ /de nyid ldog ste blta 'og bsnol la/ mthe bong dang mthe'u chung gcig la lu gu rgyud kyi tshul du bsnol la/ snying kar bzhag pa ni/ rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /'di dang gong gi mu tra gnyis kyi don gcig las mi ston/ thal mo rdzogs par sbyar ba las mthe bong dang mthe'u chung mnyam la/ lhag ma rnams brkyangs pa 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje 'dzin pa'i/ phyag rgya'o/ /ta tha'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba byed tsam na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ dang sbyar nas rdo rje'i rigs su spyi gtsug tu'o/ /lha dang sbyar na shāka thub dkyil 'khor du dgod yod/ des dkyil 'khor kha cig tu gtso bo byed/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis rdo rje 'dra bar mnyam la/

mthe bong dang mthe chung gnyis brkyangs pa 'di ni phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /phyag na rdo rje'i mu dra/ de nyid la mthe bong dang mthe chung gnyis de bzhin du byas la/ mdzub mo dang srin lag pad+ma 'dra bar bkug pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po'i ta tha'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i dus su bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ dang sbyar nas spyi gtsug tu'o/ /rdo rje rigs su mdun du'am/ /lha dang sbyar na kun rig gi shar du'o/ /phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid 'di dbang bskur ba'i dus su rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trā+om̐ dang sbyar nas rna ba g.yon par lha dang sbyar na kun rig gi dkyil 'khor lhor dgod pa'i rin chen me tog gi'o/ /las mdzub mo dang srin lag gnyis rin po che 'dra bar byas pa ni dbang bskur ba'i phyag rgya'o/ /mthe chung dang mthe bong so sor mnyam lhag ma rnams brkyangs pa ni sdig pa thams cad bsreg pa'i dbang bskur dus su a bhi ṣiñtsa hri dang sbyar nas lhag par lha dang sbyar na kun rig gi dkyil 'khor nub tu bkod pa'i shāka thub kyi'o/ /phyag rgya'o/ /lag pa g.yon pas de bzhin du bsgyur zhing bya ba ni las thams cad pa'i phyag dbang bskur ba'i mu tra de lnga dkyil 'khor thams cad du dgos/ rgya'o/ / dbang bskur ba'i dus su karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a dang sbyar la sna g.yon par lha dang sbyar na kun rig gi byang du dgod pa'i me tog cher rgyas/ snyim pa bzed pa thur du bcug pa la zer las gyen du 'thor ba ni bdug pa'i mchod pa'i byin gyis brlabs ste dkyil 'khor thams cad du dgos/ phyag rgya'o/ /de las 'og nas gyen du 'thor ba ni me tog gi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las mthe bo gnyis gyen du mnyam la mdun du 'dzin pa ni mar me'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las dung 'dra bar byas mdzub mo gnyis kyi rtse mo dang mthe bong gnyis kyi rtse mo so sor sprad pa ni dri'i phyag rgya'o/

/de nyid las rab tu brkyangs te 'dzin pa ni gtor ma'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las gung mo gnyis nang du bkug pa ni arga'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje bcings pa las gung mo gnyis mnyam ste tshigs dang po bcag la sngar bcings pa zer bas sor mo thams cad bsnol ba'i brkyangs pas brkyangs pa phyag zhes pa 'phral nas brkyangs pa la mdzad/ ni rnam par 'thor ba'i phyag rgya shāka thub dkyil 'khor du bkod pa'i 'o/ /de nyid las mthe bo dang mthe chung gnyis nang du bkug pa ni rnam par 'joms pa'i phyag rgya'o shāka thub dkyil 'khor du lho nub phyogs su bkod pa'i/ /de las 'od zer 'bar ba 'dra sor mo thams cad gdeng pa/ ni gzi brjid phung po'i phyag rgya'o/ / shāka thub dkyil 'khor du shar lhor bkod pa'o/ /de nyid gzi brjid phung po'i spyi bor bskor na gdugs dkar po'i phyag rgya shāka thub dkyil 'khor du byang shar du bkod pa'i/ 'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gnyis las mdzub mo gnyis dang / mthe chung gnyis bsnol te mdud la gyen du bskor ba ni 'khor lo'i phyag rgya'o shāka thub dkyil 'khor du nub phyogs su bkod pa'i/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis rdo rjer byas la mdzub mo gnyis rin po che ltar byas te/ lhag ma rnams 'phral nas/ 'od zer 'dra bar byas pa ni rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de bzhin du mdzub mo rdo rjer lto sbyar byas la/ sor mo lhag ma rnams bsdams nas rdo rje 'dra bar mdzub mo gnyis/ byas pa ni rnam par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor phyogs kyi byang phyogs/ phyag rgya'o/ /g.yas pa mchog sbyin du byas la g.yon pa mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i shāka thub kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang 'og phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la phyag rgya'o/

/rdo rje bsdams bcu drug po kun rig gi dkyil 'khor du dgos/ pa las mdzub mo gnyis gshib la brkyangs te rdo rje 'dra bar byas pa ni rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag rgya'o/ /rdo rje'i sems dpa'i/ de nyid las mdzub mo g.yas pa bkug pa ni lcags kyu'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las rgyal bo'i me tog ni mda' 'dra bar byas pa mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs nas mda' stong 'dra na ni mda'i chags pa/ phyag rgya'o/ /chags pa'i de nyid las slar bkug ste mthe bo'i rtse mo gnyis dang mdzub mo gnyis rtse sprad pa ni blo gros legs pa'o/ /legs pa'i de nyid las mdzub mo'i tshigs bar ma chag pa ni/ rin po che'i rin chen gyi de nyid las sor mo rnams 'od drug po/ zer 'dra bar bskyed pa ni gzi brjid kyi'o/ /gzi brjid kyi de nyid las spyi bor rang gi bzhag pa ni tog gi'o/ /de nyid las mdun du bzhag pa ni bzhad pa'o/ /bzhad pa'i/ de nyid las mdzub mo pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa ni pad+ma'o/ /de nyid las rtse mo gnyis bkug pa ni ral gri'o/ /ral gri'i de nyid las sor mo bcu po thams cad gdub bu 'dra bar byas pa ni 'khor lo'i'o/ /'khor lo'i/ de nyid las sor mo bzhi po rtse mo yid tsam pad+ma'i 'dab ma 'dra bar bya ba ni kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul byed lce'i 'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo rtse mo yid tsam bskyed pa ni rgya gram gyi'o/ /las kyi de nyid las mdzub mo shin tu bskyed pa ni bsrung res sor mo bdun char la'ang byed ba'i'o/ /de nyid las rtse mo gnyis slar bkug pa ni gnod sbyin gyi'o/ /nang du bkug pa ni bsdams pa'o/ /bsdams pa nyid mdun du bzhag pa ni 'di rnams lha la ston pa ste bdug pa la sogs pa brgyad yod pa'i dam thams cad du'obadug pa'i 'o/

/de nyid gyen du bstod pa ni 'phreng ba'i 'o/ /mdun du mthe bong gnyis mnyam ste bskor ba ni mar me'i 'o/ /de nyid las byug pa ltar byas pa ni dri'i 'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa ni lcags kyu'o sgo ba bzhi bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du dgos/ /de nyid las rtse mo gnyis sprad pa ni zhags pa'i 'o/ /de nyid las gcig la gcig mdud pa ni lcags sgrog gi'o/ /de nyid las bskyod pa ni mnyes pa'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa dngos grub kyi ye shes ni/ sku rten nas bris de la rab gnas bsnyen pa nye bsnyen bsgrub pa bsgrub chen bya gsungs/ gzugs shāka thub kyi cho ga yang 'dir de bzhin du byas te/ cung zad du na bcom ldan 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzugs kun rig gi go sar bzhag snga ma bzhin du yang na pad+mo'i rdzing bu sogs snga ma bzhin ltas te/ bri'o/ / de'i 'phreng las sngags lo ka gsum rgyal bris na de rnams kyi sngags kug tu gsung pa'i don der yang bstan par bya'o/ /yang sku gzugs ni dkyil 'khor gyi tshul du bris la/ me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ de'i spyan sngar 'bum tsam zhig dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bris na/ sngar bsnyen pa byas na las thams cad tshe 'das dbang bskur ba dang tshe 'das sdig pa sbyangs ba'i thabs rnams/ kha cig na med/ bya'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi skye rgyud bstan pa la gnyis/ dris pa dang / lan no/ dang po dris pa ni/ de nas tshang la sogs pas lha'i tshogs rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das las kyi rnam par smin pa gang gis lha'i bu dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bgyi ba dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyi dbang du gyur/ ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa lan ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes/
