bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /lha'i dbang po nyon cig 'di ni sngon gyi sgrib pa yin te/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi rigs 'di nyid na mtha' 'khob pa'i rigs ngan du gtogs pa'i rgyal po lus mi bde ba zhes bstan pa 'di'i gong ma gcig yin par 'og nas gsal bya ba zhig tu gyur te/ des mi shes pa'i dbang gis mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brten pas/ rgyal po 'dod pa'i mdzes pa'i rgyan na dri ma med pa'i skye rgyud dang ma skyes dgra'i gtam rgyud gnyis gcig par byas nas bsres te bstan pa dang / de gnyis mi gcig ste mdo nas bshad pa de shāka thub kyi bstan pa 'di nyid ma yin/ 'dir dri med kyi gtam rgyud ni dka' thub sangs rgyas kyi phyir rang gi pha 'tsho ba dang phral bar gyur pa dang / de'i mya ngan gyis gzir bas ma yang dus las 'das so/ /lan cig gi ji zhig gi rkyen gyis/ nags tshal stug po gzhan zhig tu rtse zhing dga' ba'i phyir der nye bar song ngo / /de na yang drang srong dgos pa med par rgyu med zer byams pa zhes bya ba zhig drang srong gnas te/ de ra tsa sa/ mthong ba dang rgyal drang srong la/ po shin tu ya mtshan skyes nas/ /kye ma 'di lta bu'i seng ge dang / stag dang ri dwags dang / phag rgod dang / ba glang dang / ma he la sogs pa dang / sbrul dang / sbre mong dang / sbrang bu dang / sbrang bu mchu ring dang / sbrul gdug pa rnams kyis gtses pa dang / bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / bgo ba dang / longs spyod rnams las rnam par bral ba rlung dang grangs bas yongs su gdung zhing / gces pa de na bdag nyid chen po 'di gnas so snyam par sems kyi rnam par btags nas/ de'i drung du nye bar song ste phyin nas de la 'di skad ces smra'o/ /drang srong chen po khyod ci'i phyir na/ rlung dang tsha ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis bdag rang la gnod par byed/

drang srong gis smras pa/ skyes bu chen po bskal pa du mar sgrib pa'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba las sdug bsngal gyi khur cung zad tsam zhig blangs nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar 'gyur bas 'di ni sdug bsngal ma yin gyi/ skad cig ma tsam mam yud tsam zhig yul gyi bde ba rjes su myong nas bskal ba brgya phrag stong du mar mthar thug pa med par dmyal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rjes su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /yul gyi bde ba 'dod pa'i phyir/ pha ma la sogs pa gsod par 'gyur na srog chags gzhan blta ci smos te/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun yongs su mi shes pa'i phyir/ sdig pa thams cad yongs su byed par 'gyur ro/ /drang srong gis smras pa'i tshig 'di dag thos pa dang / shin tu 'jigs skrag skyes te sdug bsngal thams cad kyis gzir nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun zhes bya ba de lta bu zhig de'i rang bzhin ci lta bu yin pa dka' thub chen pos smros shig dang / de la kho bo skyabs su mchi'am/ pha ma gtsos pa dang / srog chags rnams kyi srog bcad na sdig pa ci lta bu zhig thob par 'gyur/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun yongs su shes pa na bsod nams ci 'dra ba zhig thob/ pha ma ma bsad pa dang srog chags rnams kyang ma bsad nas bsod nams ci 'dra ba zhig thob/ 'bras bu ci 'dra ba cig thob/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod spangs na bsod nams dang 'bras bu ci 'dra ba zhig de nas drang srong des de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ci ste lan de pa bka' bsgo ba/ sems can chen po khyod nga'i tshig 'di nyan 'dod na thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshol la gus pas nyon dang bshad par bya'o/ /de bzhin bgyis khas blangs la/ zhes bsgrubs nas ni/ /rgyal pos drang srong de la ci bdog pa yis mchod byas nas/

/sangs rgyas spyod yul sangs rgyas kyi/ /zab mo'i chos 'di mnyan par bya/ /sangs rgyas chos sh+lau ka gsum po 'di drang srong gis rgyal po la bshad/ dang tshogs dag la/ /thos nas kyang ni skyabs su song / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgrib med chos/ /rgyal pos dga' bar 'gyur/ /yid dwags byol song dmyal ba rnams/ /sdig pa kun gyi 'bras bu ste/ /yul la spyod dang srog chags rnams/ /gsod cing shin tu mi zad rnams/ /pha ma gtses pa'i rgyu las byung / /bskal pa du mar sdug bsngal 'gyur/ /dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mi bzod par/ /mgon med skyabs kyang med pa ste/ /thos nas zhes drang srong gi bshad de mya ngan zug rngu yis/ / sngar gyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa'i don rang gi yid la bcags gyur nas/ /ji ltar rlung gi mar me bzhin/ /de nyid du ni dus 'das 'das/ /las kyi rnam smin de drang srong la mchod pa dang sngar chos thos la sngar yang pha ma bsad pa las 'gyod pa skyes pa'i las dge ba gnyis spyad pa dang sngon la byed pa dang 'chi khar spyad la sngon ma yin pa 'di phyi ma ltar yin no/ /yis ni/ /dga' dang ldan pa'i lhar skyes nas/ /brgya byin lha yi dbang po yi/ /blon po'i gzugs bya ba byed pas dri ma med pa rang la blon por btags dang ldan pa la/ /lha rnams kun dang yid mthun zhing / /rab dga' bde bar ldan par skye/ drang srong la bu rtsa byas pa dang chos thos pa dang sngar gyi las la 'gyod pa skyes nas/ bde ba'i mchog ni myangs gyur nas/ /ngan song du ni mi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten nas pha ma bsad pa'i las byas nas lhung bar 'gyur/ /de nas de ltar lha dbang po/ / brgya byin/ /khyod kyis mthus kyang de nyid kyis/ /yid la bcags par gsol btab nas/ /dga' ldan gnas nas dga' ba'i brgya byin gyis sngon kun rig nas bstan pa'i sdig pa sbyangs thabs rnams byas pas mchog

/bde ba kun gyi gnas su skyes/ /lha yi dbang po khyod nyon cig gang gi tshe sngon byung ba de'i dus na drang srong du gyur pa de ni gzhan yin par khyod kyis blta bar mi bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di nyid do/ /de'i phar gyur pa gang yin pa de ni gzhan yin par khyod kyi blta bar mi bya ste/ lha'i dbang po khyod de'i tshe de'i dus na phar gyur to/ /ma gang yin pa de ni gzhan yin par mi blta ste/ de'i tshe de'i dus sha tsi nyid yin no/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gang yin pa de ni gzhan par mi blta'i/ lha'i dbang po 'khor sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi lha 'di dag nyid do/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis/ phyag na rdo rje la 'khor de bzhin gshegs pas bskor ba dang / 'jig rten pas bskor ba'o/ /dang po phyag na rdo rje la 'khor de bzhin gshegs pas bskor ba la gnyis te/ gleng bslangs pa dang / gzhung ngo / /dang po gleng bslangs pa la gnyis/ 'khor gyis gleng bslangs pa dang / ston pas gleng bslangs pa'o/ /dang po 'khor gyi gleng bslangs pa ni/ de nas brgya byin dang 'dod khams kyi tshangs pa la sogs pa lha'i bu rnams yid rab tu dga' zhing rangs te/ ba spu bu kha nas spu rnams langs shing / rgyal rgyal ba zhes skad cher bos nas/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la ming bcu pa 'dis mngon par bstod gnod sbyin gyi cha lugs su bzhugs pa la gnod sbyin gyis gsol ba btab bo/ /ko khyod ni glang po'i rna ba can/ /khyod ni seng ge'i lta stangs can/ /khyod ni me lce 'bar ba can/ /khyod ni bden pa'i sprin yin te/ /khyod ni pha ltar slob pa yin/ khyod ni ma ltar slob pa yin/ khyod ni bstan pa'i sa yang yin/ /khyod ni chu bo'i gzhung yang yin/ tra k+ṣa sa dang po'i dngos nas/

ko tra sa gnyis pa/ sha la bha sbyin pa'i phar phyin/ ko ṭa sa gsum pa/ ko ṭa/ bzod pa/ ba sa bzhi pa/ sh+tsa/ brtson 'grus/ ki ti ra sa lnga pa/ ga bsam gtan/ ko la sa drug pa/ k+ṣa shes rab/ ko la sa bdun pa/ bha/ thabs/ stobs/ kā+o sa brgyad pa/ la kā+o sa dgu pa/ la/ smon lam/ bash+tsa sa bcu pa/ ka la thā ye shes kyi phar phyin/ ta thā/ a ti rdzogs pa'i don zhes nas/ brgya byin la sogs lha mchog rnams/ /sems can dus yun ring por kun la phan pa dang / /tshe dang nad med 'phel ba'i phyir/ /mgon po phyag na rdo rje khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /bcom ldan 'das tshe thung ba dang skal ba chung ba rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba dang / tshe bsring ba'i slad du bshad du gsol/ gsang ba'i bdag po bshad du gsol/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ston pas gleng bslangs pa'i ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa'i 'khor mang po de dag la legs so zhes bya bas mgu bar byas te/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i bu rnams gang khyed kyis 'di lta bu'i spobs pa yang dag par bskyed pa de ni legs so rang don/ legs so/ / gzhan don/ legs so pra ka'i don par sgrubs shig bshad par bya'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa gzhung la gsum/ sngags kyi 'phrang ba phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes thams cad kyi tshe dpag tu med pas khyab par 'byung ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas tshe snying po'i ming dang bsod nams sbyin pa la sogs dang ye shes kyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du rtogs pa zhes zer tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phel spel zer/

ba tshe ring don zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po 'di rang gi snying kha nas phyung ngo / /oṃ pu ṇ+ye puṇ+ya bsod nams gnyis/ ma hā puṇ+ya chen po'i bsod nams/ a pa ra mi ta dpag tu med pa'i bsod nams/ a yu puṇ+ya tshe bsod nams/ dzñā na ye shes/ sa bha ro pa tshogs/ tsa ya phyag na rdo rje'i dgos pa'i skabs go bar bya/ ka ri ni swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i gzungs 'di 'bring gcig lhag tsam po 'di dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bzlas pa'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /rang lha'i dang dkyil 'khor gcig tu cig car shes par bya'o/ /bshad ma thag tu ngan song thams cad rab tu zhi ste/ thugs kha'i hūm̐ las sngags las 'od 'phros nas/ sems can rgyas/ dmyal ba dang / byol song dang yi dwags rnams su skyes pa'i sems can thams cad grol bar bdag nyid kyis yang dag par rab tu shes so/ /sngar ston pa shāka thub kyis gsungs pa'i rtsa rgyud nas stong gsum gyi ngan song sbyang ba las ma gsungs pa'i phyi ma 'di nas lo ka'i khams thams cad kyi ngan song sbyangs pa nas mdzad pa rgya che bas na rtsa rgyud las kyang khyad par 'phags so/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas nas kyang / sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi yi ge de nyid sngar gyi 'od zer nyid thugs ka'i yi ge la bsdus pa'i don/ du bzhugs par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dpag tu med pa'i 'od ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i snying po'i gzungs 'di bshad do/ /tshe dpag med/ oṃ a mi tre/ a mi ta/ a mi tād bha wa/ a mi tra saṃ bha be/ bi kran te/ a mi ta/

bi kran ta ga mi/ sarba karma kle shā k+ṣa yaṃ ka ri swāhā/ de nas 'di bshad ma thag tu de bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rab tu zhi'o/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gdon mi za bar sgrib pa rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgrib pa gcod pa zhes bya ba'i snying po'i gzungs 'di rang gi snying kha nas phyung ngo / /oṃ mi bskyod par/ kaṃ ka ni/ kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ tra sa ni tra sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma a wa ra na/ pa raṃ pa ra ni me sarba satwa nan swāhā/ 'di bshad ma thag tu yang thams cad de bzhin du gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sgrib pa thams cad dri ma med cing rnam par dag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sgrib pa ma lus pa 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i snying po'i gzungs 'di rang gi thugs kha nas phyung ngo / /rin chen 'byung ldan/ oṃ rad ne rad ne/ ma hā rad ne/ rad na saṃ bha we/ rad na ki rad ne/ rat+na ma le/ bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ tra thā/ de nas 'di bshad ma thag tu bdud kyi gnas thams cad bcom mo/ /rnam par bcom par gyur to/ /de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gdon mi za bar chom pa sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i gzungs 'di rang gi thugs kha nas phyung ngo / /don yod grub pa/ oṃ a mo gha/ a tra ni ha ta/ sarba a ba rat+na/ bi na sha ni/ ha ra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags 'di bshad ma thag tu 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad g.yos rab tu g.yos/ bskyod/ rab tu bskyod/ yang dag par bskyod/ rab tu bskyod/ bsgul rab tu bsgul nas/ smad kyi shar phyogs mtho na nub phyogs dma' ba la sogs pa ya mtshan 'jig rten du snang bar gyur to/

/zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang slob ma dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po slob dpon gyi las la gnyis/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po bri zhing lha dgod pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i gnas dang sa chog kun rig ltar de'i dkyil 'khor ni 'di yin te/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /sgo dang yang dag ldan pa ste/ /rta babs bzhi dang ldan par bya/ /lte ba dang ni mu khyud ldan/ /de yi dbus su 'khor lo ni/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bya ste/ /rtsibs bzhi pa dang ldan pa la/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor ldan par bya/ /de yi dbus su gtso bo ni/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs chen po/ /phyag na rdo rje dril bsnams shing / /zla ba rgyas pa'i zhal 'dzum dkar po lha thams cad kyi zhal mdog bri/ /shar gyi rtsibs kyi steng du ni/ /mgon po mi bskyod bri bar bya/ /lho yi phyogs su rin chen 'byung ldan bri/ /nub phyogs chu skyes dam pa la/ 'od dpag med/ /byang sogs su ni gdon mi za don yod grub pa/ /dpa' bo spang bya 'joms pa la stobs chen bri bar bya/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ni/ /'khor los dka' thub kyi cha lugs min/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bsgyur ba'i cha lugs dang / /zla lha lnga char dkar ba'i dkyil 'khor mdog 'dra zhing / /dbu rgyan sogs rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa dang / /phyag ta thā bzhi char ni g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon mi 'jigs dang / /rdo rje skyil mo krung bzhugs bri/ /grwa lhas snam gyi/ yi phyogs ni kun tu yang / de bzhin bdug pa la sogs shāka thub dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i sngags kyis/ bri/ /sgo ba dag sngags shāka thub dkyil 'khor nas/ kyang khros pa las/ /khro bo'i dbang du gyur pa bri/

/zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa bstan pa ni/ khrus sngon du song bas rdzas dag de nas rnal 'byor can zhes pa 'di dkyil 'khor thams cad du slob dpon bdag 'jug sngon du lha'i rnal 'byor bstan/ nyid bzhugs/ / slob ma 'jug pa bzhin/ sngags kyi lha rnams spyan drangs te/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bha ga wan e h+ya hi sa ma ya satwaṃ/ de nas gtso bo byon mu dra bstan dgug gzhug bya pa dang / /mdor na mchod pa dang bstod pa gtor ma/ byas nas kyang / /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas slob ma lha gnas/ 'chi bdag ma yi ni srog gcod pa dang 'dra/ sbrul gyi 'jigs ldan rnams/ /spyir bdud sogs 'chi bdag gzhom phyir bzhugs par bya/ /oṃ 'dir 'jug sngags badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ rdo rje gdong bcings pa sogs 'jug pa'i khrigs kun rig bzhin/ ti rin ti ri bcing / rdo rje bsdam pa nang du bcing / /lag na rin chen thogs de nas ye shes pa gzhug de nas 'og gi dam la bzhag pa bya/ te bzhugs/ /yang na me tog 'phreng ba ste/ /de ni dkyil 'khor nyid du dor/ /oṃ kun rig ltar sangs rgyas go 'phang thob bya'i phyir sogs kyi pra ti tsa badz+ra hūm̐/ de nas mna'i dam tshig sbyin par bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya kun rig gi a sa me dri sa me ma hā sa ma'i dod ye shes dbab pa'i rjes la bya'o/ /hūm̐/ de nas 'dis gdong g.yogs dkrol bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ha s+ya ud ga ṭa ya hūm̐ 'di la gong ma gnyis su'ang shes par bya'o/ /de nas 'dis dkyil 'khor bstan par bya ste/ oṃ 'di yang gong du yang dgos/ badz+ra pa sh+ya ho/ dam tshig bsgrag cing sdom pa 'bog pa kun rig bzhin bya/ de nas dbang bskur rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan 'dis bar bya'o/ /oṃ dkyil 'khor bcu gcig po thams cad du dgos/

badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa dkyil 'khor 'dir spyi gtsug ta thā ga tas gtso byas pa'i dkyil 'khor du ni sngags 'og mas spyi gtsug du'o/ /ta thā lnga'i cod pan dngos su rang gis 'ching / hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hri/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣits+tsha a/ de nas bum pa rnam rgyal bum pa kun rig ltar dbang bskur ba'i bum pa lnga las sngar kun rig tu bzlas pa'am 'di kha cig na med/ rang gi snying po bzlas pa'i dbang bskur ba bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ ta tha'i dkyil 'khor ni sngon la des 'gre/ bud+dha ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ rat+na ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ pad+ma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hriḥ oṃ karma ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ de nas rin po che'i cod pan 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ rat+na ma la a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐ tram̐ tram̐ tram̐ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra pa tra dar dpyangs/ tra a ba la ba na a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ bud+dha mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ pad+ma mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hriḥ.oṃ karma mu tra a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ oṃ badz+ra na ma a bhi ṣiñtsa 'og tu bzhi dang sbyar/ hūm̐/ oṃ tram̐ hri oṃ bud+dha na ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ de bzhin du sbyar/ aḥ oṃ badz+ra karma slob ma'i lag tu sna tshogs rdo rje sbyin/ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ a/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra lag tu tsakra sbyin slob ma'i rgyud la sprul bshad dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i nus pa 'jog a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bh+rum̐/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra a dhi pa ti tsakra rat+na pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa slob ma'i lag tu gtad/ bdag po'i dbang rigs thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor slob dpon byed nus pa slob ma'i rgyud la 'jog satwam̐/ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ/ bud+dha sogs so sor sbyar

/hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ tram̐ tram̐ tram̐/ hri hri hriḥ a a a/ oṃ badz+ra gzungs kyi dbang sngags kyi dbang bskur rnams ma brjed par gyis shig pa/ dha ra na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ ta thā ga ta dha ra na a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ rat+na dha ra na a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ pad+ma dha ra na a bhi ṣiñtsa hri/ oṃ karma dha ra na a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ oṃ gsang dbang sngags te sngags kyi dbang bskur rnams su rung la ma smra zhig gsang sngags gsang bas bsgrub pa'o/ /ta thā ga ta ghu h+ye a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghu h+ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ rat+na ghu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ pad+ma ghu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hri/ oṃ karma ghu h+ye a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ oṃ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang rtags rdo rje dril bu byin pa sngar gyi de thams cad thabs shes gnyis med kyis zin par gyis shig pa'o/ /pra dzñā u pa sa ma yo ga a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ a/ zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa ni/ de ltar dbang bskur nas/ tshe bsrings pa'i rig pa bla ma'i thugs ka nas slob ma'i khar/ 'di sbyin no/ /oṃ bh+rum̐ badz+ra sngar gyi puṇ+ya la btags/ a yu she hūm̐ a/ de'i bsgrub pa lha sum cu me tog gang la phog pa'am yang na phyag rdor rnal 'byor byas la 'di yin te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje tshe dpag med zla ba'i 'od can/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhugs shing / rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas/ gnyis mi 'jigs pa dang g.yon/ mchod sbyin mdzad pa las bdud rtsi 'dzag pa bri'o/ /de'i 'og tu bsgrub pa po lag pa thal mo sbyar la gdong gyen du bcom ldan 'das la blta ba bris la/ ras bris la/ mchod pa rnam pa lngas spyan dbye kun rig ltar/ mchod pa/ de'i spyan ltar 'bum mtshon pa ste mtshan ma thob bo/ /lha bcu gsum me tog gang la phog gam rdo rje'i/ phrag tshang bar bzla bar bya'o/

/de nas zla ba nya ba dang / mchod pa chen po 'byor tshad/ byas la/ ba dmar ser gyi mar snod gser dngul las byas pa'i gsar par bcug pa rdo rje thog ma rang gi lag pa/ g.yon pas mnan pa/ bcom ldan 'das la kyi phyag gi bdud rtsi snod nang du 'dzag pa rab tu sems shing las sbyor la/ mtshan gcig thog thag tu bzlas pa bya'o/ /de nas dri mnam zhing sngon ma byung ba'i ngad ldang ngam/ brlang pa'am/ du ba'am/ me byung ngam/ 'od zer ram/ me sgron nam/ 'od byung ngam/ de la sogs pa'i ta tha'i zhal 'dzum mthong ngam/ me tog gi char 'bab pa'am/ rnga sgra'am dril bu'i sgra mtshan ma byung na/ mar me snod nang gi rten de'i mar gsar pa'am/ til mar ram/ chu'am/ 'o ma'am/ zho'am/ chang ngam/ khrag gam/ zhag gam/ klad pa'am/ sha'am 'di tsho dang bsres la yang na sngar gyi snod de'i nang du 'di rnams gang rung gi rten gcig 'jug pa'o/ /gang yang rung ba la rab tu bsgrub/ nangs par snga bar bsrung ba la sogs pa byas nas bdag bsrung na nas bsrung / bdag nyid sbyangs sngar gyi rten de mar yin na mar gyi sbyang / sha yin na sha'i sbyangs bar du bya'o/ /yang na rten ba dmar ser gyi mar la mar gsar nas sha'i bar gang rung gi sbyangs la te 'thungs sam zos na/ mtshan ma ji lta ba bzhin byung na ni/ nam zla ba dang nyi ma yod kyi bar du tshe ring zhing rdo rje dang mtshungs par 'gyur te/ tha mas rtags tha ma la dngos grub tha ma 'grub par kun rig nas bstan pa ltar/ ni tha ma 'grub pas 'di la the tshom med do/ /mtshan ma byung na'ang 'jig rten na nad med shes rab che ba'i don lob rkyen/ lus la skra dkar dang gnyer ma med par 'gyur/ lus brtan zhing tshe lo brgya thub par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang bzlas pa byas tsam gyis zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang la sogs las rnams brtag mi dgos par 'grub par 'gyur te/

the tshom med do/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa phyag na rdo rje la 'khor 'jig rten pas bskor ba la drug ste/ rgyal po chen po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor/ phyogs skyong bcu'i dkyil 'khor/ gza' chen brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor/ klu chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor/ 'jigs byed brgyad chung ma dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor/ lha chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa'o/ /dang po phyag na rdo rje la 'khor rgyal po chen po bzhis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor la gsum/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba/ dbang bskur ba'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba ni/ de nas 'di nas mar dkyil 'khor drug gam lo ka 'di thams cad ni sngon gyi 'khor lo lha'i rgyal po chen po bzhis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gnang ba nod cing byin gyis brlabs pa ston/ bdag cag kyang sems can thams cad kyi don dang / phan pa lus sems dag dang / bde ba'i slad du rang rang gi snying po bshad par 'tshal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje 'dzin pas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rgyal po chen po dag legs kyi shod cig dang / ngas kyang rjes su yi rangs zhing byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ngal gsos po sa dang por ngal gsos nas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs par byed pas/ kha cig na med/ la bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang zhing lha bskyed pa mu dra bsten pa dkyil 'khor du bkod pa bum pa la zlos pa dbang bskur ba rnams la dgos/ des lo ka'i dkyil 'khor kyi sngags des 'gre'o/ /ming gi yi ge dang po smos so/ /rjes su yi rangs te/ byin gyis brlabs pas rang rang gi snying po 'di rang rang gi snying kha nas phyung ngo /

/oṃ shra man/ bai/ sha ba na/ de nas dri za'i rgyal po gnas bsrung yul 'khor bsrung pos kyang / rang gi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ dhi/ de nas grul bum gyi rgyal po 'phags skyes pos kyang rang gi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ bhi/ de'i klu'i rgyal po mig bzang gis kyang rang gi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ k+ṣa zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /dang po slob dpon gyi las la gnyis/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / slob dpon bzhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po bri zhing lha dgod pa ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi dang / dkyil 'khor lhas phye na bzhi dbus dang lnga mtshams bzhi ste dgu/ mtshams na lha med lngas ni brgyan pa ste/ /de yi dngos su gtso bo ni/ /phyag na rdo rje 'gying bcing bri/ 'dir tsakra yang bsgyur/ /de yi g.yon gyi phyogs su ni/ /ngal gso dge ba'i lag pa na/ /be con g.yon/ ne'u le g.yas/ thogs pa dang / /rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /sbom zhing seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gser mdog gzi chen ldan par bri/ /mkhas pas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bkod pa ste de ltar skul byed na gzhan/ bum pa bzang la sogs/ /sku las rin chen chu bo 'bab pa bri/ /mdun du gnas bsrung de nyid ni/ /pi waṃ byed la lon zer/ brtson pa dang / /mdzes pa'i kha dog ljang khu ste/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan pa bri/ /g.yas phyogs dpa' bo lus 'phags po/ mdog cung zad khros pa/ /ral gri lag par thogs par bri/ /nub phyogs su ni mig mi bzang / mdog dmar skya/ /rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa'i mchog /sbrul mgo g.yas na gsum bsgrengs g.yon na gsum bsgrengs dbus na gcig ste/

bdun gyis bskor ba las/ /mig kyang dmar zhing shin tu 'bur/ /sgo bzhi'i phyogs ni thams cad du/ /shāka thub dkyil 'khor du bstan pa'i sngar gyi lo ka las 'das pa'i sgo ba rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob dpon bzhugs te bsgrub pa ni/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya 'dzin ma zhes bya bas/ /sngags mkhan nyid ni bzhugs pa 'jug pa 'dra dang / /bcom ldan 'das ni spyan drangs ye shes sems dpa' te/ /de nas rgyal po spyan drangs dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ.e h+ya he la rang gi snying po btags pa'i des lo ka ba'i dkyil 'khor kun la 'gre/ ngo / /spyan drangs nas ni mkhas pas mchod/ pa lnga dang brgyad/ /cho ga bzhin du mchod pa dbul/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni/ de nas sngags mkhan slob ma lha gnas 'gre sngags 'di dang / /rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya 'dis/ /slob ma rgyal rigs rje rigs sam/ /bram ze la sogs de bzhin te/ /slob ma me tog rin chen thogs te bzhugs/ kun rig ltar/ /dkyil 'khor 'jug sngags oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐/ de nas me tog rin po che 'dis dor bar bya'o/ /oṃ pra ti dza bha ma ho ta ma/ gang la bab pa'i rgyal po ni/ /de ni 'dis 'grub gzhan du min/ /de nas grwa dkyil 'khor gyi/ na bzhag pa yi/ /bum pa bzhi rnam rgyal dang lngas/ ni rang sngags la a bhi ṣiñtsa btags la lo ka ba'i dkyil 'khor kun 'gre'o/ /dbang bskur te/ /dang po phyag na rdo rje yi/ /phyag rgya'i dbang ni cod paṇa sems bskur bar bya/ /de la sogs pa'i go rim kun rig dang phyag rdor dkyil 'khor du/ gyis/ /dkyil 'khor nyid du dbang bskur na/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dbang bskur ba'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ rgyal po ma yin rgyal por 'gyur/ /rgyal po yin na che bar 'gyur/

/'dzam bu gling la dbang byed pa'i dpal dang ldan/ par gyur/ /gling bzhi pa la dbang ba'i mchog /lan bzhir dbang ni bskur rgyal chen bzhi la rims gyis me tog dor/ ba dang / /lan bzhir rgyal po bzhi'i dkyil 'khor du/ gzhug pa byas nas ni/ /de la rdo rje 'dzin rgyal bdag /bu sdug bzhin du bskyang bar bgyi/ /bdag cag rgyal po chen po bzhi/ /'bangs spyir khas blangs pa dang 'khor du bcas pa dang / /pho brang 'khor du bcas pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor der zhugs pa'i/ rgyal po rtag tu bskyang bar bgyi/ /ded dpon gzhan gyi phru ma dang / /de yi nad dang 'chi bdag gi /'jigs dang mu ge la sogs pa'i/ /gnod pa rnams ni gzhom par bgyid/ /bye brag tu khas blangs pas/ ngal gsos pos ni rgyas par bgyid/ rnam thos bus/ /yul 'khor bsrung gis zhi bar bgyid/ /phyugs dang gnyen bcas dus min pa'i/ /'chi bdag lus 'phags po yis 'joms/ /mig mi bzang gi bkra shis shing / /mu ge la sogs rnam par 'joms/ /mdor na bdag gi de yi ni/ /de dang bsam pa kun gyi ste/ /ci ste nges pa ma lags na/ /lag na rdo rje khus par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa phyag na rdo rje la phyogs skyong bcus bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba/ snying po'i rjes su gnang ba byin te bsgrub pa bstan pa/ phyogs skyong rnams kyis bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba ni/ de nas phyogs skyong rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan bdag cag rnams kyis kyang sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba'i slad du rang rang gi snying po dbul bar bgyi'o/ /'jig rten skyong ba rnams legs so rang don/ legs so gzhan don/ /legs par phul cig rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don/

de nas 'byung po rnams kyi bdag po dbang ldan la sogs pas rang rang gi snying po rnams phul ba/ oṃ sho na/ i/ dbang ldan/ oṃ na tra/ i/ brgya byin/ oṃ me lha/ a/ ga ni/ oṃ ma ya/ ya/ gshin rje/ oṃ ri ti/ ni/ srin po/ oṃ chu lha/ bi/ ru na/ oṃ wa ya be/ ya rlung lha/ bi ra/ oṃ gnod sbyin/ ku oṃ pa ri ra/ a/ nyi ma/ oṃ ha ma/ pra/ sa bdag zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ slob dpon kyi las dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /dang po las kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / zhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po bri zhing lha dgod pa ni/ de nas de dag dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkas bshad de/ dkyil 'khor yang shāka thub ltar tsakra snga ma bzhin bsam la/ /mgon phyag rdor bzhi ba/ de bzhin dbus su bzhag phyogs skyong rang gi shar du brgya byin ser po glang po la bzhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug pa 'dzin sogs/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa rin po che 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar po ra la zhon pa dbyug gu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po nag po mi la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha ljang sngon sha ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ phyogs gnas su/ /bzhag bya spyan sngar nyi ma dmar po rta la zhon pa nyi ma 'dzin pa/ nyi ma dang / /phag gi gzugs dang gnyis bzhag sa bdag g.yon pa sa bdag phag mgo can pi wam̐ sgreng ba/ te/ /sgo ba rnams kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes pas bstan/

gnyis pa bzhugs te bsgrub pa ni/ de nas spyan drangs de kun la/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod par bya/ /de nas bdag nyid bzhugs nas kyang / /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga ni/ slob ma rnams ni gzhug bya zhing / /phyogs skyong rang gi sngags btab pa'i/ /bum pa bcu gcig po/ rnams kyi dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa snying po'i rjes su gnang ba byin te bsgrub par bstan pa ni/ de nas phan par 'dod pa yis/ /slob ma bsgrub phyin snying po sbyin par bya/ /gtso bo rnal 'byor byas la phyogs skyong rang gi 'khor sngags btab ste bzlas la de la lo ka'i dkyil 'khor 'gre'o bcas rnams/ /brtag mi dgos par 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa phyogs skyong rnams kyis bstan par bsrung bar khas blangs pa la gnyis/ spyir khas blangs pa dang bye brag tu khas blangs pa'o/ /dang po spyir khas blangs pa ni/ de nas de dag mgu spyir phyogs rnams kyi bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs/ nas ni/ /'di skad tshig lhug par yod rkang pa gnyis po 'di/ ces ni tshig gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing / rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs te dbang bskur thob pa'i gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa de dag bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis rtag tu dus thams cad du bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi phru ma kun gzhom par bgyi'o/ /'bru dang me tog dang 'bras bu rnams bskyed par bgyi'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bye brag khas blangs pa ni/ de nas bye brag tu khas blangs pa la brgya byin gyi me lha gnyis ka chad chos kyi rgyal po gshin rjes/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kun la yod bdag cag gis kyang /

rgyal po chen po de'i tshe bsring bar bgyi'o/ /dus ma lags par 'chi ba brgyad po so sor dgag par bgyi'o/ /srin po rnams kyi bdag po chen po ni ri nyis kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang rgyal po de dag dang / rgyal po'i bu dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs/ mi'i gzhan gang yang rung ba dag la/ nad dang / yi dwags dang / 'dres mi 'jigs par bgyi'o/ /srin po la sogs pas 'jigs pa mi bgyi/ dus ma lags pa'i 'chi ba dag gis kyang 'jigs par mi bgyi ste/ dus thams cad du bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /de nas klu'i rgyal po ba ru nas kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang / rtag par dus thams cad du rgyal po de dang / yul thams cad du so sor bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /kun tu bsrung bar bgyi/ 'bru rnams bskyed par bgyi/ klu'i nyes pa rnams mi 'byung bar bgyi/ dug dang ser ba rnams mi 'bab par bgyi/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba rnams so sor dgag par bgyi'o/ /de nas rlung gi bdag pos kyang 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang sems can de la dus thams cad du rlung gi 'jigs pa thams cad mi 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /dus ma lags pa'i rlung mi 'byung bar bgyi'o/ /'bru dang me tog dang 'bras bu thams cad bskyed par bgyi'o/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi bdag po ku bhe ras kyang bcom ldan la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang lhan cig tu mchis te/ stobs dang ldan pas sems can chen po de dag la dus thams cad du 'jigs pa thams cad so sor dgag par bgyi'o/ /nor dang 'bru thams cad legs par 'byor bar bgyi'o/ /rang gi skye bo dang yongs kyi skye bo dang / yul dang / gnas dang / bran dang / snag gnyen dang / rus kyi gnyen dang / grogs dang /

bu dang / bu mo dang / chung ma la sogs pa bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /glang dang / ba dang / bong bu dang / rnga mo dang / lug dang / ma he dang / ba glang dang / rta dang / ra la sogs pa yang bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /de nas 'byung po thams cad kyi bdag po dang / dbang byed kyis kyang / bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang / rgyal po de dang / rgyal po de dag gi bu dang / rgyal rigs dang / bram ze'i rigs rnams 'di dang pha rol tu yongs su skyabs pa dang / phan gdags pa dang / yongs su bskyang ba dang / zhi ba dang / bkra shis pa dang / chad pa spangs pa dang / mtshon cha spangs pa dang / dug zhi ba dang / dug gzhom pa dang / mtshams bcad pa dang / sa'i 'og gi mtshams bcad pa dang / phyogs kyi mtshams bcad pa dang / rdo rje ra bas bskor ba dang / rdo rje phur pas gdab pa dang / rdo rje'i dra ba rnams bre bar bgyi/ legs pa'i dgos pa thams cad las nye bar gnas par nges par bgyi/ dgos pa dang dgos pa ma lags pa rnams kyi mtshan ma nye bar gnas par bgyi/ dge ba dang mi dge ba thams cad rmi lam du yang bsgom par bgyi/ bsgrub na yang bgegs ma mchis par bgyi/ dngos grub thams cad stsal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas yang nam mkha'i bdag po nam mkha' la longs spyod pa rnams kyis kyang / bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang dus thams cad du rgyal po de dang / rgyal po'i bu dang / rgyal po'i blon po dang / bram ze dang / rgyal rigs rnams 'jigs pa thams cad las bdag nyid 'khor thams cad dang bcas par mchis la/ bsrung ba dang / skyabs pa dang / sba bar bgyi/ mchog thams cad rab tu bstan par bgyi/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyi/ dus thams cad du phyi bzhin du 'brang bar bgyi'o/ /de nas sa 'og gi bdag po phag chen pos kyang / bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/

/bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang mi'i bdag po de dang / mi'i bdag po'i bu dang yang na lan gnyis su 'byung ba'i bu srang gzung khas blang pa dam bcas pa sems kyi bu/ bu dang / lan grangs gnyis su 'byung ba'i bu rigs kyi bu srang bzung gi bu nyes pa'i bu de gsum las dang po ni rang gi bu rigs ma 'chol ba gnyis pa 'phrang ka nas 'dug pa'i byis pa pha ma dang bral ba dag gi byas pa gsum po ngo yi blangs pa ste gsum las 'dir tha ma gnyis la bya'o/ /kha cig na med/ dang / rgyal rigs dang / rje'u'i rigs dang / dmangs rigs sam/ gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dad pa rnams kyi dus thams cad du don thams cad bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad las dus thams cad du bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid kyis kyang yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa phyag na rdo rje la gza' chen brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba bsgrub pa/ bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba ni/ de nas gza' chen po brgyad dang / 'khor rgyu skar dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang / bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi gsang sngags kyi snying po rnams 'bul bar 'tshal na/ de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ legs so/ /legs so/ /ngas byin gyis brlab kyis gza' chen po rnams shod cig de nas nyi ma la sogs pa'i gza' chen po rnams kyis/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /oṃ ar+ya re/ ā/ nyi ma/ oṃ 'o ma/ so/ zla ba/ oṃ am̐ gu ra ga oṃ/ mig dmar/ oṃ bhu ta/ bha/ lhag pa/ oṃ bhi ha ri ta/

bh+ri/ phur ba/ oṃ ku tra/ shu/ pa wa sangs/ oṃ sa ni tsa ra/ sa/ spen pa/ oṃ ra hu la/ ra/ sgra gcan/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po slob dpon gyi las la gnyis/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / bzhugs te lha bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po bri zhing lha dgod pa ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ phyi gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs dang bcas pa'i nang du lha rnams zlum po de'i nang du ka gdung gi thig btab pas phyogs bzhir gru bzhi mtshams bzhi gru bzhi'o/ /yang na pho brang yang na lha rnams gru bzhi ste gong ma bzhin no/ /dbus su bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje nyid/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i gzugs bri'o/ / oṃ badz+ra satwa sogs dkyil 'khor bstan pa'i sngags kyi/ ngos rnams su ni gtso bo'i phyogs bzhi ru shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu pad+ma/ byang du rgya gram/ phyag rgya chen po bzhi bri'o/ /'di thams cad 'bru 'grel nas bshad pa sku mdog dang phyag mtshan rdzogs par bris pa'am yang na kun rig nas bshad pa ltar ming ngam brda'am thig le bri ba gang rung ngo / pa wa sangs ni mdun dar du mdog dkar po stan nang tshang can la 'dug pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing shing thog thogs pa/ du la/ /zla ba rgyab tu mdog dkar po ut+pal thogs pa ngang pa la bzhon pa nub bri bar bya/ /g.yas su phur bu mdog dkar po zla ba gnas pa g.yas po ti g.yon chos 'chad pa'i tshig 'dren pa'i stod g.yogs ser po/ bri bya zhing / /g.yon par gza' lag mdog ser po g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon ut+pal la stan nang tshang can rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ bri bar bya/ /me lha'i phyogs su mig dmar mdog dmar po g.yas bum pa chu'i gzugs can g.yon 'bum me stan nang tshang /

dang / /rlung gi phyogs su nyi ma mdog dmar ser gyi ya lad can gyon pa lag na pad+ma rta la zhon pa ste/ /dbang ldan phyogs su spen pa mdog nag rgyan med pa/ skra bshigs pa/ dbyug tho thogs pa/ stan nang tshang can la 'dug pa 'o/ bri zer/ /srin po'i phyogs su sgra gcan mdog dud kha/ bzhin bris pa la mche ba gtsigs pa/ skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ sked pa man chad du sbrul du bri/ kha cig na ni sked pa man chad sprin gseb na 'dug pa bri zer/ bri/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor 'khor yug lha snam zlum po bum smin drug dmar po bum pa la gnas pa/ snar ma ljang khu bum pa la zhon pa/ mgo ser po sha ba la zhon pa/ lag dmar po sbrul la zhon pa/ nab so ser po pad+ma la 'dug pa/ rgyal ljang khu bum pa la 'dug pa/ skag ljang khu bya rog la 'dug pa/ mchu ser po me tog la 'dug pa/ bre dkar po pad+ma la 'dug pa/ dbo ljang khu khri la 'dug pa/ me bzhi ser po glang po che la zhon pa/ nag pa ljang khu rma bya la zhon pa/ sa ri dmar po spyang mo la zhon pa/ sa ga ljang khu ra dkar po la zhon pa/ lha mtshams ser po bya rog la zhon pa/ snron dmar nang tshang can la 'dug pa/ snub ljang khu rus sbal la zhon pa/ chu stod ser po nang tshang can la 'dug pa/ chu smad ljang khu mi snying la 'dug pa/ byi bzhin dkar po nang tshang can la 'dug pa/ gro bzhin ser po skur ma/ mon bre dmar po nang tshang can la 'dug pa/ mon gru ljang khu glang glang khyu ba gcig la zhon pa/ khrum smad ser po gser khri la 'dug pa/ nam gru dmar po rta la zhon pa/ tha skar ljang khu mi snying la 'dug pa/ bra nye ser po 'khor ma 'dug pa'o/ /tu/ /rgyu skar thams cad nyer brgyad phyogs rer bdun bdun bri bar bya/ /sgo bzhir de bzhin 'das pa'i/ sgo ba rnams/ /khros pa'i yid du lha zhe gcig pa'i dkyil 'khor rtsa ba'i dgu

bri bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bzhugs te lha bsgrub pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin mas bzhugs nas ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa/ /thams cad dgug gzhug nas gtor ma'i bar 'gre'o kyang ni spyan drang ngo / /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas slob ma rnams gzhug ste/ oṃ badz+ra 'jug pa/ ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ gra ha pra ti me tog dor ba/ tsa sa ma ye hūm̐ phaṭ/ de nas gza' brgyad phyag rdor dang dgu/ sngags btab pa'i/ /bum pa brgyad kyis dbang bskur ro/ /rdo rje'i phyag rgyas cod paṇa sems dbang bskur te/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa bsgrub pa ni/ gza' rnams thams cad bsgrub par gtso bo'i sngags la btags la/ bya'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa ni/ de nas gza' chen po de dag gis/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gza' chen po brgyad kyis kyang / rgyal po chen po de dang / rgyal po de'i bu la rtag par dus thams cad du de bzhin bgyi'o/ /de nas rgyu skar dang / nyin zhig gi drug cu cha la dbang byed pas/ skad dbyug gu dang / cig dbang / dang /yud tsam dbyug gu drug cu cha la dbang byed pas chu srang dang / thang chu srang drug cu cha la dbang byed pas dbugs cig dang / dus la dbang byed pa dang / lo gcig gi cha bzhi cha ste dbyar lta bu ste zla tshigs zla ba bcu gnyis kyi mtshams su dang / sbyor ba bkra shis la sogs pa nyer bdun dang / khyim karka tra la sogs pa bcu gnyis dang dus skar ma dang 'byor ba gza' rnams kyi mtshams sbyor 'byor zer dang / gsum po de ṭa ki dang gdan bzhi nas bshad pa ltar 'jug gza' rnams kyi mtshams gtso bo/ 'tshol gza' brgyad la sogs pa'i gza' rgyu skar gyi tshogs/

dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams skad cig la sogs pa la dbang byed pa'i lha rnams te dkyil 'khor la ma bkod kyang gza' rgyu skar yod pas shugs la 'byung ba yin no/ /kyis kyang de bzhin du phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang / dus thams cad du sems can chen po de'i bka' mi bcag ste/ dpon po bzhin du bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong brdal dang / ljongs dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang gi gnas thams cad so sor bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa chen po 'byung ba'i tshe yang / des bdag cag mchod na gdon mi 'byung bar 'jigs pa mi 'byung ngo / /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa klu chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la gsum/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa/ dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba ni/ de nas klu chen po brgyad kyis phuḥ klu rang skad/ zhes pa'i sgras/ bcom ldan 'das mnyes par byas te/ 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang de dag thams cad kyi gsang ba'i snying po rnams 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /klu chen po rnams legs kyi/ gsang ba'i snying po rnams phul cig de nas de dag mgu nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa 'di skad ces gsol to/ /oṃ mtha' yas/ phuḥ a nan+ta/ oṃ 'jog po/ pham̐/ tak+ṣa ka 'di gong na yod/ oṃ rigs ldan/ pha/ rigs ldan ku li ka oṃ nor rgyas/ phī/ ba su ki oṃ dung skyong / phe shing kha zer/ oṃ pad+ma/ phaiṃ/ chu lha/ oṃ ba sha phau/ ba ru ṇa/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba/ phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa la gnyis/

dbang bskur ba dang / phan yon no/ /dang po dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las chog dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po slob dpon gyi las chog la gnyis/ bri zhing lha dgod pa la sogs pa dang / zhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po bri zhing lha dgod pa ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor 'di la gru bzhi sgo bzhi lha snam dang sgo ba med dam/ bshad de/ pad+ma chen po 'dab brgyad pa/ /kha dog dkar po bri bar bya/ /de yi dbus su gtso bo ni/ /phyag na rdo rje zhi ba puṇ+ye'i sngags kyi rab gnas pa/ /sbrul mgo mtha' yas gdengs ka yis/ /ltos 'gro chen po spyi bor mtha' yas/ rna bar 'jog po/ mgrin par chu lha/ dpung par rigs ldan/ se ral kha stobs rgyu/ lag pa la nor rgyas/ ske rags la dung skyong / rkang pa la pad+ma/ bcom ldan 'das kyang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas sngo ljang du bri'o/ /sdig pa bri/ /mtha' yas shar du sngon po/ 'jog po lhor/ dmar po gnyis/ de bzhin du/ /kar ko ṭa nub tu ljang khu gsum dang rigs ldan dang / byang du khro bo bzhi dang / /nor rgyas bu dang dkar po shar lhor lnga/ dung skyong ba su ki zer/ dang / lho nub tu ser po drug /pad+ma chu lha byang du dmar po bdun/ de bzhin du/ 'dir thams cad nam mkha' dri med dang 'bru 'grel na lha so so ba med par thams cad dkar po/ /mdor na 'dab ma re re la/ /de dag sbrul mgo 'bar ba bri/ /sbrul mgo bdun rna ba g.yas g.yon gsum gsum spyi gtsug dang chung ma rnams ni kha dog mthun pa la sbrul mgo gsum yin no zer/ bdun chung ma yi/ /mgul nas 'khyud dang bcas pa bri/ / yab rnams ni g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum rnams ni g.yon pas ut+pal 'dzin pa gnyis ka'i g.yon gyis ni phun 'bul ba na 'khyud pa'o/ /bum pa brgyad dang gtor ma klu brgyad kyi sngags kyis btab pa dang /

/bshos mdzes pa dang 'byung po gtor ma bshams yi/ /mar dang mngar gsum/ 'o ma sbrang rtsir bcas/ /byas pa rnams ni bcu rnams mchod pa'i don du/ bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bzhugs te bsgrub pa ni/ de nas rdo rje bdag nyid bzhugs/ /sbrul mgos sbrul mgo can rnams dgug /phu zhes kyi mgo drangs nas bar du snying po bcug dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥmatha' rten du bya bas lhan cig tu/ /dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod do/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas bu ni rgyal po dang / /rgyal rigs thams cad rab sprugs nas/ /dug gi phyi nang gi nyes skyon bsal ba'i phyir/ /phu yis mgo drangs snying po bar du bcug pa a bhi ṣiñtsa mtha' rten la bum pa brgyad gtso bo dang dgu zhes bya bas dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa phan yon ni/ de nas ming tsam brjod pas kyang / /klu rnams de dag thams cad 'grub/ /de nas de dag kun mgu nas/ /bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ /spyan sngar thal mo sbyar 'khod nas/ /smon lam rab tu 'debs par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das cag gis bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba 'i gang zag rnams/ gal te dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs pa rnams la bslus par gyur na/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das nyid la bslus par gyur cig de'i tshe bdag cag gi gnas bye mas bsreg par gyur cig rdo rje kun tu 'bar bas bdag cag gi mgo bo gas par gyur cig rtag par dus thams cad du sems can chen po de bsrung ba dang / skyabs pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/ /byin chen po dang / stobs dang / brtson 'grus bskyed par bgyi'o/ /de'i dug rnams dug ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /dus dus su char dbab par bgyi'o/ /pha rol gyi yul thams la dug dang dus ma yin pa'i char mi dbab par bgyi'o/ /'jigs pa thams cad rnam par gzhom par bgyi'o/

/rgyal ba'i bka' dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' rab tu bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /de nas bsgrub pa bshad bya ste/ /lha rdzas bsgrub bya nad pa lta bu'i lus la/ 'od 'phreng dkar po yis/ /dbu la sbrul mgo bdun zer bzhin bskor ba'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin gtso bo'i rnal 'byor bsam nas kyang / /phuḥ phyag na rdo rje puṇ+ye la phu btags/ klu rang gi sngags 'phreng btags la zhes bya ba 'bum bzlas la/ /de nas mdze nad sogs/ dug blangs phuḥzhes ni/ /zla ba'i 'od zer/ bya ba'i dkyil 'khor lag pa g.yon par/ bsam nas kyang / /lha rdzas 'od zer 'phreng bas dgeng / /de la nad pa'i spyi bor pad+ma 'dab brgyad la klu brgyad phyag rdor dang dgu bsam/ phuḥzhes bya ba bsam/ /lag pa sbrul mgo zhags par byas pa'i mu dras 'dren byed pa na/ 'dra dang / /phuḥzhes bya ba'i rlung gi dug nad sogs gtor/ /lpags pa sha dang rus gnas pa'i/ /dug rnams thams cad ma lus par/ /phuḥ sbrul mgo mu dras/ zhes bya bas lag pas drang / /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa ni/ de nas phan 'dogs pa'i las rnams kun byed cing / /dug dang dug rigs sbyar la sogs/ /khu tshur gyis kyang kun 'byin na/ /sbrul mgo'i phyag rgya phul du byung ba'i tshig smos ci dgos/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa 'jigs byed brgyad chung ma dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la gsum/ sngags 'phreng ba/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba/ dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba ni/ de nas lha chen rnams kyi bdag po 'jigs par byed pa chen po bud med brgyad kyis bskor bas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag gis skrag pa dang / bud med rnams kyis skrag nas lha dang klu la sogs pa thams cad skrag

rnam par skrag rab tu skrag ste/ kha sbub tu 'gyel nas gos dang bral nas/ sems kyang stor nas kun tu 'phyan pa de dag las/ phan gdags pa de'i slad du/ bdag gi snying po rnams 'brel bar 'tshal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de la legs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'jigs par byed pa chen po legs so legs so/ /rab tu 'jigs par byed pas bdag nyid dang / lha'i bud med thams cad kyi snying po rnams shod cig de nas 'jigs par byed pa chen pos/ 'jigs par byed pa'i sgra phyung nas 'di skad gsol to/ /oṃ bhai 'jigs byed chen po/ ra bhi 'jigs mdzad ma/ swāhā/ oṃ tshangs pa khros pa'i chung ma dang bcas pa dmar/ bha bha ma bha ra/ swāhā/ oṃ bhi bi shu bhe ra/ swāhā/ bha ma bha ra khyab 'jug khros pa chung ma dang bcas pa sngo/ oṃ mahā be ra/ bhu swāhā/ lha chen po khros pa chung ma dang bcas pa dkar/ a in+d+ra bhe ra/ bhe swāhā/ brgya byin khros pa chung ma dang bcas pa ser/ oṃ ka ma bhe ra/ bhai swāhā/ 'dod pa'i lha chung ma dang bcas pa dmar/ oṃ ga ha bhe ra/ bhau swāhā/ tshogs bdag khros pa chung ma dang bcas pa sngo skya/ oṃ bring ki bhe ra/ bham̐ swāhā/ bring ki ri ti khros pa chung ma dang bcas pa ljang khu/ oṃ karti bhe ra/ bha swāhā/ smin drug khros pa chung ma dang bcas pa ljang khu/ bcom ldan 'jigs byed chen po ni/ /brgyad po de dag bdag 'jigs byed chen po smra ba brgyad po chung ma dang bcas pa rnams nyan pa yin no/ /ngag nyon/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma 'jug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga'o/ /dang po slob dpon gyi las la gnyis/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / bzhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po bri zhing lha dgod pa ni/

de dag gis de nas bdag gi dkyil 'khor bshad du gsol zhes zhus pa dang phyag na rdo rjes gsungs pa ni dkyil 'khor bshad/ /'khor lo chen po rtsibs brgyad pa/ / lha rnams gsal ba med/ bris nas dbus su rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro chen 'jig rten gsum las ni/ /rnam rgyal yang na zhal gsum phyag bzhi par gsungs te phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bsnol ba g.yas rdo rje g.yon mda' gzhu'o/ /g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan stag gi smad g.yogs sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan can zhal g.yon shin tu khros g.yas zhi ba'i zhal dbus ma'i phyed ni khros pa g.yas phyed ni zhi ba'o zhes gsungs na rgyud gcig la bzhugs pa'i gzhung 'dra'o/ /zhes bya bzhag par bya/ /de yi zhabs drung 'jigs byed pa/ /bdag po chen po khros pa na/ /'jigs byed ma sku mdog sngo nag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa glang po che'i ko rlon gon pa dbu la thod pa dang zla tshes kyis brgyan pa mtshan ma bsgreng ba btsun mo la bstan pa'o/ /yum ni dka' thub zlog pa'i tshul sku mdog phyag mtshan gtso bo dang 'dra'o/ /'khor gyi sku mdog phyag mtshan yang de bzhin no/ /dang bcas pa bri/ /rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad du/ /gzhan yang 'jigs byed brgyad po ni/ /bud med rnams dang ldan pa la/ /khros pa'i bzhin dang yid khros pa/ /ci bder bar ni gzhung du ming tsam/ bri bar bya/ /'di ni sgo sgor de bzhin du/ /'das pa'i/ sgo ba shin tu khros ldan bri/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bzhugs te bsgrub pa ni/ de nas lcags kyu la sogs pa/ /bkug ste mgo yi thun mong gi mchod rdzas rnams snga ma bzhin las 'dir khyad par du thod pa ni/ /khrag gis bkang ste mchod pa dang bshams pa gnyis ka dus gcig tu bstan nas kyang / /sha chang gtor ma bzang po dang /

/snod rnams khrag gis bkang ba dang / /mgo thod mgo bo'i dum bu dang / /khrag gam chang bkang bum pa thod pa brgyad/ /dkyil 'khor der ni bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug pa la sogs pa'i cho ga bstan pa ni/ de nas 'jig rten 'dod khams rang la sa 'og dang sa steng sa bla gsum du'o/ /gsum rgyal ba'i/ /mchog gi slob ma gzhug par bya/ /bum pa'ang mgo bo'i thod pa ni/ /de dag brgyad phyag na rdo rje dang dgus/ kyi dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa ni/ de nas las rnams sbyin bya ste/ /bud med gnod sbyin mo'am srin po'i gnas khyim mam mtshan dbang phyug lha rten yod pa gcig par/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi rnal 'byor byas la/ ni 'dul ba'i mchog /tshul bzhin du ni mchod nas kyang / /'bum phyag rdor khro bo'i sngags lo ka'i 'phreng sngags btags la/ phrag bzhir ni bzlas nas kyang / /de nas 'jigs par byed pa yi/ /bdag nyid chen po'i sgrub pa sgra thos nas/ /mi sgra de sgrub pa po 'jigs par ni mgo thod par/ /khrag mchog bkang ste 'jigs byed rnams rang sngags kyi/ ste dbul bar bya/ /de nas khro bo 'jigs byed pa/ /ma rung sgra rtag pa la sgrub pa pos 'jigs pa med pa bsgrub cing phul yid can bud med kyi/ /tshogs kyis bskor cing 'jigs byed pa/ /brgyad kyis bskor ba mthong bar 'gyur/ /de 'jigs byed/ mthong sgra de sgrub pa po 'jigs pa med gyur la/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba phyag rdor dran byed cing / /sha'am yang sngags ring sgrub pa pos yang na chang mchog gis/ /thod pa bkang ste dbul bar bya/ /de nas 'jig byed ma rung 'joms/ /mchod pa byas pa la mgu nas rab tu 'grub 'gyur nas/ /lha chen po la sogs/ ci 'dod ces ni smras nas kyang /

/mgu ba'i yid kyis bde byin byed/ /lo ka las 'das pa'i sa rnams sbyin pa ma gtogs par/ /bde chen hūm̐ gi tshul gyis gsol/ /khru ba bro ba btung ba lha'i bdud rtsi/ dang / /rdzas lha'i dang ral gri 'khor lo dang / /rtse gsum pa dang mtho rigs dang / /'dod pa mi dang sa 'og rgyal po longs spyod dang / /gling dang gling bzhi la dbang byed pa'i/ brgya byin dang / /gnod sbyin dbang phyug srin po dang / /rig 'dzin dang ni rig nyid nyam/ /'khor los gling bzhi bsgyur la dang 'jig rten nyid/ /gsum gyi bdag dang bka' nyan dang / /rang gi 'khor 'jigs byed dang bud med kyi/ /dngos grub gang yang rung ba ni/ /ci dga' ba yang sbyin par byed/ /byin nas rgod cing 'gro bar 'gyur/ /skrag na sgrub pa po de ma thag tu gsod/ /ces pas bstan/ drug pa lha chen po brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la bzhi/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba/ dngos grub kyi ye shes/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa la dngos grub gsol bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba ni/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha chen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal na/ rang gi cho ga zhib mor bshad par 'tshal gyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyang / rang gi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ tshangs pa/ am̐/ oṃ khyab 'jug bi/ sbru/ oṃ dbang phyug chen po/ ru/ rta/ oṃ brgya byin/ i/ na tra ma/ oṃ tshogs bdag ba/ kam̐ 'dod/ oṃ tshogs bdag na pa ti gā sa'i dbang phyug oṃ bri bring ki ri ti/

oṃ karti ka kā gzhon nu gdong drug zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po slob dpon gyi las la gnyis/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / bzhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po bri zhing lha dgod pa ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor ling tshe dgu snga ma bzhin bris la/ / gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i nang du lha snams zlum po'i nang ka gdung can du bya'o/ /yang na lha snams kyang gru bzhi pa'i ling tshe dgur bya'am lha bcu gsum yod/ dbus su 'jig rten phyag rdor gsum 'dul ba/ /de yi mdun du dpa' bo ni/ /shar du/ dbang phyug rtse gsum lag thogs mdog nag po mtshan ma sgreng ba'o/ /bri/ /rgyab nub tu tshangs pa ser po pad+ma thogs pa'o/ /bri bya ste/ /g.yon par khyab 'jug ljang khu g.yas 'khor lo dang dung g.yon dbyug pa dang rin po che lag na 'khor lo thogs/ /lho g.yas par dbang po brgya byin dkar po rdo rje'i gdengs ka thogs pa/ rang gi ni/ /phyag rgya'i rdo rje rtse gsum pa/ mtshan ma lag thogs bri/ / shar lhor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dmar po mda' gzhu thogs pa/ lho nub tu tshogs bdag glang sna dkar po lag pa bzhi ste phyag mtshan mtshan ni kun rig gi bris pa'i skabs ltar ro/ /rang gi dkyil 'khor chung ma rnams/ /'di yang sgo ba de bzhin te/ /bya dang bum pa gang ba bzhag /dkyil 'khor lha rnams kyi shar du ka ma la de wa/ lhor tshogs bdag nub tu gzhon nu gdong drug byang tu bh+ring gi ri ti zer/ gyi ni phyi rol tu/ /stobs bzang la sogs byang du lha ma yin stobs bzang ljang khu sdang mig tu blta ba bshol thogs pa/ /nub tu dga' byed dbang phyug dmar po gsus po 'thor 'thung thogs pa'o/

/lhor gshin rje nag po dbyug pa thogs pa/ shar du mgon po nag po gri gug dang thod pa ste lha snam la dgod pa yin no/ /mthu chen bzhag /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa bzhugs te bsgrub pa ni/ de nas bzhugs nas lha rnams ni/ /mkhas pa kun nas dgug par bya/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlha thams cad/ /dkyil 'khor dam par gzhug par mdzod/ /de nas 'ongs par mthong 'gre ba dang / /dga' ba 'gre chen pos mchod par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma yis/ /phyag rgyas slob ma rnams gzhug ste/ /oṃ pra tits+tsha ho mahā sa twa badz+ra dha ra/ ata nyā ya ha ha ha he/ me tog cho ga bzhin du dor/ / mgo la bcings kun rig ltar ram rang sngags kyi mig gdong g.yogs phye nas ni bstan par bya/ /de nas lha dgu'i/ sngags kyis btab pa yi/ /bum pa'i chus ni dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa ni/ de nas lha rnams gang dga' ba'i/ /dngos grub rab tu sbyin par bya/ /phyag rdor sngags la lo ka'i 'phreng sngags btags la 'bum gcig gam ni 'bum gnyis kyi bar du bsnyen pa byas te dngos grub kyi phyir gsol ba btab pa bstan/ sam/ /dang po bsnyen pa byas nas kyang / /dbang phyug la sogs lha mchog rnams/ /de dag bsgrubs pas bsgrub bya yi/ /mtshan gcig la sogs dbang phyug chen po'i lha rten yod pa'i sngar gnas sam ni/ /tshangs pa la sogs lha chen po'i rten yod pa'i phyag na rdo rje'i pho brang ngam/ /yang na de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ /ring bsrel ldan pa'i mchod rten drung du/ /lha rnams thams cad cho ga bzhin/ /bsgrub pas rtag tu bsgrubs byas nas/ /nam phyed na ni lha mthong nas/ /khyod kyi 'dod pa gang yin pa/ /de ni ci bder sbyin bya yi/ /bsgrub po la bzang pos zhes bos ste myur tu bsam ste smros/

/gang phyir lha la sogs pa mchog ni khyod la sbyin/ /de nas rtags shes dngos grub phyir/ /lha la mchog ni gsol ba gdab/ /lha rdzas khu ba gro btung dang / /mi snang ba dang mkha' 'gro dang / /ri lu rdzas dang rgyal srid la sogs/ /yid 'dod pa tshad med pa gsol ba gdab/ /ces pas bstan/ bzhi pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa la dngos grub gsol ba bstan pa ni/ de nas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs pa gang lags pa bsgrub pa ma byas kyang de dag bcom ldan bdag cag lha rnams kyis sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong / mtho ris kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bde 'gro'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /ngan song ma lags pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i lam bstan par sa dang po la sogs bgyi'o/ /dben bden pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /rnam par dben pa'i byang sems sa bcu la sogs lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /tā thā'i yon tan/ 'byung po'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /sa dang po la sogs yan chad kyi thos bsam sgom gsum gyi dam pa'i chos kyi lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /bde 'gro'i lam thob par byed pa'i rten lha mi'i go 'phang bstan par bgyi'o/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /nyon mongs pa med pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrub pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid du 'grub pa'i lam rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'grub pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o/ /dus thams cad du thams cad las bsrung ba dang / skyabs pa dang / sba bar bgyi'o/

/bdag nyid kyi bu bzhin du yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /de'i pha rol gyi dgra kun yongs su gzhom par bgyi'o/ /grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong brdal dang / ljongs dang / rgyal po'i pho brang dang / rgyal srid rnams bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yul dang / phyogs dang / grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong 'khor rnams bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal srid kyang stsal bar bgyi'o/ /rgyal srid thob pa rnams ni rgyal srid rgyas par bgyi'o/ /gling gcig pa dang / gling gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / bde 'gro dang / lha'i gnas dang / sa 'og dang / 'khor los bsgyur ba rnams stsal bar bgyi'o/ /mdor na brgya byin nyid dang / tshangs pa nyid dang / rtogs 'dod nyid dang / dbang phyug chen po nyid stsal bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa tshe dpag tu med pa gsung gi dkyil 'khor la gnyis/ gleng bslangs pa dang / rgyud kyi gzhung bstan pa'o/ /dang po gleng bslangs pa la gnyis/ ston pas gleng bslangs pa dang / 'khor gyi gleng bslangs pa'o/ /dang po ston pas gleng bslangs pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das yon tan phyag na rdo rje nyid kyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la kun tu gzigs nas 'dzum pa mdzad pa tsam gyi dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dag snod bcud thams cad g.yos/ tshabs cher yang dag par g.yos so/ /'gul yang dag par 'gul/ 'bar rab tu 'bar/ yang dag par rab tu 'bar/ rgod rab tu rgod/ tshab cher yang dag par rab tu rgod/ rtse rab tu rtse lus bde ba skyes pas gar byed/ yang dag par rab tu rtse zhing / rmad kyi ya mtshan du ma yang dag par rab tu snang bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa 'khor gyis gleng bslangs pa ni/ de nas kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor ni phal cher brgya byin gyis zhus/ tshangs pa la sogs phyi ma phal cher tshangs pas zhus pa rnams shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur nas/

bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' ni rgyu ma mchis par 'dzum pa mi mdzad na 'dzum pa mdzad pa'i rgyu gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das de'i slad du 'dzum pa'i rgyu gang lags pa lung bstan par gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes lha rnams kyi gsol ba'i tshig gsan nas/ 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshangs pa la sogs pa sngon gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bshad pa'i 'chi bdag zhi bar byed pa'i rig pa dang / dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bdag 'jigs par byed pa'i rigs sngags gzi brjid chen po gang yin pa de thos sam/ gleng bslangs/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyud kyi gzhung bstan pa la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba/ ngan song du skye ba dang skyes zin pa'i sdig pa sbyang ba/ rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal nas/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha chen po de dag yang dag par rab tu mgu nas ba spu langs te/ legs so zhes bya ba 'dis bstod do/ /bcom ldan 'das lha rnams kyi don du legs so legs so mi rnams kyi don du legs so/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa gnyis ka'i don du/ legs so/ /dgos pa/ gang gi slad du tshe thung ba'i sems can rnams tshe bsring bar bgyi ba dang / dus ma lags pa'i 'chi bdag gis nyen pa rnams/ 'chi ba las rnam par grol bar bgyi ba dang ngan song du skyes pa ngan song gi rgyu thams cad las ci nas kyang thar bar bgyi ba dang / 'khor ba'i 'jigs pas skrag pa'i sems can rnams bde blag tu 'khor ba la rgyab kyis phyogs par gyur nas/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar bgyi ba'i slad du/

'od zer gyi gzi brjid chen po'i stobs dang / sems mthu chen po'i rig pa bshad du gsol/ rgyud 'byung ba'i rgyu'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyi gsol ba btab pa'i tshig gsan nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po'i ma rig pa 'joms pa'i gnyen po'i rigs pa'i ye shes rigs sngags 'di nyid sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las byung ngo / / stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ puṇ+ya tshe dpag med kyi zlos sngags/ puṇ+ya/ ma hā puṇ+ya/ a pa ri mi ta ā yu puṇ+ya/ dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi te swā hā/ snying po'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ phyag rdor hri swāhā/ nye ba'i snying po'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ tshe dpag med kyi bskyed sngags te bzlas pa byed tsa na zlos pa'i sngags la btags te bzlos/ bh+rum̐ swāhā/ snying po'i nye ba'i snying po'i rig pa'o/ /oṃ rdo rje ma'i krum̐ swāhā/ snying po yang dag par bskul ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ rin chen gyi tram̐ swāhā/ oṃ rdo rje chos kyi/ hri swāhā/ gsang ba'i snying po'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po slob dpon gyi las la gnyis/ bri zhing lha dgod pa la sogs pa dang / zhugs te bsgrub pa la sogs pa'o/ /dang po bri zhing lha dgod pa la sogs pa ni/ de nas de dag dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor rtsibs bzhi par byas la/ de yi dbus su de bzhin gshegs pa tshe dang bsod nams dang / ye shes kyi tshogs dang / gzi brjid tshad med pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba bzhag par bya snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar po mnyam bzhag tu byas pa'am yang na lha lnga ka la yang phyag na rdo rje'i skabs bzhin g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon skyabs sbyin du bya'o ste/

brum̐ zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /de yi spyan sngar phyag na rdo rje ljang khu g.yas rdo rje thugs kar g.yon dkur brten pa ut+pal 'dzin pa'am 'dra bar ste/ /hriḥzhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /g.yon par khro bo ste/ khams gsum rnam rgyal sngon po g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon sdigs mdzub 'dra'o/ /krum̐ zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /g.yas par nam mkha'i snying po mdog sngon po g.yas rin po che dpral bar 'jog g.yon pa gdan la brten pa'o/ /ste/ /tram̐ zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /rgyab tu ni 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dkar po g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon pad+ma/ mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa phyag mtshan min te sems can la skyobs pa'i 'phrin las yin no/ /zhes bya ste/ hri hriṃ zhes bya ba'i snying po'o/ /de bzhin gshegs 'di ltar lha'i go sar yi ge dgod pa yang lugs gcig phyag rgya chen po dang yi ge gnyis char dgod pa'ang lugs cig ste 'og nas rig pa dang lhan cig spyan drangs zer bas so/ /gsung gi dkyil 'khor du 'dogs pa la'ang yi ge dgod pa spyan 'dren pa'o/ /ces bya ba'i dkyil 'khor la rig pa rnams bri'o/ /dbang bskur ba'i bum pa lnga dang brgyad mchod pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sngags pu ṇa bum pa thams cad la khyad par lnga la lha lnga'i/ brgyad la rtsa rig kyi btab la bzhag bdug pa la sogs las thams cad mchod rdzas thams cad pa'i khro bo'i dkyil 'khor 'di'i dbang du byas nas dkru'am sngags kyis btab pa dang / mchod pa mtshams bzhi bdug pa ma la sogs de wi bzhi la sogs bzhag ste/ sgo ba thams cad kyang de bzhin no/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bzhugs te bsgrub pa la sogs pa ni/ de nas sngags mkhan bdag nyid slob ma 'jug pa'i cho ga bzhugs la/ bde bar gshegs pa tshe dpag med/ sras phyag rdor dang 'bangs su bstan pa la dga' ba'i bsrung ma bcas shing 'khor gyis bskor te/

rig pa dang lha dgod pa'i snying po lhan cig spyan drangs pa nas gtor ma'i bar 'gre/ ngo / de nas bdag nyid dbang bskur yang dbang bskur dang bzlas pa bstan/ 'di tshe sgrub byed na bsnyen pa nas dkyil 'khor bris te rdzas dgod pa yan chad bya/ thun re'i mgo la bdag 'jug nas dbang bskur gyi bar du bya/ bzlas bsgom thun bzhir bya'o/ /phyag rdor dkyil 'khor du tshe sgrub logs su bstan 'dir thugs la bstan pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor rdul tshon gyis bris na yang mang po zhal dbye ba tsam bya/ gdong g.yogs dkrol/ dkyil 'khor bstan/ dam tshig bsgrags/ sdom pa dbog go /te skyil mo krung bcas tshe sgrub dbang du byas nas 'dug la stong phrag dkyil 'khor gyi 'phreng sngags des gtso bo gcig pu'i gsung brgyar bzlas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'am/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'am/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi dbang phyug kyang rung ste mngon sum mthong nas ci 'dod pa'i mchog so sor thob par 'gyur ro/ /ci ste mnyam par ma bzhag na de'i tshe yid kyi las thams cad nus par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba yan lag dang bcas pa la bzhi/ slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba/ bla ma la yon dbul ba/ dngos grub kyi ye shes/ dbang bskur ba'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings nas/ oṃ 'di dkyil 'khor gzhan las khyad par ro/ /badz+ra dha ra/ rdo rje 'dzin la des 'gre rat+na dha ra/ pad+ma dha ra/ bi shwa dha ra/ ta thā ga ta/ sa gong ma rnams la sbyar/ ma ya ti kra ma/ blo gros kyi rim pa/ ta thā de ltar thams cad kyi ga ta sa ma ya dam tshig dha ra 'dzin ma/ āt+ma ko ham̐ nga'am bdag yin/ zhes slob ma rnams ni rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor/ nga rgyal bskyed la slob ma gzhug par bya'o/

/de nas dam la bzhag pa ye shes dam tshig la zer/ dbab par bya/ 'dis me tog dor bar bya'o/ /oṃ me tog tā thā ga ta pra tits+tsha ho sa ma ya satwam̐/ des nas 'phreng ba de nyid kyi mgo la bcings gdong g.yogs bkrol/ dkyil 'khor bstan/ dam tshig bsgrag sdom pa dbog te dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba cod pan gyi/ ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa badz+ra dha ra ya adzñā ya hūm̐ brum̐/ kyi spyi gtsug tu/ oṃ badz+ra badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ dpal 'bar hūm̐/ oṃ rna ltag g.yas/ rat+na rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ tram̐/ oṃ ltag par/ pad+ma pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hri/ oṃ karma rna ba g.yon par/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ krum̐/ de nas dam tshig dang bka'i dbang bskur bar ud bya'o/ /de la dam tshig ni 'di'o/ /dkon mchog 'dir brten bya gong du nyams blangs zin/ gsum dang byang chub sems/ /bla ma dam pa rnams mi spang / /lan dang po pas srog chags rnams ni gsad mi bya/ /ma byin pa yang mi blang zhing / /rdzun du smra bar bya ba min/ /pha rol bud med spyad mi bya/ /bla ma smad par mi bya ste/ /de yi grib ma mi 'gom zhing / /slob dpon ma yin mtshan nyid mi ldan/ mi bzung la/ /rdo rje slob dpon mtshan mi brjod/ /sngags dang phyag rgya mi smad de/ /lo ka'i/ lha rnams la lta ga la zhig /ci ste glen pas smad na ni/ /nad rims nad kyis nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /snying dang dkon mchog gsum la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas lha yi grib ma dang / /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yis/ /phyag rgya yi ge ming ngam brda'am yi mtshan ma rnams/ /gom pas 'goms par mi bya'o/ /glen pas dkon mchog gsum sogs dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la gnod byed dang / /bla ma gnod la brtson pa rnams/ /mkhas pas snying rje bskyed nas/ bsgrims te gsad par bya/

/chos mi ldan dang sdig spyod dang / /rtag tu sems can gnod brtson dang / /dam tshig can la sdang ba rnams sngar snying brtse bas/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni sdig pa chen po byed pa rnams ma 'ongs pa na btul rgyu dang bcas pa bral bar 'dod pa'i bsam pas sngags kyis phan yon bsam gsad/ /'jungs pa ser sna can/ rnams kyi nor blangs la/ /sems can 'phongs la sbyin par bya/ /bla ma la ni mchod pa dang / /de lta'i dam tshig bsrung bar sgrub pa dang / /dkyil 'khor phyir dang dam tshig can/ /phan phyir rgyal ba'i sras rnams la/ /mchod phyir mi yi bdag po'am/ /phyug po rnams ni nor 'phrog go /sems can rnams la phan spyod pas/ /rtag tu dam tshig bla ma'i nor/ /srog chags srog ni bsrung bya'i phyir/ /rdzun du yang ni smra bar bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni mnyes bya dang / /dam tshig rnams kyang bsrung ba dang / /sngags mkhan gyi ni rig pa 'di bsgrub pa'i lha gang yin pa'i rig pa ste bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /gzhan phyag rgya bsgrub pa'i don du bsgrub pa'i yan lag gyi bud med bsten par bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub pa po'i lha bstan po'i mtshan ma thob nas gong gi bsad sogs gnas 'dug nas/ /thams cad 'dir mtshon nas rang lha la mtshan ma thob pa'i rten gyi spyod cing kun zos kyang / /bya ba'i rgyud ltar dka' tshegs med par rnal 'byor rgyud ltar spyod lam bde ba'i sgo nas 'grub 'gyur nyes par mi 'gyur na/ /snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /de nas nyams len rin chen sna bdun gyi dbang bskur ba'i rdzas la bsgrub pa dang bshad pa'i rjes gnang / 'di'i bka'i dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ dkyil 'khor gzhan las khyad par ba/ sarba ta thā ga ta dzñā na dha s+ye mi gri na hi na oṃ badz+ra su dhi ye/ oṃ sngags 'di thugs ka'i dkyil 'khor la bkod pa'i slob ma'i snying kha'i zla dkyil stong par bsam slob dpon gyi brjod de'i rjes la slob mas kyang brjod pas slob dpon gyi zhal nas sngags 'phreng byung nas/

badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ de nas rdo rje lag tu byin la las kyi dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ sarba karma ni ku ru bud+dha na ma bka' thams cad gyi 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang / hūm̐/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bla ma la yon dbul ba ni/ de nas bla ma bla ma'i phyir/ /khyod kyis lus mchog sbyin par bya/ /nor dang dbyig dang 'bru rnams dang / /stan dang bzhon pa de bzhin te/ /bran gyi mchog dang khang pa dang / /rgyal po rgyal srid de bzhin te/ /bu dang bu mo chung ma dang / /ma dang sring mo tshe lo dang / /gzhan yang ci bzhed thams cad ni/ /phan par bsam phyir bla mar dbul/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dngos grub kyi ye shes ni/ de nas byang chub bar du ni/ /sangs rgyas ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i dus su dkyil 'khor gyi rtsar slob dpon thob pa mi nyams par byed pa'i don nyid dang sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar gzhan dag dang / nyams len gyi don dkyil 'khor thams cad du shes par bya'o/ /'jig rten pa yi mthu chen rnams/ /gang 'dod pa dag bsgrub 'dod pas/ /dngos grub rnams ni gsol bar bya/ /de nas slob ma bu la phan pa'i phyir/ /sngags mkhan chos la/ ser sna med sems dang / /dad pas dad pa'i sems ldan la/ /dngos grub rnams ni sbyin par bya/ /chos rnams thams cad dngos med stong par/ /sems kyis bsgom par byas nas kyang / /stong pa'i ngang las/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ / sems kyi rnam pa bsam/ rang gi lha gang bsgom gyi snying po sa bon zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de dbus su/ /bsam nas dam tshig lha gang bsgom gyi phyag mtshan sus zhe na/ rang lha dang dkyil 'khor gcig dang ras bris de rten pa'i dngos grub sbyin bsreg gi phyag rgya yang / /bsam zhing de bzhin de nyid du/ /sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs bsreg legs pa sngar bstan pa dang phyis ston pa'i/ sgrub pa po ni bsgyur bar bya/

/lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur/ /de nas rang gi sa bon gang bsgom gyi sngags dang / /gang bsgom gyi/ phyag rgyas gang bsgom gyi mu tra gnas bzhir yang na rigs gsum spyi'i sngags dang phyag rgya gnas gsum du yang na badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+thā la sogs pa dang rdo rje khu tshur gyi gnas bcu gnyis su phyag rgya chen por de byin rlabs/ /ltag 'og go rim ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dbang bskur ro/ / rigs lnga'i sngags dang mu dra de yang ta thā ga ta sgrub pa dang phyag na rdo rje sgrub pa'i mu dras spyi gtsug tu'o/ /de nas nga rgyal bskyed nas kyang / /mkhas pa yis ni rang gi lha dang dkyil 'khor gcig dang ras bris la brten pa'i dngos grub bsgrub pa'i sbyin sreg gi sdig pa sbyang ba'i thabs kyi bye brag la sogs pa sngar bstan pa dang phyis ston pa'i/ bsgrubs byas nas/ /de bzhin gshegs kyang 'grub 'gyur na/ /dngos grub gzhan yongs su rdzogs lta smos ci dgos/ / 'phrin las bzhi ka la sogs pa zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa dbang bskur ba'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha chen po rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i bu dang / rgyal po'i blon po dang / rgyal rigs da nga / bram ze'i rigs dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / gzhan yang dma' zhing khro re chung ma phyag dar ba dang / mtha' khob pa'i rigs kyi skye bo rnams kyis dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'dir bzhugs na/ de dag gi rnam par smin pa ji lta bur 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gang ma 'ongs pa'i sems can la phan pa'i phyir/ nga la zhus pa legs so legs so/ /lha'i bu rnams kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyal po 'dir bzhugs pa dang / dbang bskur ba dang / bris pa dang / 'brir bzhugs pa dang /

rjes su gong gi rnams la yid rang ba dang / phyag byas pa dang / mchod pa rnams kyi 'bras bu dang / rnam par smin pa rnams nyon cig lha'i bu rnams mdor na nga la yang de'i yon bshad par spobs pa med de/ nga'i bsod nams kyi phung po gang yin pa de ni brgya phrag stong du mar bsgyur kyang grangs su yang mi chog bgrang bar yang mi phod/ dper yang mi bzod de/ de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi phung pos kyang mi bzod do/ lha'i bu rnams kyis gsol bar zhes bsam/ /dkyil 'khor 'di dag 'khor gyi tshig tu mos na chad lhag yod par sems/ 'dir bzhugs pa'i sems can rnams kyi 'bras bu dang / rnam par smin pa gang lags pa de ni bcom ldan 'das ngo mtshar che'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa ngo mtshar che'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis dkyil 'khor la sogs par zhugs par spro'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa spro lags so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ngan song du skye ba dang skyes zin pa'i sdig pa sbyang ba la gnyis/ lha rnams kyis zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'o/ /dang po lha rnams kyis zhus pa ni/ de nas lha de dag gis de bzhin du phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can tshe ldan bsod nams chung zhing tshe thung ba dang / rgyu'i ngan song gi rgyu dang ldan pa dang / 'bras bu/ sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dwags dang / byol song rnams su skyes pa dag tshe 'das nas mchis na/ bcom ldan 'das de la bdag gis ji ltar bsgrub par bgyi zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la gnyis/ tshe las 'das pa la sbyar ba dang / tshe dang ldan pa la sbyar ba'o/ /dang po tshe las 'das pa la sbyar ba la gsum/ dbang bskur bas sdig pa sbyang ba/ bzlas pas sbyang ba/ sbyin sreg gi sbyang ba bstan pa'o/ /dang po dbang bskur bas sbyang ba la gnyis/

mdo dang rgyas pa'o/ /dang po mdo ni/ lha'i bu rnams sems can de dag gnyis ka ni dkyil 'khor 'di nyid du chug shig tshe ldan/ chos kyi yi ge yang zlos su chug cig des sems can de dag gi tshe ring bar 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams dang bral ba rnams bsod nams dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /ngan song las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ ud de/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas pa ni/ kyai nam mkhar te/ lha'i bu rnams ngan song du skyes zin pa gang tshe 'das yin pa de dag gi ming la yang dbang skur ba cig gang tshe 'das/ gzugs brnyan la yang dbang bskur ba byos shig mchod rten btab pa la yang dbang bskur ba byos shig rang gi lha'i sku tsha tsha la yang dbang bskur ba byos shig chung ngu na de dag dang rigs mthun pa dang / de'i bu dang / de'i rigs mthun pa dang / de'i ming 'dzin pa'am/ bran la dbang skur cig gdul bya'i gtso bo yin pas na mi'i/ zhag bdun du dkyil 'khor du bcug ste/ dbang bskur gdon mi za bar zhag bdun gyis ngan song gi sgrib pa las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bzlas pas sbyang ba ni/ lha'i bu rnams de'i ming nas smos te/ 'bum phrag gnyis sam 'bum phrag gsum/ 'bum phrag bzhi nas 'bum phrag brgya stong gi bar du bzlas brjod byas na mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang rnam par byang bar 'gyur na/ sdig pa chung ngu byas pa rnams lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa sbyin sreg gis sbyang ba la bzhi ste/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang / mngon spyod do/ /dang po zhi ba ni/ lha yi bu rnams zhi ba yis/ /hoṃ khung tha ma bar ma mchog /khrung gang khru do gru bzhi pa'i/ /zlum po dbyibs nyid du byas nas ni/ /de yi ming la nyung kar 'og bsreg rdzas sogs kyis/ sha sogs kyis/ /brgya phrag stong du bsreg byas na/ /ngan song kun las thar bar 'gyur/

/de yi sha dang rus pa da nga / /skra dang thal ba la sogs pas/ /cho ga de dang 'dra bar ni/ /sbyin sreg byas na ngan song yang / /kun de'i phyed mar phab pa la/ las rnam par thar bar 'gyur/ /de yi dbus su 'khor lo thur du brus pa la ni/ /rtsibs brgyad 'od zer dkar 'bar de'i steng du zla dkyil bri/ /'khor yug rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ phyir bskyed pa la/ /'od zer dkar dang ldan par bri/ /de nas rdo rje rgya gram yar rtsig pa la dang / /rdo rje rin chen chu skyes mchog /de nas sdig pa tsakra ba ri nas gzhom pa'i phyir/ /'das pa'i/ phyag rgya sna tshogs bzhag par rim gnyis/ yang na rim bzhi/ yang na rim pa brgyad ldan bya/ /phyi yi lo ka'i rdo rje'i rigs rnams ni/ /phyag rgya rnams ni phyi rol bri/ /gza' dang skar ma'i mtshan ma dang / /de ltar 'jig rten skyong ba rnams/ /gtso bo dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i lha gang rung ri mo lugs ma'ang rung / /'das pa'i/ rdo rje can dang lhan cig bzhag /bya dang bum pa rgyas par kun rig me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs bzhin/ gang ba dang / /gtor ma lha bshos rab dkar brgyad dam bcu drug bzhag /mdor na de'i sngon du sa chog kun rig bzhin/ de'i ched tshad btab phab pa la rim gnyis/ yang na rim bzhi/ yang na rim lnga ldan par tsakra bri/ de'i dkyil 'khor thig ni btab nas kyang / /cho ga bzhin du chu tshon gyis bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po'i chas dkar po'i gos ni gyon nas kyang / /sangs rgyas gzugs can dkyil 'khor 'di byed na tshe dpag med/ kun rig ta thā ga ta shāka thub dkyil 'khor du gtso bo phyag rdor dkyil 'khor du mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i lha'i 'jog gi byang mi 'jigs pas/ /tshe 'das ngan song rgyud na gnas pa yi/ /sems can rjes su dran byed cing / /sdig pa sgrib pa sbyong ba'i phyir/

/dag sangs rgyas rnams kyi sbyin sreg ni zer pa'i rgyud kyi sbyin sreg ni/ /mar dang 'o ma sbrang rtsi can/ /'bras yos yungs kar bsres pa dang / /de yi rus pa sha la sogs/ de'i rjes la 'og me ltar 'bar ba nas bstan pa'i bud shing zho dang ldan pa zhes pa nas bsam ste/ steng du gzhug par bya zhes pa'i bar gyi don 'dir shes par bya'o/ /yang na med na/ ming nas smos te bya/ /de ni tshe 'das zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi bde 'gror skyes nas kyang / /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas pa ni/ slob dpon mkhas pas rgyas par bya dgos te/ /khru do pa'am gnas dang sa chog 'og nas ston thig sngar bstan khru bzhi pa/ /de ltar mchog ni khru brgyad pa/ /byas nas hoṃ khung gru bzhi pa/ /kun tu mu ran kha khyer la ldan par bya/ /de dbus pad+ma rin chen zur brgyud pa dang / /'od zer ser po ldan par bri/ /'khor phyir bskyed pa gzhung bzhin/ rgyas na rgyas pa dang / dbang sogs phyir bskyed pa dang / gyen du rtsig pa gnyis las med/ lhar rnam snang la 'khor lo shar/ rdo rje lhor/ rin po che nub tu/ pad+ma byang / rgya gram yang na dbu ru tsakra sogs lnga par spel nas bri/ yug tu phyir bskyed pa la/ ni rin chen dang / /mu ran rnams la chu skyes bri/ /phyi rol tu ni rigs lnga yi/ /so so'i phyag rgya bri bar bya/ /de ltar lha rnams la lo ka phyi yi lha rnams dang / /sgo bzhir/ lcags kyu la sogs bri bar bya/ /gos rnams ser por mchod rdzas dgod pa bum pa'i kha dog gser 'dra ba la sogs pa 'og me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas ston/ rgyas pa'i me lha 'og nas bstan/ spyan drangs la sngags kyi pu tsa lnga dbul bar bya/ bsgyur nas kyang / /mtho ris gnas pa rjes dran zhing / /de la phan zhing rgyas pa'i phyir/ /sgrub pa po rdo rje rin chen sogs kyi rnal 'byor byas la pa yi ni las byas nas/
