/lus can de yi tshe dang dpal/ / mtho ris su skyes pa'i gzi brjid bde ba'i longs spyod 'phel/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dbang ni/ rgyas pa'i rjes/ de nas phan phyir tshe 'das de la nges par yang / /dbang du bya ba'i las byas dkyil 'khor nas ston/ te/ /hoṃ khung gnas dang sa chog 'og nas ston thig gong du song / gzhu yi dbyibs 'dra ba/ /khru gang pa'am khru do pa/ /khru bzhir byas pa de dbus su/ /pad+ma dmar po bris nas kyang / /de yi dbus su mdar byas pa'i/ /gzhu yang de bzhin bri bar bya/ /'khor yug tu ni mdar byas pa'i/ /gzhu yi kha dog dmar po bri/ /sngags rdzogs pas ni brtag par yang / /phyi rol de dang 'dra lha rnams zhi ba'am rgyas pa ltar bya/ yang na 'khor yug steng du yang 'gro bar bya/ /sems can de yang dran byas te/ /dmar sgrub pa po spyan ras gzigs la sogs pa dbang gi lha'i rnal 'byor bya/ me 'bar ba dang dbang gi spyan drangs pa 'og nas ston/ de la pu tsa bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor dang lha spyan drangs hoṃ bya/ por bsgyur pa'i gos gyon la/ /me tog dmar ram pad+ma dmar/ /'bras bu dmar ram mtshon bskus pas/ /mar dang gur gum bsres pa dang / /tsan+dan dmar po'i phye ma yi/ /sbyin sreg byas na lha la sogs/ / mchod zer/ thams cad de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa mngon spyod ni/ de la gdon rnams gzhom pa'i phyir/ /mngon spyod kyang ni brtsam bya ste/ /khrus phyed dang gsum mam khru gsum mo/ gnas dang sa chog 'og me ltar 'bar ba nas ston thig gong du song / /de ltar dam par khru dgu bya/ /gru gsum dang ni ldan pa la/ /dbus su rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ /rtse gsum pa dang rgya gram pa'i/ /rdo rje rnams dang dbyug pa dang / /mgo gcig zer rtse gsum pa'i rdo rje dang / /dgra satwa rtse gsum mu khyud bskor/

/phyi rol tu yang rim gsum du/ 'khor yug steng du yang 'gre lha rnams sgo dang rta babs gsum/ /snga ma zhi ba'i sbyin sreg ltar bya/ bzhin du brgyan par bya/ /bya dang gtor ma bum pa dang / /bshos cha rnam pa mang du bzhag /sha dang khrag gis bkang ba yi/ /mgo yi thod pa kun tu bzhag /de yi lus can sdig sogs dang / /bgegs rnams gzhom par bya ba'i phyir/ /gos nag bgos shing khros nas kyang / /rang lha'i dzo gi 'jig rten gsum rgyal bdag nyid bsgyur/ /de nas de yi mngon spyod me lha spyan drangs sogs sdig bcom lus/ / drag po'i sid+dhi rdzogs bgegs dang bral te ci bde bar/ /mtho ris 'jig rten mi yi nang / /khams gsum pa ni ci dgar spyod/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa tshe ldan la sbyar ba ni/ sngon la zhi ba rgyas pa dbang sngon byed/ go rim 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /tshe ldan 'di gnas la'ang bya ba ste/ /de nas gang gi phyir bya ba/ /de yi phyir sngar de nas de'i sdig pa 'joms yang de bzhin 'gyur/ /gzhan dag sbyin sreg min pa dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang bzlas pas sdig pa sbyang ba tshe ldan la bya/ kyang ni las rnams kyang / /snga ma sbyin sreg gong du bshad pa ji bzhin de ltar bya/ /des ni sems can rnams la yang / /myur du bde skyid 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa la bzhi ste/ rgyud bris pa'i phan yon/ rgyud mnga' gsol ba'i phan yon/ rgyud bshad pa'i phan yon/ dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po rgyud bris pa'i phan yon ni/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams yid mgu nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ngan song du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi don dang / phan pa dang / bde ba'i slad du brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di bri ba dang /

'brir 'jug pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo'am/ bdag cag tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams kyis bu bzhin du bskyang bar bgyi'o/ /gang rgyal po dang / rgyal po'i bu dang / rgyal po'i blon po rnams dang / ji ltar gsungs pa'i rjes su slob na/ de'i rgyal srid 'phel bar bgyid/ yul phyogs dang / rang gi skye bo dang / yongs kyi skye bo dang / bran la sogs pa bsrung bar bgyi/ nor dang 'bru rnams mang du 'byor par bgyi/ bud med dang skyes pa dang / khye'u dang / bu mo rnams dang ldan par bgyi'o/ /'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / lo legs pa dang / zhi ba rnams su bgyi na/ ji ltar bshad pa las mi rtogs par bgyi ba lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyud mnga' gsol ba'i phan yon ni/ gang gis brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di dad pas rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong brdal du btsugs la/ bdag nyid kyis bsdus pa dang / glang po che'i steng du bzhag la grong dang / grong khyer la sogs pa thams cad bskor na/ nad dang gdon thams cad ma mchis par 'gyur la/ sems can chen po de'i drung na/ bdag bran gyi tshul lam/ bu'i tshul du gnas par bgyi'o/ /gang du 'dir rab tu spyod pa de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje nyid rdzogs par longs spyod pa'i skus rdo rje sems dpa'i skur bzhugs par 'tshal bar bgyis te/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' kun tu bzang po re ba thams cad yongs su bskong ba de nyid/ brtag pa'i rgyal po'i gzugs su bzhugs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'khor dang bcas te bzhugs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /sa phyogs de mchod rten du gyur par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /mchod par bgyis te phyag 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /kun tu bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa rgyud bshad pa'i phan yon ni/ bdag cag tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyis brtag pa'i rgyal po 'di kun nas rgyas par 'chad pa'i rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub chen po de'i g.yog dang bran gyi tshul du gnas par bgyi'o/

/bka' nyan pa'i tshul du gnas par bgyi'o/ /bsgo ba thams cad mnyan par bgyi'o/ /phan pa dang bde ba thams cad bgyi'o/ /dngos grub thams cad kyang stsol bar bgyi ste/ bcom ldan 'das mdor na de'i rkang pa'i tshul spyi bos blang bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mchod par bgyi'o/ /bdag di'i phyi bzhin du 'brang ngo / /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa dkyil 'khor du bzhugs pa'i phan yon ni/ bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ dbang bskur ba la sogs pa de dag kyang bdag cag gi dpon legs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /phyag na rdo rje legs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /rdo rje sems dpa' legs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /bde ba chen po kun tu bzang po legs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa legs par 'tshal bar bgyi'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes/ tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams chos la rim gro byas pas de ltar dam tshig bcas par gyur pa gang yin pa de ni legs so/ /legs par sgrubs shig ces pas bstan/ bam po gsum pa/ bzhi pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor la bzhi/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba/ dngos grub kyi ye shes so/ /dngos grub kyi ye shes/ phyag rgya'i ye shes so/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes/ yid skyob par byed pas/ sngags dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i snying po rig pa dang / phyag rgya sku dang / snying po thugs bskul ba thams cad bstan par bya ba'i phyir/ nyid kyi snying po 'di bshad do/ /oṃ bh+rum̐ hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ badz+ra pā ṇi ḍi ḍa tiṣ+ṭha kun bzang / hūm̐/ oṃ bde ba chen po/ hūm̐ a/ 'di gsum gtso bo gang rung /

oṃ badz+ra phyag na rdo rje hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ḍi rin chen 'byung / dha badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ 'od dpag med badz+ra hūm̐ swa/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ a zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba la gnyis/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po slob dpon gyi las la gnyis/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / zhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po bri zhing lha dgod pa ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ dkyil 'khor lnga ma bzhin bris la/ / phyag rdor dang tshe dpag med/ dbus su rdo rje bri bar phyag rdor gyi thugs phyag mtshan du bri ba'i gdams pa bya/ /yang na rdo rje dkar po rdor dril can sems dpa' 'am/ /kun tu bzang ngam ser po rin chen snye ma 'dzin pa/ bde ba che/ / dmar po'am mda' gzhu/ spyan sngar phyag na rdo rje la/ / dmar rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa g.yas rdo rje rin chen te/ phyogs su rin chen thogs pa ni rin chen bsnams/ /rnam par gsal ba 'od dpag med dmar ser rdo rje dmar po pad+ma kha 'byed pa nub phyogs bri/ /byang don 'grub rdo rje lus ljang khu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa rim pa bcu gnyis yod pa la gtso bo dang 'khor gyi rim pa gnyis tshar ram/ phyogs phyag na rgya gram bsnams/ /phyi rol tu ni kun bskor zhing / /sangs rgyas rim pa gsum la 'das pa'i rab bdun shāka thub dang brgyad ni phyogs rer gnyis gnyis sku 'god na thams cad 'bi ro 'dra gsungs/ thams cad bzhag par bya/ /de yi rim pa bzhi pa la/ phyi rol sems dpa' bcu drug rnams/ /go rim bzhin du dkyil 'khor ba/ bri bar bya/ /de yi phyi rol dkyil 'khor bang rim lnga pa la sems dpa' rnams/ /byams pa la sogs bskal bzang bcu drug mchog chen bri/

/de ltar rim pa drug pa la/ dge slong kun dga' sogs/ /rim pa bdun pa la rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ thub rnams de yi phyi rol bri/ /rim pa brgyad pa la lha chen brgyad rang gi chung ma bus bskor ba'i/ /'dod khams kyi tshangs pa la sogs lha chen brgyad phyi rol bri/ /gza' brgyad dang skar ma nyer brgyad/ lha thams cad dang / /rgyal po rim pa bcu pa la rgyal chen bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bzhi po rnams dang ni/ /rim pa bcu gcig pa la phyogs skyong bcu'i dkyil 'khor phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba rnams/ /de yi phyi rol bcu drug gi mtshan ma dmyal ba kun/ /'dod chags la sogs byol song dang / 'dod chags kyi mtshan ma bya zhe sdang sbrul gti mug phag ste dud 'gro'o/ /srin por yi dwags dbang ldan du lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi mtshan ma bri/ rim pa bcu gnyis pa ni sgo ba yin no/ /sgo sgor gsungs pa de bzhin du/ / de rnams lha snam bzhi'am gnyis la bri ba'ang lugs gcig go /shāka thub dkyil 'khor nas bstan pa ltar rim dgu la gza' chen brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ta thā lnga sems dpa' gcig sgo ba bzhi nyi shu rtsa lnga po rtsa ba'i lha/ sgo ba stobs kyi dam pa rnams/ /dri rnams lnga tsan+dan gu gul gla rtsi a ka ru ga pur/ yi chus bkang ba/ gser gyi bum pa 'od can dang / /gtor ma dang ni lha bshos dang / /me tog bdug pa rab mdzes dang / /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phan rnams dang / /bla bre dang ni rnga mchog dang / /dril bu rdo rje nor bu dang / /do shal nyi zla la sogs brgyad/ /'dod chags rnams ni 'bras bu ni/ /'dod pa'i gzugs sogs yon tan lngas bkang ngo / /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa bzhugs te bsgrub pa ni/ de nas sngags mkhan nyid kyis ni/ /spyan drangs gtor ma'i bar 'gre bdag nyid gzhug par bya/

/zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba la gsum/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid gzhug cing dbang bskur ba dngos/ bla ma la yon dbul zhing bka' nod pa'o/ /dang po slob ma'i mtshan nyid ni/ bdag gzhan la khyad par tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor nas bshad pa bzhin/ nyid kyi ni dbang bskur la/ /sdom dge slong nas dam tshig ldan pa dang / bla ma mos slob ma'i mtshan nyid dkyil 'khor du shes par bya shing mi 'jigs la/ /theg pa chen po'i rigs skyes skyon dang bral ba dang / /ser sna ma lus spangs gyur cing / /yon tan mang po ldan gyur dang / /sbyin pa gtong dang tshul khrims mang du thos/ /byams pa dang ni snying rje'i sems/ /dga' ba btang snyoms gnas pa dang / /rgyu la stong pa mtshan ma rang gi ngo bo med pa'i sems/ /smon pa med pa'i yid ldan pa'i/ /slob ma dam pa zhes pas bstan/ /gnyis pa gzhug cing dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ sngags 'di yis/ byang chub tu ni sems kun rig ltar bskyed la/ /sngags mkhan gyis ni gzud par bya/ /dkyil 'khor du 'jug sngags/ oṃ badz+ra hūm̐ dza/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ me tog dor sngags/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi tits+tsha badz+ra sa twa ma hā su kha ham̐ hūm̐/ ha ha ha ho/ sa ma ya satwam̐/ me tog gi 'phreng ba gtor nas gang la bab pa de'i sngags dang phyag rgyas mgo la bcing bar bya'o/ kun rig ltar mi byed na/ /de nas dam tshig sbyin par bya ste/ ci ste khyod kyis su yang rung ba la smras na ni/ phyag na rdo rje nyid kyi rdo rje 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar bas khyod kyi mgo 'gems par 'gyur ro/ /oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ a/ 'dis dam tshig gi chu blud la/ gdong g.yogs dkrol dam tshig sbrags sdom pa dbog bar bya'o/ /oṃ badz+ra tsak+ṣa pa sh+ya he/ adzñā sa yan te lan te mo k+ṣa ya na ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ dkyil 'khor bstan/

de nas phyag na rdo rje la sogs pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bstan te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /oṃ cod pan gyi dbang bskur gyi dus mu dra lnga po sngar dang 'dra/ sngags 'di gcig pu lha lngar brjod pa 'ong yang badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gi dor bya gzhan snga ma bzhin/ badz+ra pā ni sa ma yan te/ a nu rak+to a bhi ṣiñtsa tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa sarba badz+ra a bhi ṣe ka ta hūm̐ a/ yang 'og gi bum pa de dbang bskur sngon du lan re brjod lan lngar bya gsungs/ oṃ badz+ra bud+dha a bhi ṣe ka ta oṃ hūm̐/ dpral ba oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa sarba rat+na a bhi ṣe ka ta oṃ tram̐/ rna ba g.yas/ oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa sarba pad+ma a bhi ṣe ka ta oṃ hri/ ltag pa/ oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa sarba karma a bhi ṣe ka ta oṃ ā/ rna ba g.yon/ zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa bla ma la yon dbul zhing bka' nod pa ni/ de nas bdag lus la sogs pa yon du phul la bka' nod par bya'o/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta adzñā a bhi ṣe ka te da sa mi gri na badz+ra pra sid te ye swāhā/ zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dngos grub kyi ye shes la gnyis/ mdo dang / rgyas pa'o/ /dang po mdo ni/ de nas 'phrin dbang tshe dpag med bzhin las thams cad byed du 'jug cing dkyil 'khor pa'i/ dngos grub kyi thams cad kyang sbyin no/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas pa la gnyis/ rang don dang / gzhan don no/ /dang po rang don ni/ nir te bde bas bde ba bskyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor rtsibs bzhi po'i dbus su ni/ /kun tu bzang ngam bde ba cher/ /bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor kun nas 'gre/ kyang kyis kyang bsgoms nas kyang / /snying khar zla dkyil steng du hūm̐ zhes bya bsam nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms pa goms nas mtshan ma thob tsa na 'bras bu thob/

sems dpa' mnyam par 'gyur/ /dpal ldan phan yon las bzhi sogs/ rnams kun byed cing / /kun tu bzang por bdag nyid bsgom pa goms pas 'gyur/ /de ltar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /hūm̐ las sangs rgyas gzugs gyur pa'i/ /phyag na rdo rje bdag nyid 'gyur/ /snying khar 'khor lo rab bsgom la/ /phyag na rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje khro bo rnams bsgom te/ /snying kha'i dbus su phaṭ zla steng du/ ces bya/ /hūm̐ dang zlos sngags zhes bya bas bskor bar bsam na/ bzlas bsgom byas na/ /khro bo chen po nyid du 'gyur/ /rdo rje brtan par bdag gyur la/ nam mkha'i snying po/ /snying khar oṃ zhes bya ba yis/ /bskor ba'i dbus dang tram̐ ldan pa/ /bsam na rin chen 'dra bar 'gyur/ /rdo rje bsgom pa snying khar ni/ /dbus su tram̐ zhes bya ba bsam/ /dkyil 'khor bzlos sngags oṃ zhes bya bas bskor bsam na/ /phyag na pad+mo mnyam par 'gyur/ /'khor lo rgya gram de'i dbus su/ hūm̐ rdo rje las zhi bar bsgom la/ ldan par/ /a zhes bya ba de'i dbus su bskyed nas kyang / /hūm̐ dang a las oṃ zhes bya bas bskor bsam na/ /rdo rje las dang mnyam par 'dra zer/ 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa gzhan don la lnga ste/ 'phrin las bzhi mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi las tshogs/ phrin las bzhi'i 'jug bstan pa/ 'khor gyi lags so bya ba sbyin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'phrin las mdor bstan pa ni/ de nas las rnams bshad bya ste/ /zhi ba dang ni rgyas pa'i las/ /de ltar dbang dang mngon spyod rgyas bshad skabs su mngon spyod dam ma smos pa la bkas 'chad pas so/ /rnams/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg cho ga yis/ /las rnams thams cad bya ba yin/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa ni/ rdo rje ched du gtad pa la/ sems par bdag bsgyur lha'i rnal 'byor gang rung gis byas la/

/zhi ba'i las ni brtsams bya zhing / /cho ga shes pas dus kyi shes pa nyid/ nang par nyid/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg nyid byed cing / /'od zer dkar po sprin gyi tshogs lta bu de lus bsgrub bya la/ /'phro bar gyur pa rnams bsgom la/ /rtag tu shar brtas 'od zer gyis/ / phyogs kyi shis pa nyes pa thams cad nyon mongs zer/ sel byed pa/ /'di ni sems can phan dga' bas/ /gdul bya de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs las bya/ /kun tu bzang po'i sku chen nam/ /bde ba chen por bsam nas kyang / /nang par re re'i 'od byed na/ /snga ma bzlas pa sbyin sreg sogs bzhin du las byas te/ /nang par sngar ni sems can rnams/ /sdig can sems ni zhi bar byed/ /gser 'od mdzes shing 'bar ba yis/ / lo ka dang ldan rin chen bzhin du bsam nas ni/ /bza' ba lto thon rjes/ legs bcas phyed tshun chad nyi ma yi/ /gung la rgyas pa'i las shis te/ /rin chen 'dra ba'i zur brgyad/ khung thab brkos la/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg rab tu bya/ /yang na sngags pas snga ma bzhin/ /'od kyi sprin ser po lta bu lus bsgrub bya la rab bkang ste/ /sbyor dang cho ga dang ldan pas khud du ni/ /pad+mo thab 'dra bar byas nas kyang / /pad+mo rdo rje chos 'dzin par bdag 'gyur la/ /dga' shar/ dang dus/ nye ba nyi ma'i mthar/ nub tsam/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg nyid byed pa'i/ /'od zer dmar po sprin gyis lus bkang nas/ /bsgrub bya/ thams cad ma lus dbang du bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa sems dpa' bcu drug gi las tshogs ni/ 'dren pa kun tu bzang po yis/ /zhi ba'i las ni rab tu bya/ zhi ba'i las ni mi shes des 'gre /rdo rje rin chen rgyas pa ste/ /dbang bskur ba yang de bzhin no/ /dbal sems dpa' rnams kyi bsgrub pa'i las te shar gyi sems dpa' bzhi dang rdo rje rin chen bka' chad bsrung /

gyi rnam rgyal de bzhin du/ /longs spyod dbang phyug dpal mnyam med/ phan yon 'di dang / /rdo rje nyi ma gzi brjid dang / /mdog sdug shin tu 'bar bar bya/ /bzhad cing rmad du mdzad pas bzhad pa'i ting nge 'dzin grub na/ ni/ /dga' mgu rang pa rnams su 'gyur/ /pad+ma chos kyi ting nge 'dzin grub na bzhad pas chos kun ni/ /rtogs mdzad sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /mnyam 'gyur lha bran smos ci dgos/ /gzhan gyi rigs sngags tshogs mchog rnams/ /rnon pos grub na gcod pa nyid du mdzad/ /gdon dang yi dwags 'dri rnams dang / /gnod sbyin srin po bka' nyan dang / /gza' mchog brgyad po ma rung rnams/ /'khor bcas 'khor lo'i ting nge 'dzin gyi grub na rtsad nas 'byin par mdzad/ /lkugs dang smra ba'i ting 'dzin gyi grub na/ lkug pa ma yin dang / /glen rnams mi smra smra bar mdzad/ /lce la dzam̐ zhes bya ba yis/ /ma rung rnams kyang lkugs par mdzad/ /rgya gram gyi ni mchod pa las/ dang / /sems can don mdzad thams cad ston/ /ham̐ hūm̐ zer/ zhes bya bas bsrung ba 'phro mdzad cing / /rdo rje srung bas bsrung bar mdzad/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i sa bon ni/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin nyid kyis kyang / /ma rung rab tu ma rung kun/ /za byed sdig spyod smos ci dgos/ /ma rung khur snying khar dam du ni/ /bam̐ zhes bya bar bsam nas kyang / /dug dang ri dwags gdon la sogs/ /rdo rje bsdams pas bcing bar mdzad/ /ces pas bstan/ bzhi pa 'phrin las bzhi'i mjug bsdu bstan pa ni/ bzlas dang sems dpa' bcu drug lha'i rnal 'byor byas nas zhi bar byed na sku mdog dkar po sngags kyi mtha' rten zhi ba'i de bzhin du thab dang rdzas dang gnas dang dus me lha chas gos rnams bzhi bar bya de bzhin gsum po la'ang sbyar sbyin sreg las rnams kyis/ /dgos pa thams cad 'grub par bya/

/'od zer gsal bas dngos po la/ /rgyas par 'gyur pa bsgom byed cing / /zhi ba'i sems dpa' bcu drug sems kyis zhi bar bya/ /sems dpa' bcu drug rgyas par byed na rang gi lus ni gser btso ma/ /nyi ma gsal shar dge 'dra bar/ /bsam la rgyas par bya ba'i phyir/ /'od zer sprin gyi dga' bar bya/ /pad+mo bcu drug gi dbang gi las byed na sems dpa'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /hri 'dra 'od zer btang ba yis/ /snying la kun tu bskor byed cing / /'dod pa 'i rgyal po kun gyi dbang du byed/ /rdo rje hūm̐ gi ting 'dzin gyi/ /khros pas rdo rje mtshon cha'i char/ /sdig spyod lus la dbab mdzad na/ /de ma thag tu med par 'gyur/ de yan chad sbyin sreg lha'i rnal 'byor/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa 'khor gyi lags so bya ba byin pa ni/ de nas 'di sa bcad de gud par btags/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir/ the tshom thams cad gcod pa dang / ngan song thams cad bzlog pa'i brtag pa dam pa 'di bshad pa legs so legs so/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa phyag rgya'i ye shes la gnyis te/ mdo dang / rgyas pa'o/ /dang po mdo ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes phyag rgya'i le'u 'di bshad do/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas pa la gsum/ lag pa byin gyis rlabs pa/ phyag rgya bcing thabs dngos/ zhar la byung ba sngags bstan pa'o/ /dang po lag pa byin rlabs ni/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la/ ngag tu brjod pa a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du gyi byin gyis brlabs par bsam ste/ byang chub kyi sems hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang shes rab a zhes bya bas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor de gnyis byin gyis brlabs la/ lag pa gnyis kyi thal mo gnyis ka la a la sogs pa'i yi ge bcu drug gis kun tu bkang zhing 'phro bar bya ste/

mthe bong gnyis la oṃ zhes bya ba bsam/ gung mo gnyis la tram̐ zhes bya ba bsam/ mdzub mo gnyis la hūm̐ zhes bya ba bsam/ srin lag gnyis la hri zhes bya ba bsam/ mthe chung gnyis la a zhes bya ba bsam/ de ltar yi ge rnams bsam par byas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yin par mos g.yas kyi be ro sogs lnga g.yon gyi de dang 'dra ba'i lha mo lnga pa bskyed de/ chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres pa skad sor bzhag pa la a n+yo na la sogs pa yod pas de dag brjod/ bdag dang yang dag rjes su mthun par byas te/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa phyag rgya bcings thabs dngos ni/ lag pa gnyis pad+ma lta bur sbyar ba byas nas/ oṃ zhes bya ba brkyangs pa dang / a zhes bya ba gnyis bkug ste/ de bzhin du hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang / hri zhes bya ba gnyis pad+mo'i 'dab ma 'dra bar bya'o/ /tram̐ zhes bya ba gnyis gshibs te brkyangs la/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya 'di nyid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo kun tu bzang po'i ste las thams cad dang ldan pa'i dam tshig go /de nyid sngar gyi mu dra de nyid la ral gri 'debs pa'i tshul du byed pa'ang kun bzang thugs kyi'o/ /rnon po dang 'dra ba dang / de las rab tu 'khor lo dang 'dra ba ni 'khor lo'i 'o/ thal mo sbyar la sor mo rnams rtse mo yid tsam bkug pa la de nyid kyi sku'i mu dra'o/ /de nyid las 'khor lo mu dra khar bzhag pa ni sgra'i ste 'di ni de nyid gsung gi'o/ phyag rgya'i tshogs so/ /de nyid gar dang bcas pa gnyis su byas nas gar byas na las kyi'o/ / lnga po 'di kun bzang gcig po'i/ g.yon pa 'jigs byed dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbang phyug gnyis kyi'o/ /mgo thod thogs 'dra dang / /g.yas pa mdung rtse rtse gsum pa/ /g.yon pa pad+ma kha 'dzum dang / /g.yas pa oṃ zhes bya bar 'i steng du bzhag

/g.yon pa khyab 'jug 'khor lo 'di rtsibs ltar dbyug tho gsum/ g.yas pa'i mthe chung mthe bos mnan te sor mo lhag ma gsum bsgrengs pa'o/ /a brgya byin dang oṃ gnyis lag gnyis char gyi rtse sprad la/ /lhag ma gsum ni rdo rje can/ /hūm̐ ka ma la de'i/ dang oṃ gnyis gzhung byas la/ /lhag ma mdar byas mda' can gyi skar mda'i tshul du brkyang ba/ /lag pa g.yas g.yon 'khor lo thal mo sbyar bsam/ bya/ /'di ni gza' dang nyi ma zla ba yis/ /mig dmar/ thal mo dam sbyar brkyang bskum yang byed pa/ sor mo 'phro/ /lag pa'i mu dra gza' lag rtag tu se gol gtogs/ /de nyid phur pa'i tshig dbang gsum pa ste/ /mchu la mtheb mdzub gnyis kyi kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul du byed/ tshig chub 'dra bar bzhag /pa wa sangs kyi mu dra ni gnyis mnyam sbyar/ /spen pa 'i mu dra dbyug pa 'dzin pa ltar bya/ /ba glang sna ltar ni chu srin sgra gcan lag pa gnyis brkyangs nas thur bkug pa glang po che'i sna 'dra ba'i tshul 'dra/ /shes bya rgyu skar rnams kyi me tog 'phro ba ltar sor mo rnams brkyangs bskums byed pa 'dra/ /de nyid bskor na glog 'phreng gi ltar myur ba/ bla 'og bzhag pa sprin klu spyi'i phyag rgya/ /'di dag snying po'i thugs bskul ba'i don gyi na phyag rgya ste/ las kyi phyag rgya yang 'di dag nyid do/ /de nyid sngar gyi pad+ma lta bu'i mu dra de nyid 'gre yang na sngar gyi lag pa gnyis pad 'dra ba las srin lag sbas pa ni phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las hūm̐ zhes bya ba'i tshigs bar ma bcag pa ni/ dbang bskur byed pa ste nam mkha'i snying po'i phyag rgya de nyid 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas su 'god pa'am gong ma bya'o des kun 'gre'o/

/las hūm̐ zhes bya bas bsdams la srin lag pad+ma 'dra bar byas pa ni pad+ma las byung ba'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i nub tu dgod phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las hūm̐ zhes bya ba dang hri zhes bya ba dang gshibs te bsgrengs pa ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gtso bo sems dpa'i phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las pad+mo 'dra bar byas pa ni bde ba chen po'i phyag rgya'o/ / 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo/ de nyid 'od zer 'dra ba'i tshul du byas pa ni kun tu bzang po'i gtso bo 'dis byas na phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid nang du mdzub srin bkug pa ni khro bo sna tshogs gzi brjid can 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi g.yon gyi phyag rgya'o/ /de nyid las shin tu khur/ bsdams pa ni rdo rje bsdams khur/ pa'i brkyangs ba mthe bong phye ste bsgrengs pa la ni bsrung ba rdo rje bsrung ba'i 'o/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba so ltar mdzub mo gnyis mche ba ltar byas pa ni rdo rje gnod sbyin no/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba gnyis lcags kyur byas pa rdo rje rgyal po ni dgug pa'o/ /de nyid las mdzub mo gnyis brkyangs te mdar byas pa ni mda'i chags pa 'o/ /hūm̐ dang oṃ zhes bya ba gnyis sbyar nas se gol/ ba ni legs pa'i dgyes rdo rje sems dpa' sngar song bas shar gyi bzhi'o/ pa'i 'o/ /de nyid sems dpa'i kha cig na med/ dkyil 'khor lta bur byas pa ni/ gzi brjid kyi'o/ /de nyid rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe bong gnyis mnyam ste mdzub gnyis bcag la/ nor bu 'dra bar byas pa ni rgyal mtshan gyi'o/ /rgyal mtshan gyi de nyid bskor na bzhad pa ste bcu drug po 'di kho nar dgos so/ /de nyid khar bzhag na dgyes shing 'dzum par mdzad pa ni ya mtshan no/ rin chen lngar song bas lha'i bzhi'o/

/thal mo pad+mar bkug pa ni spyan ras gzigs pad+ma'i 'o/ /thal mo sbyar ba las a zhes bya ba dang / oṃ zhes bya ba nang du bkug pa ni ral gri'i phyag rgya'o/ /thal mo'i sor mor rnams gcig la gcig sbyar ba ni 'khor lo'i rgyu snga ma 'khor lo'i mu dra blangs nas 'thung ba'i tshul las oṃ zhes bya ba gnyis khar bzhag pa ni tshig 'byung ba smra ba'i ste/ mdor na phyag rgya 'di dag ni las thams cad sbyin par byed pa'o/ /de nyid mthe bong / bsdus btud sbrul mgor 'gyur/ /kun du gnod sbyin mche ba 'dra/ khur bcings mthe bong brkyangs thad ka nas mche ba ltar byas pa/ /srin po lag pa g.yas pa blangs nas 'thung tshul yi ni khrag 'phrog pa/ /lag pa bskor ba nas/ rlung gi lha'i ba dan 'dzin tshul ste/ /dbyug thor ldan pa 'dzin pa'i tshul byed pa/ gnod sbyin no/ /lha'i bum pa bzhag pa nor gyi ste/ /mthe bo'i sna 'dra bsre me'i sne le'i sna 'dra bar bya zer ku bhe ra'i 'o/ /mgo yi thod pa rlon pa nag po ste/ /bh+ring gi ri ti lag brkyangs ba/ 'jigs byed brgyad kyi yang na dbang ldan gyi steng phyogs dkyil 'khor du/ lha chen brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du/ /pi wam̐ g.yon thogs dri za'o/ yul 'khor bsrung gi'o/ /me lha lag gnyis 'bar ba me 'bar ba/ kyi sor mo rnams me lce ltar gdengs pa/ /gung mo dbyug 'dra gshin rje yis/ /rno la khro dang dbang bsgyur ma/ /rdo rje bsdams pa las mthe chung gnyis gshibs te brkyangs nas ral gri 'debs pa ltar byed pa phal skyes pos mthe chung ral gri mdzub zhags pa/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub gnyis sbyar/ /rlung gi rgyan mtshan lha'i mu dra/ dar 'dzin pa'i dang po gnyis gyi'o/ /de la sogs pa'i phyag rgya rnams/

/lag las skyes pa skye bar 'gyur/ /lha rnams kun gyi thun mong du/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya bkra shis te/ lag pa pad+ma 'dab brgyad ltar byed pa/ /klu rnams zhes bya ut+pa pad+ma'i mu dra di nyid cung zad bsdus la/ /de ltar so ni lag pa gnyis ka sen mo rnams gshibs te ston pa/ gnod sbyin rnams/ /srin mo rnams kyi mgo tshul pa/ lag gnyis kyi skyor mo'i tshul du byas pa/ /bud med ḍā ki ni brgyad kyi/ yang na 'jigs byed brgyad kyi chung ma rnams kyi sor bcu bsnol/ /spyi'am gza' rnams kyi ni dbyug pa 'phyar ba'i tshul ste/ /ar+gham̐ dbul ba snyim pa gnyis bzed pa las gung mo gnyis bkug pa/ rgyu skar bcas/ rnam spyi'i/ /de dag kun gyi sems mu dra bstan pas/ bsgrub pa'i/ /mgo rlon pa bo skam po tshal pa gsum gnyis gcig 'dra/ thod pa khar bzhag pa'i/ /phyag rgya 'di ni phra men mkha' 'gro ma zer pa'o/ kun rig du dgos/ /mgo thod lce yi phyag rgya ni/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yis bshad/ /lo ka ba de dag kun gyi thun mong du/ /phyag rgya chen po bshad par bya/ /lo ka ba brkyangs par bshad pa ni/ /yang na thal mo pad+mar bya/ /rdo rje 'i phyag rgya snyim par byas par sor mo rtse mo brnol ba la lce mngon pa'i khu tshur bcings nas ni/ /a zhes bya ba lu gu brgyud/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba gnyis bsgrengs pa/ /phyag na rdo rje'i phyag rgya yin/ /rdo rje bsdams pa bsdams lo ka gsum snang nas kyang / /hūm̐ dang a gnyis gshibs te bsgreng / /oṃ zhes bya ba ngos bcar ba'i/ sbyar zer/ /phyag rgya snang bar byed pa'i mchog /de nas lo ka gsum 'dul a zhes bya ba bcings/ /de las oṃ zhes bya ba gsum 'ching nang du gzhug /de las/ a zhes bya ba gsum 'jig son bzhin sbyar/

/de las oṃ yang a dang 'dra bar mi g.yo mgon po/ bya/ /tram̐ zhes bya ba gshibs nas ni/ /a dang oṃ gnyis lu gu rgyud/ /lhag ma gshibs pa'i phyag rgya ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i phyag rgya shes par bya/ /tram̐ zhes bya ba dbyug sngon po gshibs nas ni/ /hūm̐ zhes bya ba de bzhin no/ /de ltar hūm̐ zhes bya ba gshibs/ /lhag ma bzhi po de kun rig dkyil 'khor du dgos 'od zer 'bar ba bya/ /rta mgrin phyag rgya gang yin pa/ /de yang las rnams kun la gsungs/ /sangs rgyas/ spyan mu dra ni rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis rtse sprad mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs dang por btsugs te mig 'dra bar byas srin lag mthe'u chung nang du bcug pa'i steng mthe bos mnan pa mig dang 'dra bar bya/ /mu dra mā ma ki ni thal mo sbyar ba las srin lag dang mthe'u chung nang du bcug pa'am ma bcug kyang rung ste mdzub mo gnyis rdo rje'i rwa ltar gung mo la ma reg par blta'o/ /rdo rjer bshad/ rtsa gsum pa/ /dkar thal mo sbyar ba las gung mo gnyis pad+ma ltar byas la mthe'u chung gnyis so sor 'phral ba'o/ mo yi mu dra/ pad+ma nyid du bshad/ /ut+pal la ni thal mo sbyar ba las mdzub mo gnyis gung mo rgyab nas dkris te mthe bong gung mo la sbyar lhag ma la bsnol ba sgrol mar bshad/ bzhi po de kun rig dkyil 'khor du dgos/ /ces pas bstan/ gsum pa zhar la byung ba sngags bstan pa ni/ sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa/ ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba ba/ dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra dz+ra/ twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa twa/ shar gyi bzhi/ hūm̐ dzā/ ho/ dha lho'i bzhi/ tram̐/ r+ya/ bh+ri/ ha/ nub kyi bzhi/ hri dhi/ krum̐/ bha/ byang gi bzhi/ kaṃ raṃ/ k+ṣam̐/

sam̐/ kun rig gi dkyil 'khor du dgos pa'i sgeg mo la sogs pa'i sngags ni rang ming la oṃ spel ba ste badz+ra la s+ya zhes bya ba ste des 'gre/ mu dra de nyid 'dus pa ltar byas/ yang na rigs gsum spyi'i khongs su 'du/ spyan ma oṃ bud+dha lo tsa na hūm̐/ mā ma ki oṃ badz+ra mā ma ki tram̐/ gos dmar mo oṃ badz+ra paṇa ḍa re dhe hi dhe hi sid+dhi bod+dhi lo ki ta ram pa swāhā/ sgrol ma oṃ oṃ badz+ra ta re tut+ta re hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swa swa swa/ zhi ba'i brdung drug sbrel du gong bar bya/ 'phrin las mi byed na'ang chog 'phrin las byed na sems dpa' bcu drug sngags kyi mtha' rten du btags pa la lag pa rnga dang cang te'u dang kar ko dang gling bu dang rnga bo che la sogs pa brdung zhing ba'o/ /shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ shām̐ pa ta/ rgyas pa'i brdung ba'o/ /ring po/ ghuṃ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐ ghum̐/ dbang gi brdung ba'o/ /ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐ ho dūm̐/ mngon spyod kyi brdung ba'o/ /kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐ kha tam̐/ zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa me ltar 'bar bar 'phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ lha rnams kyis zhus pa dang / phyag na rdo rjes bshad pa'o/ /dang po lha rnams kyis zhus pa ni/ de nas lha rnams kun dga' nas/ /phyag na rdo rjer phyag 'tshal te/ /khro bo'i 'khor lo bshad pa'i phyir/ /gsol ba btab pa nyid du gyur/ /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa phyag na rdo rjes bshad pa la bzhi/ sngags kyi 'phreng ba/

rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba/ bsgrub pa/ 'phrin las bstan pa'o/ /dang po sngags kyi 'phreng ba ni/ bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes rang gi zhi ba'i/ zhi ba'i sku bor te rdo rje sems gdul bya gdug pa can khro bo'i skur bzhugs te/ rdo rje gnyis su med pa'i mnyam pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i khro bo rdo rje me nyi ma zhes bya ba'i snying po nyid kyi thugs kha nas phyung ngo / /oṃ dril bu/ kha cig na med badz+ra satwa kro dha ha na lārka ma hā badz+ra kro ta dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a pa ya na sh+ya na sh+ya/ ha ra ha ra pra na nā hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'jig rten gsum snang shar oṃ tre lo kya lo ka ka ra hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsum 'dul lho oṃ tre loka dha ma ka dha phaṭ/ gsum 'jig bya oṃ lo ka na shā ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsum 'chi nub oṃ ḍi bha ban dha ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsum snang gi g.yas su bdud rtsi 'khyil pa oṃ a mri ta hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsum 'dul g.yas su dbyug pa sngon po oṃ ka la dan da hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsum 'chang g.yas su mi g.yo ba oṃ ka ni dhu ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ gsum 'jig pa g.yas su rta mgrin oṃ hri dhi hūṃ phaṭa/ dus kyi lcags kyu oṃ ka la a ku sha hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhags pa oṃ ka la pa sha hūm̐ phaṭ/ lcags sgrog oṃ ka la ban dha hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'bebs pa oṃ ka la rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭ/ dus kyi srin mo gsum snang g.yon oṃ ka la rak+ṣa si hūm̐ phaṭ/ dbyug pa ma gsum 'dul g.yon du oṃ ka la dan dhi hūm̐ phaṭ/ dus mtshan ma gsum 'ching g.yon oṃ ka la ra ti hūm̐ phaṭ/ gnod sbyin ma gsum 'jig gi g.yon du oṃ ka yak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba la gnyis/

bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / bzhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po bri zhing lha dgod pa ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor mi zad pa/ /lo ka'i khro bo la ltos nas che ba'i mchog ste rtsibs bcu gnyis/ phyogs bzhi re re mtshams bzhir sam phyogs bzhi gsum gsum mo/ gnyis gnyis/ /lha rdzas lha dang gzhal yas khang la 'bar ba'i 'phreng bas dkris/ /shin tu 'bar zhing cher 'bar ba/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor cher bris nas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bzhag par bya/ /'jig rten gsum snang la sogs khro bo brgyad pa kun/ /khro bo brgyad kyi ma rung phyogs skyong brgyad snying khar mnan nas sdig byed cing / /zhal ni shin tu mche ba gtsigs pa 'jigs 'jigs blta/ /phyag na ི mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa brgya phrag du mar ldan/ /sbrul dang mi sdug thod rlon skam gsum sku gsung thugs kyi rtags mgos brgyan pa'o/ /stag lpags kyi ni smad g.yogs bgos/ /rgyu ma gdug pa can zhabs 'og tu bcug pa'i rgyu ma drangs nas thogs shing dbu mtha' yas/ /mgo thod shas gang phyag na thogs/ /de ltar bris nas rtsibs rten gyi spyi'i gru la phyi rol tu/ dus kyi dbyug pa la sogs pa bzhi sngar yang tsakra'i rtsibs la bris te 'dir yang rtsig pa'i nang tsakra'i phyi'i gru chod la bris te bdug pa'i tsakra bzhi 'dod srin mo bzhi dang sgo ma bzhi/ zhal bzhi ni lha'i rnam pa gsum pa don dam bcu bdun no/ /srin po'i tshogs rnams bzhag par bya/ /sgo ba rnams ni ji bzhin du/ /rang gi phyag rgya las mtshan dang / /de nas bdud rtsis bkang ba yi/ /bum pa bcu drug mchod pa'i yang dbang bskur yang yin gsung bzhag par bya/ /gdug pa sha chen gyi gsur me tog dri zhim dang / sngon po/ zhun chen mar me dang ni bro snod dang / /kha zas bkang ba'i gtor ma dang /

/bza' dang bca' dang bdud rtsi chang dang sbyar dang / /mgo thod gang bar gyur pa rnams/ /dkyil 'khor du ni mang du bzhag /ces pas bstan/ gnyis pa bzhugs te bsgrub pa ni/ de nas slob dpon bdag nyid kyang / /mgu nas mgo thod phyag rgyas gzhug ye shes pa spyan drangs dgug gzhug byas mu dra la logs na med do/ /srin mo bzhi'i ḍā ki ni bzhi dang mthun no/ /rten yang gdug sogs bzhi dang mthun no/ /phyag rgya de dang de yi ni/ /sha rnams kun gyi dam tshig lha re re la rang sngags kyi mchod byed gzhan las khyad kyi chog gsol/ /de nas 'dod ldan snyed nas ni/ /hūm̐ gis mtshon rang sngags kyi zhes bya bas bsgrub par bya/ /de nas sngags mkhan sgo lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas dkyil 'khor gyi sgor yang / /de nyid nang nas bzhugs lha tshangs pa'i bzlas bsgom tshangs bar bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha re re la yang sngags kyi mchod pa dang gtor ma byed pa ste nyams len sngar dang gnyis gcig pa ste/ bzlas bsgom gyi gong zhugs rjes la byed par dran lan bsnyen par bya/ /de ni nges par dngos grub ster/ /yud tsam 'jig rten gsum dbang gyur/ /dkyil 'khor du slob dpon dang bsgrub pa'i grogs ni tshogs rnams dang / /rang gi lha yi tshogs rnams la/ /rgyud las byung ba'i dam tshig brjod/ /de nas mchod de langs nas kyang / /shar gyi tshogs can rdo rje sems khro bos dpa' yi/ /tshul du gnas nas 'byung bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas slob ma lha gnas sngon du song nas/ bsdus nas ni/ /lag na rin chen thogs te gzhug /dkyil 'khor du 'jug sngags oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ya hūm̐/ dam la bzhag oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa si hūṃ phaṭa/ de nas ye shes dbab kun rig nas 'byung ba'i tshigs bcad dang sbyar la me tog dor oṃ badz+ra kro ta larka su ra pra ti dza hūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra kro dha na ni rak+ṣa mgo la bcings/ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra khro bo/ kro ta pa sha dkyil 'khor bstan/ hūm̐ phaṭ/ tsan rgan mna' chu blud oṃ kre dha sa ma ye na hūm̐/ bhi ra ba tu hūm̐ phaṭ/ sngags gnyis po 'di la dam tshig bsgrag bya ba tsam las gzhan nas mi gsung oṃ badz+ra kro ta sa ma ye ma ti kra ma hūm̐ phaṭ de nas dam tshig bsgrag cing sdom pa dbog dbang bskur gsungs/ cod paṇa dbang gi dus su a bhi ṣiñtsa dor 'di mu dra snga ma dang 'dra'ang / sngags 'di yang snga ma bzhin gnas lngar sngar bzhin no/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ra dha sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'dis dbang bskur la de bzhin du dbang bskur bya'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa bsgrub pa ni/ de nas rang lha'i dzo gir byas te mtshan ma thob thob bzlas bsgom bya ba/ bsnyen pa/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bsgrub pa bya ste/ de dag gi bsgrub pa bshad de/ bdag nyid khro bor snyoms zhugs te/ /de nas snying khar ram̐ las nyi ma bsgom/ /rang gi chos kyi yi ge hūm̐ sngon po las/ /'phros nas yang dang yang 'od zer/ 'phros shing / ste zer/ /de gnyis 'od dang hūm̐ gnyis gcig tu sgom par byed/ /de nas 'grub 'gyur gzhan du min/ /khro bo'i rgyal po'i las kyi srin po sogs rang rgyud pa'ang thugs rje khro bor sprul pa rnams kyi/ las dngos su/ /gsod par yin par bshad mod kyi/ /der ma zad zhi dang dbang dang rgyas pa rnams/ /de dag byed 'gyur gdon mi za/ /rdo rje rang lha'i rnal 'byor byas te mtshan ma thob thob bsgom/ bzlas bya ba bsnyen pa/ bstan nas de bsgom la bsgrub pa bya ste/ sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gnas/ /khro bo'i bsnyen pa sngon du song nas bsgrub pa bya ba ni dkyil 'khor bsgoms byas la/ /bla ma dmod byed sogs gdug pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i nga rgyal gyi dkyil 'khor tsakra bsgom pa bsgrub pa lta bu bsnyen sgrub gnyis sngon du song ba tshar gcod na/

sems can 'jigs byed cing / /mdor na dug rigs gdon la sogs/ /de bzhin de dag thams cad ni/ /thabs la sogs pa thugs kha'i 'od zer dang bzlas pa 'joms byed pa/ /rta mgrin khros nas snying la 'byung 'gyur ba/ /bsad pa'i las la bsam par bya/ /khros par gyur pa rgod pa'i khas/ rta mgrin rta skad dang bcas pas/ /bsgrub bya'i sha dang khrag rnams 'jib byed cing / /de dag srog 'tsho ba 'phrog byed pa/ /bsam pa nges par brlag bsad par 'gyur/ /khro bo tshar gcod pa de yan 'dogs na 'jig rten gsum snang de la gzhan gyi byed na shar gyi lha gang yin pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor byas la/ mdzad/ /zla ba 'dra ba'i dge bsam dkar zhing / /lha'i sku dang thugs kha'i yi ge las 'od zer 'byung ba mang po yis/ /bsgrub bya'i lus la khyab par gyur pa rnams bsam la/ /rims dang gdon dang dug la sogs/ /'od zer de ni phyung nas bsgrub bya'i lus la kyang / /de yi nad rgas gnod pa rnams/ /zhi bya'i phyir ni ring du dor/ thar bar byed/ /de nas hūm̐ bsgrub bya'i lus la rang gi snying ka'i 'od zer gi tshogs bzhag la/ /rdo rje phyis bgegs mi 'jug pa'i don du bsrung ba lta bur bsgrub bya'i lus bsam zhing / /haṃ gi sngar gyi ho btags la thugs ka las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor los go char bya/ /'od zer chu bsgrub bya'i sdig pa 'khru ba/ yi dbang bskur ro/ /de nas de yi ming sngags spel bas smros shing / /bzlas pa tshul bzhin bsam par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa 'phrin las bstan pa la gsum ste/ zhi ba/ rgyas pa/ dbang / dang po zhi pa la bcu/ thab khung dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bri/ mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa/ phyogs kyi shis pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor/ bsgrub pa'i chas dang bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par/

yam shing bud shing gi khyad par/ bud shing la me sbar ba sngon du song bas me lha'i khyad par bstan pa/ me lha dang ye shes kyi lha la sbyin sreg bya ba dngos/ bsgrub bya la bsrung ba dang / gshegs su gsol ba'i cho ga ma grub na bskyar ba'i cho ga bstan pa'o/ /dang po thab khung dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ de nas thab khung zhi rgyas dbang gsum la rnam gcig ni/ /zla ba kha dog dkar po 'od dkar po rgyas pa'i 'od zer 'phro 'dra la/ /dman pa tha mal khru gang tsam 'am yang na 'bring blon po lta bu/ khru do pa/ /mi rgyal mchog rnams kyi ni gnyis su 'gyur/ gzhan las nyis 'gyur byas/ /de yi sa rnams thab khung gi rgyud gzhung nas 'byung ba'i cho gas rnam par sbyangs byas te/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad steng na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbus su rdo rje rtse lngar 'gyur pa gcig /'od zer dkar por 'phreng bskor gzi can gyis/ /'khor yug bzhi tshe dpag med bzhin lha rnams gnyis sam bzhi'am brgyad 'dis 'dzin phyag rgya'i tshogs rnams thams cad bri bya chu tshon gyi ste/ /rigs nyon mongs brgya la sogs phyag rgya 'joms pa'i mtshan mar/ rgya zur phyin cing / /rgyal po bzhi yi ji bzhin phyag mtshan rnams/ /phyogs kyi bdag po rnams kyang phyogs phyogs su/ /lha chen dmyal ba sogs 'bri ba dang mi 'bri ba'i lugs gnyis la sogs phyag rgya khyab 'jug dang / /sgo dang rta babs 'khor lo lta bu nyid du bri bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa ni/ dri zhim chus bkang mdog 'od dkar 'gyur pa/ /dkar pos shin tu dkris pa'i bum pa brgyad/ bzhag rtsa rig bzlas la/ /dkar gsum gang ba'i gtor ma lha bshos dang / /bdug pa mar me me tog rnams kyang bzhag /mchod pa bya ba'i phyir ni bla bre dang /

/gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rnga yab la sogs bzhag /nang re ga pur bcas pa'i dri zhim pa'i/ /tsan+dan la sogs byug pas thab la byug thab la byas la/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa phyogs kyi shis pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ kha ni shar phyogs bltas te sbyin sreg bya/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor byas la gshegs pa'i bstan la rdo rje dkyil krung gi bya ba'am/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa bsgrub chas dang bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par ni/ yang na rnal 'byor ldan zhing sems pa'i skyil krung / gdan/ /gos zer me tog stod g.yogs smad g.yogs la sogs 'phreng ba gar gyi rgyan/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi 'o ma dang / /nas kyi thug pa la sogs rnams/ /til mar dang ni til nyid dang / /yungs dkar dang ni 'bras yos dang / /'bras can nas dang gro rnams dang / /me tog shin tu dri zhim rnams/ /ga pur dang ni bsres nas ni/ /tsan+dan dkar pos dgos pa dang / /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa yam shing bud shing gi khyad par ni/ 'dab bdun me tog 'bras bu rnams/ /zho dang ldan pa'i yam shing la/ /de dag thab khung bu'i khyad par che na yam shing ri/ las/ /rang gi sor gyis gcal bya zhing / /nyi shu rtsa bzhi yan chad mchog /sor bcu drug ni bar ma ste/ /tha ma bcu gnyis nyid du shes/ /shin tu chung na sor brgyad de/ /bud shing 'o ma can zho dang ldan pa la/ /dri chus bskus pas shes par bya/ /bud shing / zhes pas bstan/ drug pa bud shing la me sbar la sngon du song bas me lha'i khyad par bstan pa ni/ de las byung ba'i me/ sbar nas dri chus gtor bdud rtsi 'khyil sogs khro bo'i sngags bzlas nas ni/ /pad+ma me lha la dkar po'i zhal 'dra dge /pad+ma nor bu ril ba thogs/ de'i phyag mtshan/ /lag na dbyug pa mchog thogs pa/ /pad+ma dkar po'i gdan steng 'dug /de lta'i me lha bkug nas kyang / /ar+gham̐ blangs te dbul me lha rang sngags kyi mchod pa lnga dbul/

bar bgyi/ /de nas zla rgyas dkar po la/ /bzhugs pa'i 'gro phan dkyil 'khor gcig gi rang lha la mchod yon dang mchod pa lnga 'bul spyan drangs te/ /pad+ma dkar po'i shar phyogs su/ /bsam ste steng du bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa me lha dang ye shes kyi lha la sbyin sreg bya ba dngos ni/ de nas de ltar bsam nas kyang / /bsgrub bya rtag tu mdun bzhag ste/ /de yi nad gnod sogs nyes pa drangs nas ni/ /shin tu bsrings te sngar bsgrub pa'i skabs nas de'i nad rnams gnod pa dang bzhi ba'i phyir du dor zhes pa'i don/ sba bar bya/ de'i spang bya/ /de nas bsgrub bya nangs par sngar ni gtsang gyur cing / /shin tu dri zhim pos slob dpon dang bsgrub bya'i lus byugs la/ /lha rdzas kyi bdud rtsi bzhin bsam lha'i zhal zas bsreg rdzas dang bsgrub bya'i nad dang gdon sogs sbyin sreg bya/ /dam tshig 'di ni 'da' bar dka'/ /lha rdzas 'di ni bro lnga 'di/ /dang po me la rang sngags kyis brtag byas la/ /khro bo de ni me ltar 'bar ba la sogs pa'i ye shes kyi khro bo ste zhi ba lo ka gsum snang gi de lus su/ /spyan drangs nas ni bzhugs par bsam/ /de nas dang por khro bo spyan drangs pa'i khro la/ /rang sngags kyis bsreg bya lan gsum dbul bar bya/ /de nas dkon mchog mtshan na mo bud+dha ya gsum zer/ gsum la dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sngags kyis dbul/ /de nas me lha nyid la rang sngags kyis dbul/ /de nas dkyil 'khor gcig la byed pa'i dbang du byas na dang po gtso bo la de nas 'khor rnams la rang sngags kyis rdo rje sems pa la/ /de nas lha rnams re re la/ /de nas lha rnams phyi ma la bkod pa'i lo ka la/ bgegs la sogs zhi ba'i don du bgegs kyi ming dang sngags spel pa dbul/

/yid du 'ong ba'i lha rang lha la byed pa'i dbang du byas na yang rung / /de nas dang por me ltar 'bar ba sogs khro bo yi/ /sngags kyis sngags spel yam̐ shing sbyin sreg bya/ /de nas rdzas thams cad gcig tu bsres nas kyang / /bdud rtsi'i sngags kyis btab nas ni/ /de bzhin sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i tshul dang go rim mang bar gsungs kyang dang por me lha/ de nas rang lha/ de nas yang me lha la lhag ma gcig 'bul ba yod/ ro bsreg pa'i skabs de rnams ma gtogs pa khro bo la 'bul ba yod/ de'i don yang 'di yin gsungs/ byas 'og tu/ /brgyad stong nyid dam yang na ni/ /brgya rtsa brgyad kyi bar du ni/ /khro bo nyid la dbul bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ brgyad pa bsgrub bya la bsrung ba ni/ bsgrub bya de yi lus la dbang sngar kun rig bkod dkyil 'khor zer/ pa'i bum chus nus na kun rig ltar bskur zhing / /mnyam par bzhag pas bsrung nas kyang / /zhes pas bstan/ dgu pa gshegs su gsol ba'i cho ga ni/ mjug tu mngon par mchod nas yi ge brgya pa lan bdun bzlos nas lnga brgyad kyi ni/ /lha rnams thams cad oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /la sogs sngar ltar spyan drangs pa rnams gshegs par gsol/ /'dis ni zhi ba'i las rnams kyang / /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /ces pas bstan/ bcu pa la grub na bskyar ba'i cho ga bstan pa ni/ ci ste de ni sdig can nam/ /gal te mnyam par ma bzhag pas/ /de tshe dngos grub dngos por 'dzin pa shas che bas kun rig tu bshad pa'i rtags ma gyur na/ /stong pa nyid du rnam bsgom la/ /de nas de bzhin sa sbyang ba nas gshegs gsol gyi bar du byas nas kyang / /gdon mi za bar dngos grub 'gyur/ /zhi ba'i las rdzogs so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyas pa la bcu bzhi ste/ sbyin sreg gi gnas dang thang dang dkyil 'khor bri ba/

mchod rdzas dgod pa/ sgrub pa po'am chas/ phyogs kyi shis pa sngon du song bas bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor/ ting nge 'dzin dang bzlas brjod kyi khyad par/ mchod pa/ yam shing bud shing gi khyad par/ bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par/ me lha sbyin sreg bya ba/ ye shes kyi lha dang sbyin sreg bya ba dbang bskur ba/ bsrung ba'o/ /dang po sbyin sreg gi gnas ni/ 'bras bur de ni rgyas par bya dgos te zer/ ldan pa'i nags tshal lam/ /yang na gnas sam rgyal po dang / /rgyal rigs khyim du rgyas pa ni/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis bya ba ste/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa thab dang dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ khru do yang na khru bzhi 'am/ /de ltar mchog ni khru brgyad pa 'o/ /chung mchog bar ma rnams la gcig /rgyas pa'i las ni bya ba yin/ /mdor na hoṃ khung bya ba ni/ /stegs bu brtsigs te dkyil 'khor ni/ /chung ba la ni khru brgyad de/ /bar ma la ni bcu gnyis nyid/ /mchog la bcu drug yang na ni/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi shes par bya/ mu khyud kyi phyir bskyed pa dang yar rtsig pas mnyam/ de'i phyed mar bab pa dang rat+nas spras pa 'di med/ /mu khyud sor brgyad bcu drug gam/ /sum cu gnyis su bya ba yin/ /phyi yi 'khor lo de yi phyed/ /pad+ma rnams rat+nas spras kyis brgyan par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su rin chen zur brgyad pa dang / /pad+ma sna tshogs brgyan par bya/ /de yi dbus su brko ba ni/ /legs par bltas rgyar khru do la zabs su khru gang / te phyed kyi tshad/ /gru bzhi pa 'am zur brgyad pa/ /yang na dpal bskyed thab kyi dbyibs pad+ma 'dra/ /mdor na 'jim pa ser po yis/ /de bzhin thab mchog brtsigs bus nas kyang zer nas ni/ /gur gum la sogs bskus nas kyang / /de yi dbus su bri ba ni/ /mtshan mchog ser pos bskus nas kyang / /gser mdog 'dra bar bsgom par bya/ /de nas tshon rtsi dmar ser gyis/

/rin chen phyir bskyed pa la/ /pad+ma la yar ba gcig pa la sogs pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor khor yug mar phab pa la rdo rje rtse lnga de bas phab pa la rgya gram tu/ /gnas pa nyid du bri bar bya/ /rim lha rnams gcig la 'das pa gcig la lo ka pa gnyis sam ni rim bzhi pa/ gnyis pa la 'das pa gnyis la lo ka ba/ /yang na rim pa brgyad bzhi pa la 'das pa bzhi pa la lo ka ba ldan par/ /der ni sgo ba de dag nyid/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs su bri bar bya/ thams cad rtsa ba'i lha yin gsungs/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa ni/ bum pa kha dog gser 'dra zhing / /dri chus rab tu bkang ba la/ /shin tu mdzes brgyad bcu gnyis sam/ /sum cu gnyis sam bcu drug ste/ dkyil 'khor tsakra gtso bo'i sngags bsam zhing rtsa rig gam yang lha'i khro bo'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs/ /dkri ba'i dar ni ser po la/ /kha rgyan yal ga me tog can/ /dri zhim me tog bdug pa dang / /'phreng ba mar me rgyan rnams dang / /rgya mtshan 'phan la sogs pa dang / /bla bre gdugs rnams ser pos brgyan/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa sgrub pa po'i chas ni/ bdag nyid gos dang rgyan rnams dang / /me tog la sogs ser pos brgyan/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa phyogs kyi shis pa sngon du song bas bdag nyid lha'i rnal 'byor ni/ byang phyogs kha bltas 'dug nas ni/ rgyas pa la phan 'dogs pa'i lha byang na yod/ /'jig rten 'dul sogs khro bo yi/ /nyid kyi dkyil 'khor 'di'i dbang du byas pa ste gzhan gyis byed na lho phyogs kyi lho gang yin pa'i rnal 'byor rjes dran zhing / /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa ting nge 'dzin dang bzlas brjod kyi khyad par ni/ lha yi yid sgrub pa po'i ting nge 'dzin la mdun gyi nam mkhar 'di rnams bsam/ bzhin nor rgyal mtshan/ /rgyas pa la phan 'dogs pa'i lha rnams btso ma yi ni gser dang 'dra/

/de bzhin nyi zla ku bhe ra/ /nor sbyin dang ni dzam+bha la/ ming gi rnam grangs/ /gser gyi char rang lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas dmigs yul du lha de rnams bzhag nas sbyin sreg sngon du 'og tu bzlas pa bya/ ni rab 'bebs shing / /yid kyi 'dod pa skong mdzad pa/ /mdor na de yi 'od zer gyi/ /nges par dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /de nas rgyal srid thob 'gyur na/ /lus rgyas pa dang smos ci dgos/ /rgyas par bya phyir de ming nas/ khro bo'i brgyadapa zer/ /smos khri ni zer te brgya phrag brgya rtsa brgyad/ brgya zer/ /yang na de bzhin stong phrag 'bum zer nyid/ /brgya rtsa brgyad brgyad stong zer du bzlas par bya/ /de nas sngar lha gang bsgom pa'i sbyin sreg rab bya ste/ /byang phyogs su ni seng ge yi/ /gdan gyi steng na rin chen dang / /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan lnga brtsegs zer seng ge'i steng na/ /rdo rje lho phyogs sems dpa' dang ni rin chen mchog /rin chen dpal dang gzi brjid mchog /rdo rje bzhad dang rin chen mtshan dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rab brgyan nas/ /phyag ni mchod sbyin gzhol ba dang / /rin chen char yang 'bebs brtson cing / /'od zer gser 'phreng thams cad kyis/ /de la shin tu khyab byed bsam/ /zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa mchod pa ni/ dung dang cang te'u pi wang dang / /sil snyan glu dang gar mchog gis/ /mdor na sngar gyi lha rnams la mchod pa byas nas ni/ /de yi 'og tu las brtsam mo/ /zhes pas bstan/ brgyad pa yam shing dang bud shing gi khyad par ni/ /khung bu'i khyad par rab 'bring tha ma nyid las kyang / /yam shing bud shing khyad par dbye/ /ring thung gi tshad mdzub gang khur bcang sa khru dang / /chung ngu nyid du bshad pa yin/ /bar ma khru dor shes par bya/ /khru bzhi pa ni mchog yin te/ /me tog 'bras bu bcas rim kyi/

/ya thog ma thog sbrang rtsir bzhugs/ /zhes pas bstan/ dgu pa bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par ni/ 'bru rnams thams cad 'byor pa dang / /me tog 'bras bu ser por ldan/ /mar dang sbrang rtsi bsres nas ni/ /phal cher dpal gyi 'bras bur ldan/ /zhes pas bstan/ bcu pa me lha sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ me lha gser dang 'dra ba la/ /phyag mtshan skabs bzhin phyag bzhi pa de 'dir de bzhin/ /pad+ma'i gdan gzhug rnam brgyan pa/ /spyan drangs bsreg blugs rgyud gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin bya sbyin sreg bya/ mchod yon dang mchod pa rang sngags kyis 'bul lo/ /zhes pas bstan/ bcu gcig pa ye shes kyi lha la sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ de yi lus su khro rgyal po/ dkyil 'khor gang byed pa'i lho'i lha/ /byin chen legs par bcug nas ni/ /sngon bzhin dran byed de zhal du/ /sbyin sreg yongs su brtag bya ste/ /'bum mam dung phyur zer/ gnyis 'bum tsam gyis kyang / /de ni nges par rab tu grub/ /'bum phrag brgyas ni rgyal srid do/ /longs spyod phun sum tshogs par 'grub/ /ces pas bstan/ bcu gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ de nas mjug tu 'od zer gyis de la dbang bskur/ zhes pas bstan/ bcu gsum pa bsrung ba ni/ bsrung bar bya/ /de nas de ni rgyas 'gyur te/ /phyag na rdo rje'i bka' bzhin no/ /rgyas pa'i las rdzogs so/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dbang la bcu gsum ste/ lha dang bsam pa bstan pa dang / gnas dang thab khung gi khyad par/ yam shing dang bud shing bstan pa/ bsreg pa'i rdzas thab khung la byug pa bya zhing mtshan ma bri ba/ mchod pa/ bsgrub pa'i chas/ sngon du song bas phyogs dang dus kyi shis pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par/ sbyin sreg gi me lha'i khyad par bsrung ba/ gshegs su gsol zhing rang la bsrung ba'o/ /dang po lha dang bsam pa bstan pa ni/ dbang ni chags pa'i sems kyis kyang / /bsgrub bya chags pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis kyang /

/byang sems chags pa bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /rdo rje chags byang sems la chags/ pa de las byung / /khams gsum chags par byed pa'i phyir/ /pad+ma sems la rtag tu chags/ /de bas 'di ni de dag gis/ /las grub par ni bshad pa yin/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa gnas dang thab khung gi khyad par ni/ chags dang mthun pa'i sa dmar po phyogs sam/ /smad 'tshong ma'i chags par byed pa'i khyim du shis/ bco blag tshos chen mkhan nam zla bud med/ mtshan can 'dzag pa/ dag gi /khyim du chags pa'i las rnams bya ba yin/ /yid dang mthun pa'i sa phyogs sam/ /rdo rje bcom ldan 'das la chags pa'i lha rten yod pa gnas kyang rung / /phyag na pad+ma'i gnas nyid du/ /rtag tu rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas/ rten yod pa/ /bde chen gyi ni gnas chen dang / sems dpa'i khyad par/ /pad+ma ut+pal rdzing bu dang / /ban du ka yi me tog nas/ /me tog 'bras bu dmar tshal ni/ /yid 'ongs sems ni chags byed pa/ /der ni stegs bu khru brgyad dam/ /de ltar bcu gnyis bcu drug rnams/ /byas nas de yi dbus su yang / /hoṃ khung dkyil 'khor bya ba ni/ /khru gang yang na khru do 'am/ /de ltar khru ni bzhi par bya/ /gzhu 'dra ba dang pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ 'dra/ /yang na rdo rje 'dra bar tshes gcig pa'i ri mo bya/ /zla 'dra zla ba kam̐ 'dra dang / /de ltar pad+ma'i 'dab ma gcig pa'i dbyibs sa 'dra/ zheng du mchu yi phyed kyi tshad/ /zheng gi phyed kyi tshad tsam du/ /hoṃ khung zabs su bskor bar bya/ /mu khyud sor ni bzhi par bya/ /nyis 'gyur ba ni khru do pa la sor brgyad des 'gre nyis 'gyur bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa yam shing dang bud shing gi khyad par ni/ tha ma mchog ni khyad par las/ /yam shing so so'i nges par bya/ /yang na yam shing bsreg shing gi /tshad ni bzhi ba'i las su gsungs/

/shin tu dmar ba'i tsan+dan nam/ /yang na shing mar gzhan yang rung / /me tog 'bras bu dmar po 'am/ /btsag dang tsan+dan rgya skyed sogs/ /leb rgan rtsi dang gur gum gyis/ /mdor na bud pa'i shing dang ni/ /yam shing la yang bskus nas ni/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa bsreg pa'i rdzas ni/ yungs dkar kha dog dmar po 'am/ /btsag dang mtshal yang de bzhin du/ /zangs kyi phyed dang yungs dkar dang / /ske tsha'i 'bru dang lañtsha dang / /til dang mang 'ga' la sogs des zhes 'byung / /zhun thigs 'bras bu dang / /la phug yungs rdog de bzhin du/ /khrag zla mtshan dang dngul ni chen po rnams/ /bsreg bya'i phyir ni bsdus nas kyang / /sngar bshad 'bras bu la sogs pa'i/ /btsag la sogs pa'i khru bas yang yang bskus nas ni/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i khro bo'i sngags kyis byin brlabs te/ /ba dang ra las bzhos pa yi/ /bsrubs ma thag pa'i mar gsar dang / /mar dang til mar rnams kyis dgangs/ /ga pur la sogs bsres nas kyang / /bdud rtsis 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis btab sti bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa thab khung la byug pa bya zhing mtshan ma bri ba ni/ de nas hoṃ khung dmar po la/ /byu ru'i sdong po 'dra bar dmar pos rgyun yangs/ /bsam nas spos dmar la sogs dang / /gur gum dmar pos byug par bya/ /de nas kha dog dmar po yi/ /stug po nyid du bsku bar bya/ /gur gum dmar po bsres pa yis/ /tshon gyi ri mo bri ba ni/ /hoṃ khung nang du pad+ma bri/ /de yi steng du dma' bcas gzhu/ /rtag tu hoṃ khung 'khor yug tu/ /phyi bskyed pa la pad+ma nyid du bri bar bya/ /gzhu yi dbus su yar brtsigs pa la rdo rje nyid/ /'khor yug tu ni mda' nyid bri/ /gzhu yi yar brtsigs pa de la gzhu'i phyi la rdo rje bris pa dang spel la/ phyi rol yar rtsig pa'i phyed mar phab la 'dir khor yug gsum pa la ste zhi rgyas dbang gsum char la bzhi bzhir byed na tshe dpag med kyi zhi ba'i thab bzhin no/

/pad+ma nyid/ /bris nas de yi steng du mda'/ /de yi phyi rol rdo rje lha rnams la sems dpa' bcu drug gis brgyan dang / /lcags kyu mda' bcas gzhu bris la/ logs pa chad lho phyogs rgyal mtshan rin chen dang / /gzi brjid dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ bzhed pa chad pad+ma ral gri 'khor lo rnams/ smra ba chad nub phyogs nyid du bri bar bya/ /rgya gram rdo rje che ba go cha'i mchog /byang phyogs su ni bri bar bya/ gur chad grwa rnams su lha rnams kyi ni spos la sogs/ bdug pa la sogs/ /phyag rgya'i gzugs su bris bya zhing / /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa mchod pa ni/ me tog dmar po la sogs pas/ /shin tu snga ma bzhin mchod de/ /zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa bsgrub pa'i chas ni/ dpal dang gos dang 'phreng ba dmar/ /dmar po'i bris ni bskus nas ni/ /zhes pas bstan/ brgyad pa sngon du song bas phyogs dang dus kyi shes pa ni/ rtag tu thub pa nub bltas la/ /dmar thag ma chad las bya ste/ /zhes pas bstan/ dgu pa ting 'dzin phyag rgyar ni/ /pad+ma dmar po'i gdan bsam la/ /rab chags rang gi nga rgyal phyag na pad+ma rnams/ /bsgrub pa'i g.yon du rdo rje chags pa las/ /g.yas su bde ba chen po ste/ /bsam nas de yi dbus su ni/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin ma bzhag /rdo rje gzhu dang g.yon gyi mda'/ /me tog dmar brgyan rab mdzes la/ /dri dmar la sogs rab mchod de/ /zhes pas bstan/ bcu pa sbyin bsreg gi me lha'i khyad par ni/ mda' dang gzhu me lha'i phyag mtshan thogs de bzhin du/ /pad+ma dmar dang dbyig thogs pa'i/ /me yi lha ni bkug nas kyang / /de yi dbus su khro rgyal po/ /legs par bcug ste bzhag nas kyang / gis mchod pa la sogs mchod pa lnga phul/ /'od zer chags pas dmar po bsgyur nas ni/ /de las rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa bcing pas bkug nas ni/

/bsgrub bya'i spyi bo zhabs kyi drung du sgrub pa po bzhag /de ltar bsam ste sdom zhugs pas/ /zhes pas bstan/ bcu gcig pa sbyin sreg gi phan yon ni/ las byed pa ni gang yin dang / /chags pa'i sems su byas nas ni/ /de yi 'od zer spyi bor gang / /de ni sgrub po rang gi lha'i snying la rak+ṣa btags la bsrung nas btang bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ bcu gsum gshegs su gsol zhing rang la bsrung ba ni/ de nas rdo rje 'dod pa 'dis/ /dbang gi lha rnams mchod de gshegs par gsol/ /sgrub pa po rang la de nas bsrung ba byas nas ni/ /rdo rje 'dod pas rtag tu bzlas/ /dbang gi las rdzogs so/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba la bdun te/ gang gis bstod pa/ mchod pa/ bstod pa'i yul/ bsam pa/ bstod pa'i tshig bstod pa'i phan yon/ rjes su yi rang ba dngos so/ /dang po gang gis bstod pa ni/ de nas brgya byin tshangs sogs lhas/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa mchod pa ni/ /yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te/ /rin chen gdugs la sogs mchog gis/ /mchod pa sna tshogs byas nas kyang / /zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa bstod pa'i yul ni/ /phyag na rdo rje rgyal spyan la/ /zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa bsam pa ni/ /dga' ba'i bsam pas bstod byed pa/ /zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa bstod pa'i tshig ni/ /sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa la rdo rje sems dpa' la rdo rje sems dpa' dang gcig dpe'i sgo nas bcu ni/ /mi shes dri ma kun 'jom pa/ dang gnyis/ /rdo rje dang gsum/ rdo rje 'dzin rgyal po/ dang bzhi/ /rdo rje dang lnga/ rdo rje dang drug rdo rje 'dzin/ dang bdun/ /rdo rje sku ste dang brgyad/ sku che ba/ dang dgu /phyag na rdo rje dang bcu'o/ /phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ rdo rje yan lag dang gcig

rdo rje mchog dang gnyis/ /rdo rje 'bar ba dang gsum/ che 'bar ba/ dang bzhi/ /rdo rje shugs dang lnga te shugs che ba/ dang drug /rdo rje mtshon chen zer cha dang bdun/ mtshon cha che/ dang brgyad do/ /rdo rje chags pa'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ phyag na rdo rje dang gcig phyag chen po/ dang gnyis/ /rdo rje mda' dang gsum/ ste rab 'bigs pa/ dang bzhi/ /rdo rje rnon po dang lnga/ rno ba che/ dang drug /che ba'i che ba dang bdun/ rgya mtsho che/ dang brgyad do/ /rdo rje legs pa'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ rdo rje pad+ma dang gcig byang chub che/ dang gnyis/ /byang chub sangs rgyas dang gsum/ rang byang chub/ dang bzhi/ /rdo rje rgya chen dang lnga/ rgya chen dang drug ste/ /rdo rje sgyu ma dang bdun/ rnam sbyong ba/ dang brgyad do/ /rdo rje las kyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ rdo rje rgyu dang gcig ste gnod sbyin che/ dang gnyis/ /rdo rje pad+ma dang gsum/ rnam sbyong ba/ dang bzhi/ /rdo rje khro bo ma rung che/ dang lnga/ /rdo rje dgra sdang 'jom pa'i gtso/ dang drug go /rdo rje bsrung ba'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ rdo rje 'jigs pa dang gcig bsrung ba che/ dang gnyis/ /rdo rje lcags kyu dang gsum/ don yod byed/ dang bzhi/ /rdo rje ro lang dang lnga/ ro lang che/ dang drug /rdo rje srin po dang bdun/ za ba po/ dang brgyad do/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sgo nas mtshan dgu ni/ rdo rje gnod sbyin dang gcig gnod sbyin che/ dang gnyis/ /rdo rje gdon dang gsum ste gdon gyi mchog dang bzhi/ /'jigs byed dang lnga/ dga' che dang drug

drag po che/ dang bdun/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed dang brgyad/ rngam byed pa/ dang dgu'o/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi sgo nas mtshan bdun ni/ bsgrub dka' dang gcig bgrub pa legs pa dang gnyis ste/ /rde rje legs pa dgyes mdzad pa/ dang gsum/ rdo rje dga' ba dang bzhi/ dga' ba che/ dang lnga/ /dga' ba'i rdo rje dang drug dbang byed pa/ dang bdun no/ /rdo rje rin chen gyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ 'od stug pas ni gcig stug pa che/ dang gnyis/ nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa po/ dang gsum/ re ba thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ dang bzhi/ rdo rje dbang bskur dang lnga/ rin chen dang / dang drug go /rdo rje rgya mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ rdo rje rgya mtshan dang gcig yon tan mtsho/ dang gnyis/ /rdo rje ye shes dang gsum/ ye shes che/ dang bzhi/ rigs sngags bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ dang lnga/ ha la ha la nag po che/ dang drug go /rdo rje gzi brjid kyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ sgra che zhing ni gcig 'jom pa can/ dang gnyis/ /rdo rje 'dod pa dang gsum/ 'dod pa che/ dang bzhi/ /snyigs ma'i lus ngan rnams sbyongs ba/ dang lnga/ /skad gcig g.yo ba'i the tshom gcod/ dang drug go /rdo rje bzhad pa'i sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ glog bzhin zhal gyi ljags las 'phro/ dang gcig /rdo rje me dang gnyis ste ma rung 'dul/ dang gsum/ drag po rab snang dang bzhi/ snang mdzad pa/ dang lnga/ nyi ma stong gis gdung pa'i zhal/ dang drug go /rdo rje chos kyi sgo nas mtshan bdun ni/ spyan dmar dang gcig 'jigs par mdzad pa sogs/ dang gnyis/ /khro bo du ma'i 'od bzhin 'phro/ dang gsum/ /phyag rnams du mas dang bzhi/

mtshon cha brgya/ dang lnga/ /du ma'i zhal ste dang drug sku yang stong / dang bdun no/ /rdo rje rnon po'i sgo nas mtshan lnga ni/ 'gyil zhing dang gcig brgyan yang 'khyil pa dang gnyis ste/ /sems kyi chos pas sku mi mnga'/ dang gsum/ /rnam par rtog pa ma lus 'dul/ dang bzhi/ /ma rig 'jom pa'i tshangs pa ste/ lnga'o/ /'dod chags zhe sdang dri mthar mdzad/ dang gcig /sgyu ma khyab 'jug rdo rje can/ dang gnyis/ /rtse gsum rtse gsum 'chang 'phrog pa/ dang gsum/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug che/ dang bzhi'o/ /rdo rje smra ba'i sgo nas mtshan bzhi ni/ srid dang srid min rnam sbyongs ba/ dang gcig /zhi zhing la la dga' ba dang gnyis ste/ /sangs rgyas sangs rgyas rab rdzogs pa/ dang gsum/ /sangs rgyas bdag nyid sangs rgyas sku/ dang bzhi ste mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad do/ /rdo rje rab skyes rdo rje sems/ /kun du bzang po cher bzang ba/ /mtshan rnams dam pas rab brgyan pa/ /khams su bdag nyid khyab pa po/ /thams cad rdo rje'i bdag nyid gtsang / /zhes pas bstan/ drug pa bstod pa'i phan yon ni/ /gang gis 'di bris bklags gyur tam/ /rtag tu de don 'chad byed dam/ /dran nam nyan par byed kyang rung / /phyag na rdo rje 'dra bar 'gyur/ /zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa rjes su yi rang ba dngos ni/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' rtsal pa dang / brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa 'khor rnams la sogs pa dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri za dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po la sogs pa bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa mngon par dga' ste rjes su yi rang ngo / /zhes pas bstan/ zhar byung rgyud kyi rdzogs tshul smos pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa rdzogs so/

/zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa 'jug gi don byas shes drin bzo bskyed pa'i phyir 'gyur byang smos pa ni/ rgya gar gyi mkhan po shan+tiṃ ka ra dang / bod kyi lo tsa ba ban+dha dza ya rak+ṣis bsgyur cing zhus/ ā tsar+ya rin chen mchog gi skad gsar bcad kyis bcos nas gtan la phab pa'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ 'di lta bu'i rgyud 'chad pa rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam dbye byed tshul/ bdag gi rje bla ma rnams 'di ltar gsungs te/rgas par na bla ma gong ma'i rgyud kyi ṭīk+ka sa gcad sogs gsung rab chen po dag gi gzhung dang sbyar ba'i tshig don mtha' dag ma lus pa 'chad pa ni rab yin la/ 'bring du na sa gcad dang gzhung gi tshig yongs rdzogs sam thog mtha' sbyar ba'i khog phub kyi bshad pa 'di lta bu byed pa'am/ yang na rgyud kyi lung rgyun sngon la byas nas sa gcad dang gzhung gi tshig zur sbyar ba tsam zin thun du byed pa ni 'bring gi 'chad tshul yin la/ bsdus pa'i lugs ni gzhung la sa gcad sbyar ba klags lung du byas te/ gal che ba rnams la mchan bu'i steng nas bshad pa thor tsam byas pas kyang rgyun mi nub cing bshad bka' thob par gyur ba yin te/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i mngon rtogs dka' 'grel las gzhung gi don rnams ni mchan du legs par btab la/ zhes dang / bshad pa mang po ni gsang sngags dam tshig gi rgyud yin pas 'chol par 'gyur la/ zhes dang / rje btsun rin po ches gsung las kyang de 'dra ba mang du 'byung bas so/ /gzhan yang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi kye rdor rgyud bshad gnang dus kyi gsung rgyun zin bris las kyang / bla chen 'phags pa la rgyud bshad thob pa mang du yod kyang / yongs su rdzogs pa dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal che+en la/ khong dbus kyi dga' ldan du rgyud gsum gyi 'chad nyan la bkos nas/ hor rgyal pos rgyud 'dzin lnga brgya tsam la rgyun du 'tsho ba sbyar/ bkra shis dpal gyi dngos slob na bza' brag phug pa la bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgya mtshan gyis rgyud gsum gsan dus dka' sa tsho la bshad pa dum tsam dang /

gzhan rnams la lung gtso bor mdzad nas bshad bkar 'gro ba tsam gsan te brgyud pa yang brag phug pa nyid la 'ded par mdzad pa yin no/ /zhes 'byung ba dang / zha lu bu ston gyis kun mkhyen 'phags 'od la gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud bshad gsan dus kyang / 'phags 'od kyi gsung las/ khyed lta bu la rgya ba'i rgya lugs dang / gar pa'i gar lugs nas dgos pa'i lugs min/ gzhung dang 'brel pa tshor shar te bklags la skabs skabs su 'gag re tsam bshad de chos thob che bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs par bu ston nyid kyis mdzad pa'i rgyud kyi bshad thabs gsang ba'i sgo 'byed las 'byung ngo / /'di dag kyang rgyud bshad rgyas bsdus kyi rnam dbye shes pa la phan pa'i rtsod bral gyi gsung rgyun du shes par bya'o/ /gang ltar rgyas 'bris bsdus gsum gyi 'chad tshul gsum ka la rgyud gzhung dbu zhabs yongs rdzogs kyi lung dang / /de'i tshad ldan gyi 'grel pa bla ma brgyud pa zam ma chad pa las 'ongs ba'i lung rgyun nges par bya dgos shing / yang sa gcad dang gzhung sbyar ba'i bshad pa logs su ma byung yang rgyud kyi gzhung dang 'grel pa tshad thub gang rung gcig gi lung thob kyang bshad bka'i rgyun thob par 'gyur ba bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed pa lags pas rjes 'jug dpyod ldan rnams kyis dgongs par mdzod/ 'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud rgyal gyis/ /don 'brel khog phub legs bshad 'di bgyis pas/ /rtsa rgyud bla ma'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs nas/ /bdag gi rgyud la byin rlabs 'jug gyur cig 1 /tshul khrims rnam dag log spyod bral ba'i sku/ /zab yangs chos kyi chu rgyun 'beb pa'i gsung / /mtho dman kun la mnyam nyid 'byongs pa'i thugs/ /skyabs gcig rje btsun mus pas slar yang skyong / 2 /gang gi zhal dkyil zla ba'i dkyil 'khor las/ /byams pa'i 'dzum zhal yid la yang yang gcar/ /de 'dra dran tshe lus kyi spu g.yo zhing /

/mig nas mchi ma 'khrug pas gsol ba 'debs/ 3 /tsha bas gdung tshe gangs chu 'dod pa bzhin/ /dus ngan skye bo'i spyod pas log bsgrub kyis/ /shin tu mnar tshe mgon khyod lhag par dran/ /rmongs pa bdag la mi mngon dbyings nas skyobs/ 4 /'brel tshad don ldan khyod kyi thugs rje yi/ /sngon chad yid la bsam pa kun 'grub cing / /da dung bdag dang slob mar bcas pa yi/ /'di phyi'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ 5 /rje btsun khyod kyis gsung gi 'phrin las rnams/ /thabs tshul du ma'i sgo nas 'phel ba'i phyir/ /cha mthun rgyud kyi khog phub legs bshad pa/ /sbyong rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed 'di/ 6 /rdo rje gdan ltar mkhas grub 'du ba'i gzhi/ /dbus 'gyur tshal ltar chos sgra sgrog pa'i ljongs/ /rtse lnga'i ri ltar 'jam dbyangs sprul pa'i gnas/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i gnas su legs par sbyar/ 7 /dge ba 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag dang bdag gi gdul byar gyur pa yis/ /shes rgyud sgrib gnyis bag chags kun byang nas/ /dus 'dir nad med tshe rabs mthar phyin zhing / 8 /rdo rje'i lus brtas dbang po kun gsal bas/ /bstan dang 'gro ba'i don mang 'grub pa dang / /nam zhig tshe 'di'i snang ba nub ma thag /dpon slob lhan cig bde ba can skyes nas/ 9 /sa lam thar phyin gang 'dul sprul pa yis/ /spyi dang bye brag bstan pa rgyas byed shog /gzhan yang gang ri'i khrod kyi rdo rje gdan/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i bstan pa'i rgyun skyong ba'i/ 10 /myur du rings brgyud dri med 'ga' 'byung zhing / /de rgyun skal par rgyun chad med par shog /de dag rnams dang dngos rgyud slob ma yis/ /sngags 'chang yab sras bstan pa'i rgyun bzang 'di/ 11 /yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rab rgyas nas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun rnams kyi 'phrin las kyis/ /kha ba ri yi ljongs kun khyab pa sogs/ /bdag gi re smon thams cad 'grub gyur cig

12 /ces ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i don 'grel khog phub legs par bshad pa sbyong rgyud bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di yang 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo pad+ma'i rnam 'phrul bsod nams dbang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' zhi ba mtsho'i rnam par sprul pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ rigs thams cad dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag drug pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid gzhan ngor ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba rgyal tshab mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ sprul pa'i sku lo nas spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can rje nags dgon pa chen po sbyin pa grags pa/ nyams rtogs kyi mngal bdag grub mchog dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos kyi grags pa rnams gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa'i zhabs sdul spyi bos len pa/ dpal sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngon byon pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i tshul gyi gsung rab rnams mthong ba'i tshe dang 'dod kyi dad pa bcos ma ma yin pa skyes pa'i rkyen byas/ da dung bdag la rten nas rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa cung zad tsam 'phel na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i kun nas blangs ste/ rgya gar lugs la sarba dzi tra ste 'di 'dul ces grags shing / /rgya nag lugs la me mo phag gi lo nag zla ba'i dmar cha dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen po'i bzhi thog bla brang gi tshom dmar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni skyes sbyang gi blo mig rab tu gsal zhing / yi ge'i 'du byed la sbyangs pa phul du phyin pa bsam 'grub lhas sbyin gyis rnam rgyal rdo rje'i dad pa dang brtson 'grus bla na med pa'i sgo nas mgyogs par bgyis so/

/'dis bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa 'phel zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig shu bhaṃ mastu sar wa dza ga taṃ/ skye dgu rnams dge bar gyur cig r+harme u da ya mastu/ chos 'di dar bar gyur cig sarba maṅgalaṃ thams cad bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 130 a myes zhabs/ ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i don 'grel khog phub/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 127
